lines.text: Let's get one thing clear: As your handler, my opinions are not up for focus-grouping, and I don't love having my judgment questioned.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30830
lines.text: Arish told me you found the source of the tremors. He said there was no way to stop them.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30831
lines.text: I didn't do enough. We can't stop the tremors. They're just gonna keep getting worse.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30832
lines.text: Yeah, Arish told me as much. Not exactly the news we were hoping for...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30834
lines.text: I don't think Arish would agree with you.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30833
lines.text: Then it's a good thing I don't make a habit of letting other people think for me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30835
lines.text: Arish told me you found the source of the tremors, but couldn't stop them.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30836
lines.text: Arish told me you found the source of the tremors. He said there was no way to stop them. At least not yet.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30837
lines.text: Listen, Arish wants to see you at the Field Office. He and Pope are working on a plan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12609
lines.text: Zoe, I'm outside.

lines.speaker: ZOE_1510
lines.text: Glad you're still alive, Dylan. Let's get back to work.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_1512
lines.text: I'm sorry about your dad.

lines.speaker: ZOE_4562
lines.text: Oh... You heard that? It was a long time ago.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13645
lines.text: Time doesn't always help.

lines.speaker: ZOE_13646
lines.text: No, it doesn't.

lines.speaker: ZOE_2341
lines.text: Hey, Dylan. Just got a call: Pope's relocated to the Field Office to coordinate the completion of the CFD. She wants to see you.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18915
lines.text: And, uh, you should hear it from me first -- I'm being investigated for insubordination.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_8107
lines.text: What? Why?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18920
lines.text: Remember when I played music to lead you out of the Sinkhole? I sort of commandeered the PA system.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18922
lines.text: To lead you out of the Sinkhole, I sort of commandeered the PA system to play music.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18924
lines.text: You're in trouble for that?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18925
lines.text: I also abandoned my post. And... Well, the PA system was Plan B. Plan A involved explosives.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18996
lines.text: You saved me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18997
lines.text: This is a federal agency, Dylan. There are rules -- stupid rules -- and I broke them. I knew what I was doing. It's not your problem.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18999
lines.text: Anyway, they'll just give me a slap on the wrist like usual.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19001
lines.text: Are you gonna be okay?

lines.speaker: ZOE_19002
lines.text: It's not my first write-up. They'll just waste everybody's time and do nothing in the end. Trust me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19004
lines.text: They'd never fire me in the middle of an active AWE. They just wanna show that they can.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_2977
lines.text: I'm up, Zoe! What happened? Did I stop it?

lines.speaker: ZOE_3074
lines.text: The CFD? Oh you stopped it alright. But the CFD mishap earned the Patterning AWE the dubious honor of officially being the biggest threat to our dimension, according to Pope. Even worse than the Hiss. Pope's the acting director now and she's reinstated me as your handler, thank fuck.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9520
lines.text: What happened to Arish?

lines.speaker: ZOE_9521
lines.text: He survived if that's what you're asking. Suspended though. A lot of people got hurt. Last I heard he raided a liquor store and set up camp in the lobby of the Verconn building. Kicked everyone else out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9523
lines.text: It's good to have you back on the radio. Arish wasn't nearly as fun.

lines.speaker: ZOE_9524
lines.text: Aw. It's nice to order you around again.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22020
lines.text: I was trying to be serious.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22021
lines.text: That was your first mistake.

lines.speaker: ZOE_9535
lines.text: Listen, nap time's over. The CFD Patterned the Sinkhole even deeper, which Pope says is very very bad. She needs your help. Go check in with her.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22023
lines.text: Don't get too excited.

lines.speaker: POPE_4266
lines.text: Dylan, we're receiving new data from directly below the Oldest House. This info is... It's, it's incredible. And The Oldest House is being fundamentally changed by the Patterning. The sheer scale of the forces at work here is staggering. We still don't know how to stop it, but maybe now we have a chance at understanding it. And well, that's the first step towards solving any equation.

lines.speaker: POPE_4267
lines.text: I have a lot of data to dig through. Thank you again, Dylan!

lines.speaker: ZOE_22091
lines.text: Dylan? Sounds like you made Pope happy.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22092
lines.text: I saw something while I was down there, Zoe. It's difficult to explain, but... It's about Jesse. Meet me at the Oldest House, at the Prime Candidate training grounds. Near my cell.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22093
lines.text: I'll be there, Dylan.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22094
lines.text: You did good work today.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22099
lines.text: We still don't have a way to fight the Pattern.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22098
lines.text: At least we know there are a lot of ways that don't work, if I'm understanding Pope correctly. That's still progress.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22100
lines.text: I wouldn't have made it without Grist and her team. Despite everything, they completed their mission.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22101
lines.text: The Bureau will remember them, Dylan. We understand the sacrifice they made.

lines.text: Hey. In case this goes sideways, I'm sorry I dragged you into this.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71650
lines.text: Yeah, so am I.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71649
lines.text: Hey, fuck you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71648
lines.text: If this goes sideways, I'm sorry I wasn't more help.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71647
lines.text: We wouldn't have made it even this far without you. But...

lines.speaker: ZOE_71646
lines.text: Apology accepted. I would prefer to be saved.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71645

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71640

lines.speaker: ZOE_71638

lines.text: Hey, you can tell a lot about a person from their taste in music.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71637

lines.speaker: ZOE_71636
lines.text: You don't remember, or it's too embarrassing to share?

lines.speaker: ZOE_71635
lines.text: Maybe we can find the band. Another time.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71633

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49263

lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49264
lines.text: Nevermind.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49266
lines.text: Oh my god! I was in a Threshold! Holy shiiit.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49268
lines.text: Okay. You can tone it down. You were trained for this, I get it. Just keep me updated.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49271
lines.text: I'm more worried about the civilian. I was trying to find her... but I ended up back here first.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49269
lines.text: Think you can get back there again?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49270
lines.text: If I see the taxi... I hope so. I'll try.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49274
lines.text: Well, it's a good thing you're rolling with the punches, because if there's a civilian there, sounds like you have to find a way back. Keep me posted.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71171
lines.text: Damn.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71170
lines.text: I have to find another taxi...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11137
lines.text: Zoe?

lines.speaker: ZOE_11138
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.text: I just got back from the Threshold, with the taxis.

lines.text: The civilian?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11141
lines.text: I couldn't get to her... I don't think I'll find her again. But maybe... Maybe she got out on her own.

lines.text: Is that likely... or wishful thinking?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49380
lines.text: Sorry. I... hope you're right.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49381
lines.text: You know, you can be a little pessimistic sometimes.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49383
lines.text: Yeah, well, we're talking about a Threshold, remember?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49384
lines.text: But, hey, you never know. Maybe she did. At least you tried.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49387
lines.text: I got out, didn't I? I just... hope she's okay.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49385
lines.text: If she did get out... that means she's somewhere in the city, on her own. Hopefully she runs into someone from the Bureau before the Hiss.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49389
lines.text: Yeah... I hope so.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50240
lines.text: Zoe? I found six... secret hideouts, I guess. Some kind of spy stuff, except they knew about the Paranatural. And whoever they are, they're very organized.

lines.speaker: ZOE_50242
lines.text: Whoa. Sorry, you found these in New York, in Manhattan? Uh, I mean, we can assume organizations like ours exist, similar agencies in other countries, at least... But if leadership is aware of somebody operating here besides us, I certainly wasn't told. So either my clearance isn't high enough, or you found something we didn't know about.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50241
lines.text: They were monitoring the Oldest House. They had cameras, names. They knew about us.

lines.speaker: ZOE_50243
lines.text: Shit. How did they even find us? If they were watching the FBC without us knowing about it, these were some serious players.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50244
lines.text: Do you think they could be dangerous?

lines.speaker: ZOE_50245
lines.text: You were in their hideouts, you tell me. If they're like us, well, most of the time, no.

lines.speaker: ZOE_50247
lines.text: Although I guess it depends who you ask.

lines.speaker: ZOE_50246
lines.text: But if they operate under different rules or mission statements... Who knows.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50252
lines.text: I wonder if any of them survived the AWE...

lines.speaker: ZOE_50251
lines.text: Even if they all turned Hiss, if they had six outposts just in Manhattan, they must be a big operation...

lines.speaker: ZOE_50250
lines.text: Either that, or... Or they were here for us...

lines.speaker: ZOE_50248
lines.text: You didn't find anyone in these hideouts, did you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50249
lines.text: No, they all looked abandoned.

lines.speaker: ZOE_50254
lines.text: I'll inform upper management about this. When you have time, you're gonna point out every one of these locations on a map so we can send in a recovery team. Hopefully find out more.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50405
lines.text: Zoe? I've set up all the map kits the FBC dropped around the city. We should have full coverage of every zone.

lines.speaker: ZOE_50406
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50407
lines.text: Zoe? I've been setting up these... pylons across the city...

lines.speaker: ZOE_50408
lines.text: What? The map kits?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50409
lines.text: Yeah, I guess. I think I've got every zone now.

lines.speaker: ZOE_50410
lines.text: I saw those were coming online. Bureau cartographer could hardly contain his excitement. Good job.

lines.speaker: ZOE_50412

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50324
lines.text: It's dead now.

lines.text: Broke space?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50327
lines.text: Hey, I'm not a scientist.

lines.speaker: ZOE_50328
lines.text: Clearly.

lines.speaker: ZOE_50329
lines.text: And did you... Fix it?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50330

lines.speaker: ZOE_50331
lines.text: Great.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50332

lines.text: Maybe?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31458
lines.text: If I'd just... gotten here sooner.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31460

lines.speaker: ZOE_31462
lines.text: Get back safely.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5528
lines.text: Ah, fuck. We'll try to find and notify family. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: ZOE_12670
lines.text: Fuck. Are you okay?

lines.text: Yeah. I'm okay.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31909
lines.text: Good. That's good, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31911

lines.speaker: ZOE_31912
lines.text: Wait, really? I wonder what the story is there...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31915
lines.text: I wonder what he was hiding from... Did he know this would happen, somehow?

lines.speaker: ZOE_31917
lines.text: That's not a fate you wanna see coming.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31918
lines.text: No. It's not.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_1648

lines.speaker: ZOE_1708
lines.text: The Resonant is gone? And the Mold? I mean... How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30885
lines.text: I think... It feels like it's fading away.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30884
lines.text: You think?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5379
lines.text: The Mold in me was connected to the Resonant. It must be gone now. I, I can't feel it anymore.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5380
lines.text: That's good, Dylan. We're still going to get you a full medical workup as soon as we can. But for now...

lines.speaker: ZOE_30886
lines.text: Good work.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5381
lines.text: I... don't know. I feel... different. What if it's still in here, inside of me, but just silent now?

lines.speaker: ZOE_5383
lines.text: Then we won't know unless it decides to speak up again.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30887
lines.text: So for now... let's just call it gone. We'll have you evaluated as soon as we can. You did good work today, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30889
lines.text: I feel... bad, Zoe. Like... I destroyed something just being born. Were we wrong to kill it?

lines.speaker: ZOE_30890
lines.text: Is that you or the Mold talking?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30891
lines.text: I'm just saying... All the Mold wants is to live. To grow.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30892
lines.text: Yeah, well. Unfortunately for the Mold, this dimension doesn't belong to it. You did good work today, Dylan. Enjoy it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30894
lines.text: That wasn't a rhetorical question, Dylan. We'll get you a full medical workup as soon as we can, okay? You did good work today.

lines.text: She wasn't there? At her apartment?

lines.speaker: ZOE_48481
lines.text: No, she was there. And from what I hear, she seemed cooperative too... But then things took a turn.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48484

lines.speaker: ZOE_48485
lines.text: No, this isn't on you. The team found her. She was even going quietly, but...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48491
lines.text: I did. But... I let her go.

lines.speaker: ZOE_48492
lines.text: Oh, what the fuck, Dylan?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48493
lines.text: Her research will help the city. I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_48494
lines.text: Jesus Christ. You better be.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49457

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48496
lines.text: So do I.

lines.speaker: ZOE_48495
lines.text: Never do it again.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49455
lines.text: Uh... No, I didn't.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49454
lines.text: Shit. Well, hopefully she turns up. Before she does something we can't take back. Thanks for trying.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31086
lines.text: It's not too late to turn back.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31087
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22487

lines.text: What did they teach you here?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_8091
lines.text: It's not important.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5779
lines.text: Why aren't you angry at the FBC? They stole your childhood. They stole your whole goddamn life!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5780
lines.text: Of course I'm fucking angry! I'm angry at myself!

lines.speaker: ZOE_8110
lines.text: Jesus. You're gonna make some lucky therapist very rich.

lines.speaker: ZOE_17445
lines.text: What the Bureau did to you was completely fucked up. You realize that, right?

options.text: I don’t want to think about it

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17451
lines.text: They were trying to teach me how to control my powers. I was always messing up.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22628
lines.text: You were a kid and they turned you into a lab rat!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17452
lines.text: I don't want to think about it! Why can't you just drop it?

lines.speaker: ZOE_22629
lines.text: Because I'm pissed off!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17453
lines.text: You're right, Zoe, okay? Is that what you want to hear?

lines.speaker: ZOE_22630
lines.text: No! I don't want to be right. I want to be pissed.

lines.speaker: ZOE_17449
lines.text: You gotta talk about this sometime, Dylan.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22626
lines.text: What they did here? What we did here was not okay.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22627
lines.text: Door's open, Dylan. Let's move.

options.text: I don’t want to think about it

lines.speaker: ZOE_311
lines.text: Listen, I know I'm FBC. I'm a part of the organization that did this to you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17455
lines.text: It's not your fault, Zoe. Most of the FBC didn't even know about the program.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22632
lines.text: Still, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17459
lines.text: You're nothing like them, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22631
lines.text: That's not the point.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17460
lines.text: You weren't there, Zoe, but if that's an apology then I accept it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22633
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: ZOE_17461
lines.text: So I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22635
lines.text: I always knew the FBC did sketchy things but I didn't realize it was this bad.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_312
lines.text: Zoe, watch out!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_310
lines.text: I'm fine. But I have to do this part alone, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5818
lines.text: I'll update Pope and call for backup. I'll be here when you get back.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22659
lines.text: The fault should be behind this door. You good?

lines.speaker: ZOE_22636
lines.text: Christ. What happened here?

lines.speaker: INTERCOM_70799
lines.text: P6 Mobile Containment Device detected.

lines.speaker: ZOE_17348
lines.text: Shit. Janky old security system's acting up.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_306
lines.text: Let's just go.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22640
lines.text: Alright, we're going.

lines.speaker: ZOE_34011
lines.text: Ah, shit.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22641
lines.text: I need to get out of here. I need to get out of here.

lines.speaker: INTERCOM_70800
lines.text: Test 356 commencing.

lines.speaker: ZOE_17337
lines.text: Dylan? You with me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22642
lines.text: This is where it happened... I killed them...

lines.speaker: INTERCOM_70801
lines.text: System error.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22643
lines.text: Hey, hey. I know, Dylan. Your file mentioned the accident, the deaths.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_70747
lines.text: (breathing)

lines.speaker: ZOE_49064
lines.text: No one would blame you, not after what they did.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_70748
lines.text: (breathing)

lines.speaker: INTERCOM_70802
lines.text: No input detected.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17350
lines.text: I lost control. This is why I can't get angry. People die.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22644
lines.text: Dylan. They drugged you, they experimented on you for years, they didn't even treat you like a human being.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17351
lines.text: I blame me! I hurt people. I'm responsible for that.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22646
lines.text: No. The people in charge were responsible.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22645
lines.text: No. I did it. Me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22647
lines.text: I want to make this clear.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49065
lines.text: I don't blame you. And you shouldn't blame yourself.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22649
lines.text: You were an exhausted, angry, isolated 16-year-old with paranatural powers! What did they fucking expect to happen?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22648
lines.text: I just wish this never happened. I wish they never brought me here. I wish I had a normal life.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22650
lines.text: I wish you did too.

lines.speaker: INTERCOM_70803
lines.text: Deactivating security protocols.

lines.speaker: ZOE_17362
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49066
lines.text: The door's unlocked. Let's get out of here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22638
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: ZOE_304
lines.text: Patterning. We must be getting close...

lines.speaker: ZOE_22574
lines.text: What room is this?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22575
lines.text: It's the playroom.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22576
lines.text: Of course it is.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22577

lines.speaker: ZOE_22578
lines.text: Is that some old cartoon?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22579
lines.text: Puppets.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_308
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: ZOE_17463
lines.text: Shit. Looks like this area is running on emergency power. The doors won't open until we get the power running again.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22586
lines.text: I'll see what I can do.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22585
lines.text: Works for me. I'm gonna take a look around.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22587
lines.text: I'm gonna take a look around.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22597
lines.text: There's gotta be a way to get the power running.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22598
lines.text: Any luck finding the breaker?

lines.speaker: ZOE_314
lines.text: Jesus. This whole operation seems sketchy as shit. What kind of testing did they do here, exactly?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5775
lines.text: I don't remember all of it. They sedated me a lot.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5776
lines.text: Wait, they drugged you? God, the Ethics and Oversight Department really dropped the fucking ball on this one. What else did they do to you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17469
lines.text: Darling had his own ethics. It was all about results for him.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22588
lines.text: Yeah, Research has a bad habit of thinking like that.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17470
lines.text: I told you I don't remember.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22590
lines.text: Did they hurt you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22589
lines.text: Leave it alone, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22591
lines.text: That bad, huh?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5783
lines.text: Found the breaker panel, but one of the Power Cores is dead.

lines.speaker: ZOE_8096
lines.text: Don't look at me, I'm not Maintenance.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22610
lines.text: Hey, good job. Test number 82: Success!

lines.speaker: ZOE_22615
lines.text: How often did they make you do these tests? Did you get days off?

lines.text: Prime Candidates don't get days off. Darling said the work was too important.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22616
lines.text: How many hours a day?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22618
lines.text: We didn't have clocks.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22619
lines.text: I don't want to talk about this, Zoe!

lines.speaker: ZOE_22620
lines.text: You clearly need to.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22621
lines.text: I'll take that as a no.

options.text: Prime candidates don't get days off

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22655
lines.text: The replica of the Service Weapon is still here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22654
lines.text: They had a model of the Director's gun?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22653
lines.text: Shooting practice was part of Director training. No bullets though. They told me to use my imagination.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22657
lines.text: How do you learn to use a weapon without ammo?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22656
lines.text: I don't know. Can't imagine why they didn't trust me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_34009
lines.text: I'm with you, all right? We'll make it fast.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22580
lines.text: Dylan, how young were you when the FBC brought you in?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22582
lines.text: I was ten.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22581
lines.text: Christ. You grew up here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22599
lines.text: Door's locked.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22600
lines.text: You did hear me say that it won't open until the power's back on, right?

lines.speaker: THEBOARD_49698
lines.text: < Stop/Cease/Turn Back >

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49699
lines.text: What? Why?

lines.speaker: THEBOARD_49700
lines.text: < Entering is forbidden/stupid/a no-no >

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49702
lines.text: You can't stop me.

lines.speaker: JESSE_60407
lines.text: ...sorry I couldn't save you...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60413
lines.text: ...wish I could say goodbye...

lines.speaker: ZOE_68528
lines.text: Where are you going?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68527
lines.text: I'll be back.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68539
lines.text: Okay... Guess I'm waiting here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68538
lines.text: Should we continue?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68537
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68535
lines.text: Sorry. Let's go.

lines.speaker: ZOE_12387
lines.text: The Oldest House is being evacuated. We're leaving.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12388
lines.text: You shouldn't be in here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_16653
lines.text: Something came through, Dylan. Into our dimension. Into Manhattan.

lines.speaker: ZOE_16652
lines.text: We have to go. Now.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16657
lines.text: I could hurt you.

lines.speaker: ZOE_16656
lines.text: Then don't.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16655
lines.text: Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_16654
lines.text: Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12393
lines.text: Why did you come back for me after what I did?

lines.speaker: ZOE_16659
lines.text: It wasn't you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16658
lines.text: It was me. I fuck things up. That's what I do. You're fucking stupid for trusting me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_16662
lines.text: Don't call me stupid.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16661
lines.text: Then leave. While you have the chance.

lines.speaker: ZOE_16660
lines.text: And don't tell me what to do.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12394
lines.text: I'm no use to you. How could I possibly help the FBC after what happened?

lines.speaker: ZOE_16663
lines.text: That's not the point!

lines.speaker: ZOE_71850
lines.text: I'm here to save you, Dylan. Not an FBC asset.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16666
lines.text: I could have killed you, Zoe. I'm not worth saving.

lines.speaker: ZOE_16665
lines.text: I'm not giving you a choice.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16670
lines.text: I can't go. If something happened to you because of me, I couldn't, I--

lines.speaker: ZOE_71841
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: ZOE_16669
lines.text: Let me worry about me, okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16672
lines.text: Do I have to threaten you? Is that what it's gonna take?

lines.speaker: ZOE_16674
lines.text: You can try.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16680
lines.text: Why are you even here, Zoe?

lines.speaker: ZOE_16679
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: ZOE_71842
lines.text: Because I care about you and I want you to live!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16678
lines.text: Why are you yelling that?

lines.speaker: ZOE_16677
lines.text: Because, you emotionally braindead idiot, I shouldn't have to spell it out for you!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19344
lines.text: You don't understand. You said it yourself: "People don't change." You're convinced that I've always been a good person. But I wasn't. Seven years ago, I let the Hiss take me. They must have told you that.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19345
lines.text: They said you invited the Hiss in.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71843
lines.text: Why did you do it?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16720
lines.text: We're not friends, Zoe. You're my handler. We can never be friends. Not really.

lines.speaker: ZOE_16719
lines.text: You know that's not true.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18225
lines.text: Who's the one giving orders?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18226
lines.text: Fine. You know what? You're right. As of this moment, I officially resign as your handler.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18227
lines.text: Now please.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71844
lines.text: Let me save your life.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16721
lines.text: You're not hearing me.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71845
lines.text: What if...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71846
lines.text: What if that's what I want?

lines.speaker: ZOE_16723
lines.text: You don't.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71847
lines.text: I know you, you don't give up Dylan.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71848
lines.text: Listen, you are more than just an FBC asset.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71849
lines.text: More than a failed experiment, more than all that fucked up shit that happened in your past.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18228
lines.text: It doesn't end here. Let's go. Friends don't leave friends in slowly imploding Places of Power.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16733
lines.text: You know you're incredibly stubborn, Zoe?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18229
lines.text: It's not your most likable trait.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16743
lines.text: Thank you for not giving up on me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_16742
lines.text: So that's a yes?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16741
lines.text: Yeah, it's a yes.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16746
lines.text: I'm staying.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18239
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18240
lines.text: I have to save the Oldest House. I don't know how, but I have to try.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18241
lines.text: You're gonna get yourself killed.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18242
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18213
lines.text: The FBC locked me in that cell for years.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60003
lines.text: And forgot about me. Darling forgot about me. I thought Jesse forgot about me. I had nothing. No future. Just four walls.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18214
lines.text: I wanted it to end. The Hiss... It was a way out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19346
lines.text: I didn't know what they would do. I didn't know I would survive it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18216
lines.text: I failed at everything I ever tried to do. I saw the Hiss coming and I couldn't think of a reason to fight it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18217
lines.text: Maybe if I'd been stronger, like Jesse... I could have resisted. But I wasn't. Not then. And not now.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18218
lines.text: There's that winning attitude.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19347
lines.text: This isn't a joke, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19348
lines.text: I'm not laughing.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19349
lines.text: You weren't in control when the Hiss took you. You can't blame yourself for what happened.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18219
lines.text: Don't you get it? I was weak, and the Hiss used that to hurt people. I thought Jesse got rid of the Hiss inside of me, but she didn't. She couldn't. And now it's a part of me forever.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59998
lines.text: It reacted to that thing Jesse and I tried to stop, the Hedron. And if I get near it again, the Hiss will take control.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18223
lines.text: Listen.

lines.speaker: ZOE_59999
lines.text: You held back the Hiss.

lines.speaker: ZOE_60000
lines.text: I saw it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_60001
lines.text: You can do it again.

lines.speaker: ZOE_60002
lines.text: I was wrong, okay? People can change. The past doesn't matter. Who are you today?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18224
lines.text: Don't make me watch my friend die.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18230
lines.text: Come on.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18231
lines.text: What's the plan?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18232
lines.text: For now: Get everyone as far away from the Oldest House as possible.

lines.speaker: DYINGFBCRANGER_18233
lines.text: What in the- aaaaAAAAAHH!

lines.speaker: DYINGFBCRANGER2_18234
lines.text: Need backup at- gaaaahhh!

lines.speaker: ZOE_18235
lines.text: What the fuck is that thing?

lines.speaker: POPE_18236
lines.text: All personnel, this is Acting Director Pope. Evacuate the Oldest House immediately. The Hedron phenomenon occurring in the Prime Candidate area is blocking our escape. We will transmit data as long as we're able to. Do not attempt a rescue. Please, just get out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18237
lines.text: They're not gonna make it...

lines.speaker: ZOE_18238
lines.text: We have to go, Dylan.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18243
lines.text: I guess now I can't order you to leave.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18244
lines.text: No, you can't.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18245
lines.text: What if I order you to come with me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18246
lines.text: I can't follow your orders anymore, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18247
lines.text: Then you'll need your radio.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18248
lines.text: I have to go help with the evacuation... Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18250
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll keep my head up.

lines.text: This is Emily Pope. What's your status out there? Please report.

lines.speaker: POPE_1572
lines.text: Please, are you still there? Talk to me.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_1575
lines.text: This is Dylan. Everyone out here is dead. I'm sorry. But I cleared the area.

lines.speaker: POPE_7085
lines.text: Dylan? De Vera reported that you had to be contained. She said you turned Hiss.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12617
lines.text: It's true. But I'm in control again. At least for now.

lines.speaker: POPE_22688
lines.text: I took a big chance on you before and you haven't let me down.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12619
lines.text: Zoe thinks I'm fit for duty. You're gonna have to trust that.

lines.speaker: POPE_22689
lines.text: Okay. Agent de Vera was right about you before.

lines.speaker: POPE_12626
lines.text: Frankly, we don't have much to lose anyway.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22687
lines.text: This is Dylan. We cleared the area.

lines.speaker: ZOE_226
lines.text: Dylan, I'm getting reports of something in the sky. Situation's going from shit to fucked.

lines.speaker: POPE_12549
lines.text: The Oldest House is structurally compromised. Unidentified hostile entities are present in the building. All personnel must evacuate.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_227
lines.text: Bad news, Zoe. The Rangers didn't make it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_7061
lines.text: Pope is still alive. If we lose her, the FBC will come apart. Hurry, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12539
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: POPE_224
lines.text: Be advised, readings indicate that the Patterning phenomenon is caused by a Hedron. Procedures for hostile incursions on this scale are, uh...

lines.speaker: RANGERBODYGUARD_1569
lines.text: Ma'am, we're pinned down!

lines.speaker: POPE_12615
lines.text: We have no procedure for this situation. All staff receiving this message, your top priority is to discover a way to repel the Hedron. Evacuate, then keep fighting. Don't let this be the end.

lines.speaker: RANGERKAPOOR_7072
lines.text: We're stopping these fuckers here!

lines.speaker: RANGERMASON_7073
lines.text: I think it's AAAAAGH!!

lines.speaker: FBCRANGER3_7074
lines.text: It got Billy! Shoot it, shoot it!

lines.speaker: POPE_229
lines.text: Stand down. He's one of us.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12628
lines.text: The route to the exit is clear. You should evacuate. The FBC needs you alive.

lines.speaker: POPE_12629
lines.text: Right now I have bigger concerns. We have an active Patterning event happening inside the Oldest House. The House is resisting, but it's clearly losing. And... We've confirmed the source of the Patterning, Dylan: It's a Hedron.

options.text: Jesse and I met a Hedron

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12632
lines.text: Jesse and I met a Hedron when we were kids. It didn't do anything like this.

lines.speaker: POPE_12634
lines.text: Yes, I know. But that Hedron was very weak, dying. After Darling locked you away, he brought it into the Oldest House for study. Seven years ago, it died. But if this Hedron is in its prime...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12636
lines.text: Why is the Hedron even here? What does it want?

lines.speaker: POPE_12637
lines.text: We don't usually look for motivations when it comes to paranatural entities. But, in this case, we know that the Hedron and Hiss are in conflict.

lines.speaker: POPE_12640
lines.text: As a resonant force, Hedron are diametrically opposite to the Hiss at a level we don't fully understand yet. Now, Hedron are incredibly powerful transdimensional entities. And it was likely drawn here by the presence of the Hiss. To eradicate it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12641
lines.text: So you're saying the Hedron is the only thing that can wipe out the Hiss.

lines.speaker: POPE_12643
lines.text: To the best of my understanding, yes. It's a shame we can't let it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12644
lines.text: So we're caught in a war we don't understand.

lines.speaker: POPE_12646
lines.text: Reductively, yes. And it seems the Hedron is about to win.

lines.speaker: POPE_12647
lines.text: The Hedron seems to have formed a direct link with the Oldest House and used it to enter our dimension. It could transform our entire planet, our entire reality, just by being here.

lines.speaker: POPE_12650
lines.text: Dylan, I don't know what to do against something like this.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12653
lines.text: I can fight the Pattern. I've killed Resonants. So maybe I can do something about that link.

lines.speaker: POPE_12655
lines.text: I hope you're right. Your sister would want me to tell you to be careful. Please come back.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12658
lines.text: Don't worry about it Pope. You and your team need to evacuate in case things go bad.

lines.speaker: POPE_12659
lines.text: What, you don't have a plan?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12660
lines.text: I'll find out when I get there.

lines.speaker: POPE_22690
lines.text: You are definitely related to Jesse.

lines.speaker: POPE_12668
lines.text: Unlock the door. Let Dylan through.

lines.speaker: RANGERMOORE_12669
lines.text: RANGER MOORE

lines.speaker: POPE_70845
lines.text: It's funny... Your sister and I met under very similar circumstances seven years ago. She rescued me from a safe room too...

options.text: Jesse and I met a Hedron

lines.text: Dylan, did you find Pope?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12698
