lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_58212
lines.text: LW AGENT SCRIVER

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_58213
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_58214
lines.text: Sometimes I think you have no capacity for sense of wonder in your heart.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_58215
lines.text: Sounds about right.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_58216
lines.text: Nonsense. You have a better heart than that.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_58217
lines.text: ...thanks?

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57730
lines.text: Would you look at that.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57731
lines.text: LW AGENT MUIR

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57732
lines.text: LW AGENT SCRIVER

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57733
lines.text: LW AGENT MUIR

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57734
lines.text: LW AGENT SCRIVER

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57735
lines.text: LW AGENT MUIR

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57736
lines.text: It is pretty impressive.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57737
lines.text: There you go.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68297
lines.text: Zoe... How did the Hiss get into the Evac Site?

lines.speaker: ZOE_68298
lines.text: It happened so fast, we're still investigating... Probably someone made a mistake, a civilian slipped through intake with active Hiss possession. Or the Hiss just... Overwhelmed the perimeter guards. We'll have to wait on the final report.

options.text: I know we have no choice

lines.speaker: DYLAN_4449
lines.text: Look, I know we don't have a choice. It's just... she wasn't always a monster, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_4450
lines.text: At least her death will mean something. Not everyone gets that.

lines.speaker: ZOE_12297
lines.text: Look, we need her. You know that.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12777
lines.text: I'm sorry, but you can't rest yet.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12927
lines.text: It's not right what they're doing to her, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_12928
lines.text: To who?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12929
lines.text: The Resonant.

lines.speaker: ZOE_12930
lines.text: You mean the monster that nearly took out half the city?

lines.speaker: ZOE_14751
lines.text: You got a better idea to stop the Hiss, please don't hold back.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13019
lines.text: She was a victim. And a human being. This is wrong.

lines.speaker: ZOE_13020
lines.text: Welcome to the FBC.

lines.speaker: ZOE_13021
lines.text: She's dead, Dylan. Think of it like organ donation.

options.text: I know we have no choice

lines.speaker: THEBOARD_72164
lines.text: < Steel your nerves/heart for the nearby Fault/Sin/Blemish >

lines.speaker: THEBOARD_72166
lines.text: < Venture North/Underground/Choo-Choo >

lines.speaker: JESSE_60220
lines.text: ...feel it every day now...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60238
lines.text: ...an itch on my brain...

lines.speaker: JESSE_71064
lines.text: ...don't know what it is...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60239
lines.text: ...it's not good...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60230
lines.text: ...don't feel like myself...

lines.speaker: JESSE_71068
lines.text: ...just an annoyance at first...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60231
lines.text: ...like getting your sleeves wet washing your hands...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60215
lines.text: ...it's like... there's an earthquake coming...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60216
lines.text: ...except that wasn't the earthquake... ...it was a paperclip falling off a desk...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60233
lines.text: ...the real earthquake is coming next...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49657
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: JESSE_60242
lines.text: ...look again, and...

lines.speaker: JESSE_71069
lines.text: ...your hands are rotting now...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60244
lines.text: ...it's a cliche...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60243
lines.text: ...repeating, refracting, like...

lines.speaker: JESSE_71070
lines.text: ...a kaleidoscope...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60245
lines.text: ...something wrong...

lines.speaker: THEBOARD_49754
lines.text: < The Director and you/we are too close/pathetic >

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49755
lines.text: She's my sister.

lines.speaker: THEBOARD_49756
lines.text: < Tip-Toe/Watch Out >

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49757
lines.text: I'll be fine.

lines.speaker: JESSE_71067
lines.text: ...have to...

lines.speaker: JESSE_71066
lines.text: ...stop it...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60210
lines.text: ...I have to make a choice, between bad and worse...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60234
lines.text: ...sorry...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60246
lines.text: ...my thoughts keep circling...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60247
lines.text: ...do the same thing every day...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60248
lines.text: ...it's connected to what's coming...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49753
lines.text: Jesse... Where are you?

lines.speaker: JESSE_60254
lines.text: ...ever had that feeling?...

lines.speaker: JESSE_60253
lines.text: ...think there's one more step at the bottom of the stairs?...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36101
lines.text: Jesse...?

lines.speaker: JESSE_36102
lines.text: Something is coming, Dylan. I'm trying to stop it. Locking the doors. I have to do it alone. It's not safe.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36103
lines.text: I thought you woke me up to help.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36104
lines.text: I woke you up so you could run.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36105
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: JESSE_71072
lines.text: You need to go back, Dylan!

lines.speaker: JESSE_36106
lines.text: Is he still here? I can't tell.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36107
lines.text: I'm here. I'm with you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36128
lines.text: Jesse. I won't let you do this alone.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36129
lines.text: Who are... Dylan. You're my brother.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36130
lines.text: Listen to me. This place takes pieces from you. Your memories. If you stay, you will lose yourself too.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36131
lines.text: That's my choice to make.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36132
lines.text: No. Dylan--

lines.speaker: JESSE_36133
lines.text: You don't know where we are, Dylan. You don't understand what it does to you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36134
lines.text: I don't care.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36135
lines.text: If you can hear me, listen: Our dimension is a room in a house full of rooms. We are in the walls, the place between places, sealing holes so nothing leaks through.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36136
lines.text: But this place is empty. It will take anything it can get.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36137
lines.text: And we're the only ones here. Understand?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36138
lines.text: I don't know, Jesse...

lines.speaker: JESSE_36109
lines.text: The cracks are growing. We're running out of time.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36110
lines.text: Don't forget. I can't forget.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36111
lines.text: Forget what? Jesse?

lines.speaker: JESSE_36139
lines.text: You should have stayed away. You should have... You... Where are we?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36140
lines.text: Jesse? Are you okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36114
lines.text: Whatever it is you're trying to stop... It's causing the Patterning, isn't it?

lines.speaker: JESSE_36112
lines.text: I have to close the Fault. Close every Fault, before it breaks down the walls.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36113
lines.text: I have to close the Fault. Close every Fault, before it's too late.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36115
lines.text: Dylan?

lines.speaker: JESSE_36116
lines.text: He didn't get out, did he? He didn't leave.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36117
lines.text: Why didn't he leave?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36118
lines.text: I'm not leaving you.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36119
lines.text: Fuck.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36141
lines.text: I need to... I need to... I...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36142
lines.text: We're in a Fault, remember? We're sealing the dimension. Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36126
lines.text: Jesse!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36127
lines.text: I'll find you again.

lines.speaker: JESSE_60258
lines.text: What's that saying? "You can't unscramble an egg."

lines.speaker: JESSE_36143
lines.text: Wait. This is it. This is why I'm here. Protect the dimension. Save Manhattan. Keep my brother safe.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36155
lines.text: Jesse!

lines.speaker: JESSE_60257
lines.text: ...sorry...

lines.speaker: JESSE_71071
lines.text: ...can't be here when...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49758
lines.text: Jesse...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50177
lines.text: I can't feel her anymore...

lines.speaker: THEBOARD_49759
lines.text: < The sibling/you is unnecessary/surplus >

lines.speaker: THEBOARD_49760
lines.text: < We have you/the sibling >

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49761
lines.text: We are not interchangeable.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_50178
lines.text: The city needs Jesse...

lines.speaker: ZOE_68037
lines.text: Hey, you made it to the Evac Site.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68038
lines.text: Watch your step.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68039
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: ZOE_68040
lines.text: You'll see.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_6495
lines.text: Zoe, I'm at the Evac Site. I found the--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19152
lines.text: Whoa.

lines.speaker: ZOE_6496
lines.text: Dylan? You okay? We just registered another tremor.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19154
lines.text: Yeah... I registered it too.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19153
lines.text: I see the building. I'll get inside and find out what's causing the tremors.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19155
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_6499
lines.text: What is this thing?

lines.speaker: ZOE_6501
lines.text: You found the Sinkhole. Research thinks it's caused by Patterning. How deep is it now?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_6500
lines.text: It's deep. I mean, really deep.

lines.speaker: ZOE_6502
lines.text: Last I heard, it only went down a few meters. Pope sent a team to look into it, but they had to pull out when the Hiss attacked.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19881
lines.text: Nngh.

lines.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER_19875
lines.text: Remain calm. Please enter the building in an orderly fashion. This is a pre-recorded message.

lines.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER_19876
lines.text: This is a federal evacuation zone. Alert guards of any strange behavior. Food, water, and restroom facilities will be available inside.

lines.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER_19877
lines.text: If you begin to hear, smell, or taste the color red, seek assistance immediately.

lines.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER_19914
lines.text: Please take a number and wait to be processed.

lines.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER_19916
lines.text: You are safe. There is no need to panic. Information and additional reassurance will be provided soon.

lines.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER_19917
lines.text: For faster processing, fill out your intake form in triplicate using a blue ink pen.

lines.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER_19918
lines.text: Unless you require urgent medical assistance, do not interact with the staff.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19900
lines.text: Zoe, I'm in the building. Lots of dead FBC. No sign of any civilians. I'll see what I can find upstairs.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19901
lines.text: Unngh.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19903
lines.text: Dylan? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19907
lines.text: The Hiss resonance is really strong here, Zoe. I'm not sure I can do this.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19908
lines.text: Okay. Well, just... Hang in there.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19909
lines.text: The Hiss resonance is really strong here. But I can handle it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19910
lines.text: I didn't doubt you can handle it until you brought it up.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19911
lines.text: Keep it together in there.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30840
lines.text: Zoe, are you playing music?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30841
lines.text: Mind if I listen in?

lines.speaker: ZOE_30842
lines.text: Well... I guess you've earned it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71744
lines.text: Hey, I think you've earned this.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71743
lines.text: Before I forget, I found a track I think you'll like.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16523
lines.text: Arish?

lines.speaker: ARISH_9463
lines.text: Faden.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16524
lines.text: The CFD. Disgusting, isn't it? But it takes a monster to kill a monster, right?

lines.speaker: ARISH_17707
lines.text: Ahh.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16525
lines.text: I have been dreaming of this moment for seven years.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9493
lines.text: What? Why? Zoe's done nothing but help the FBC.

lines.speaker: ARISH_9492
lines.text: Agent de Vera defied a direct order, abandoned her post -- and her new team -- and nearly blew up critical machinery. She could have compromised the entire fucking CFD operation. She broke just about every protocol we have.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16547
lines.text: The Bureau loves its protocol.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16548
lines.text: Hey. You spent the last seven years sleeping while my people were fighting for their lives. Protocol saves lives.

lines.speaker: ARISH_67006
lines.text: I should know.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9495
lines.text: What? Why? Because she saved me from the Sinkhole?

lines.speaker: ARISH_9494
lines.text: De Vera's got a hundred warnings on her record, and a shitty attitude. I have been in the trenches for years. And she comes in fresh and thinks she knows better. That kind of attitude costs lives. I should know.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16549
lines.text: This isn't about Zoe. Not really. It's about me.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16550
lines.text: Okay. You wanna talk about you?

lines.speaker: ARISH_17735
lines.text: What the hell makes you think you're worth the risks she took?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16531
lines.text: Do you think it will work?

lines.speaker: ARISH_16535
lines.text: I know it'll work. I can feel it. I can feel it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16533
lines.text: Arish...?

lines.speaker: ARISH_16536
lines.text: It'll work. It has to.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16541
lines.text: The Resonant wasn't always a monster. You're treating her like a weapon.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16540
lines.text: A city full of people in danger and you sympathize with the monster.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17732
lines.text: None of them should suffer.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16538
lines.text: Well, someone's gotta, I know who I choose.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16545
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: ARISH_16544
lines.text: We're about to wipe the Hiss off the face of this dimension. I'm fan-fucking-tastic.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17733
lines.text: Is your injector full?

lines.speaker: ARISH_17734
lines.text: It's just a fucking headache!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16569
lines.text: I'm trying to make up for the past, Arish. I'm not who I was before.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16568
lines.text: None of us can change the past. And nothing we do now will fix our mistakes. Believe me, I wish I was wrong.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16576
lines.text: By saving me, Zoe saved a valuable FBC asset. You wouldn't even have the CFD at all if it weren't for me. You've seen what I can do.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16575
lines.text: And that's what I'm worried about. What happens the next time you turn Hiss, huh?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16578
lines.text: Would you suspend Zoe if she'd done it to save anyone else but me? Would you have even given the order to abandon the search?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16581
lines.text: Don't punish her because of me.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16583
lines.text: Well maybe we can rethink the suspension. But the demotion is non-negotiable. It may not look like it, but I am saving Agent de Vera from learning the hard way. When you make mistakes that get people killed, you can never go back.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16586
lines.text: Argh... Look...

lines.speaker: ARISH_17742
lines.text: We need to start running tests on the CFD, so I'll make this quick: I'm pulling you off the field.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16587
lines.text: What? But Pope wanted me to--

lines.speaker: ARISH_16588
lines.text: You were a big stick, Faden.

lines.speaker: ARISH_67008
lines.text: But when the CFD is ready, we'll have a bigger one.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16595
lines.text: Wait. Please. I need to see this through. I need to stop the Hiss. Let me help test the CFD.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16596
lines.text: You know, it might surprise you, but my team is well-trained and just as capable as you.

lines.speaker: ARISH_67009
lines.text: We don't need you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16597
lines.text: You're making a mistake, Arish.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16598
lines.text: Releasing you was a mistake. One I am more than happy to correct.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16599
lines.text: I've saved civilian lives. I saved your life.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16600
lines.text: Too little too late.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16603
lines.text: Eisner will take you back to your cell. I have the controls for your containment device now. You try anything, I will activate it and have you dragged back.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17743
lines.text: Arish--

lines.speaker: ARISH_16604
lines.text: You are NOT one of us, Faden. You are not FBC. You're not even FUCKING HUMAN!

lines.speaker: ARISH_17744
lines.text: Goddamn migraine!

lines.speaker: ARISH_17745
lines.text: Does anyone have a painkiller?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16605
lines.text: Arish, I'm sorry about the past, okay? I'm sorry for what I did seven years ago. I'm sorry so many of your team died. I'm sorry that I killed people and I can't even remember their faces! But if you don't think I feel anything from that, you're wrong. I wish things had been different, I wish I had been different.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17746
lines.text: But I didn't let the Hiss into our dimension. I am guilty, yes. But not for everything they've done. You know that.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16608
lines.text: You just feel guilty.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16609
lines.text: This is about the security of my--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16614
lines.text: This is about you! You feel guilty that you couldn't stop the Hiss. You had seven years and you still couldn't get the job done. You feel like you let your team down. You feel like you let the whole world down, and you're taking it out on me. But it's not my fault you failed, Arish.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16612
lines.text: You know what? As Zoe would say: Go fuck yourself, Arish.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16613
lines.text: I'm gonna lock you up and throw away the key, Faden.

lines.speaker: ARISH_17749
lines.text: Eisner.

lines.speaker: ARISH_16617
lines.text: Take him to his cell.

lines.speaker: RANGEREISNER_70786
lines.text: Let's go.

lines.speaker: RANGER1_17751
lines.text: Holy shit!

lines.speaker: TECHNICIAN1_17756
lines.text: It's happening!

lines.speaker: TECHNICIAN2_17757
lines.text: The CFD isn't ready!

lines.speaker: ARISH_16632
lines.text: We're out of time.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16635
lines.text: You need me, Arish.

lines.speaker: ARISH_67010
lines.text: <grunts>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17861
lines.text: Let me finish the job!

lines.speaker: ARISH_31920
lines.text: Faden! Don't fuck this up!

lines.speaker: ARISH_16648
lines.text: Anyway, I'm glad you're here. Saves me a call. I just filed the paperwork: Your handler, Agent de Vera, is being suspended. She's a decent agent, but she has completely lost objectivity.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17737
lines.text: Just not my life, right?

lines.speaker: ARISH_17738
lines.text: The truth? If you'd died in that sinkhole, I wouldn't have lost a goddamn wink of sleep. You may have fooled de Vera and Pope, but I know who you are.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17739
lines.text: You don't think it's possible to change?

lines.speaker: ARISH_17740
lines.text: Oh, I do. We're all changing all the time.

lines.speaker: ARISH_67007
lines.text: But the thing is...

lines.speaker: ARISH_17741
lines.text: People only change for the worse.

lines.speaker: RANGER1_17854
lines.text: Holy shit!

lines.speaker: TECHNICIAN1_17855
lines.text: It's happening!

lines.speaker: TECHNICIAN2_17856
lines.text: The CFD isn't ready!

lines.speaker: ARISH_17857
lines.text: We're out of time.

lines.speaker: RANGEREISNER_70787
lines.text: Come on.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17859
lines.text: You need me, Arish.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17865
lines.text: I'm gonna finish the job!

lines.speaker: ARISH_17864
lines.text: Eisner, let him go!

lines.speaker: ARISH_31921
lines.text: Faden! Don't fuck this up!

lines.speaker: ARISH_9516
lines.text: Get down there and fight!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19067
lines.text: What are you waiting for? Help those Rangers!

lines.speaker: CFDPLATFORMLOUDSPEAKER_2344
lines.text: Please stand by for CFD recalibration 285. Do not approach without authorization. Do not approach while calibration is ongoing. Do not touch the CFD or its electrified components. Be prepared to vacate the area on short notice.

lines.speaker: CFDPLATFORMLOUDSPEAKER_19058
lines.text: Calibration initiating in 3... 2... 1...

lines.speaker: CFDPLATFORMLOUDSPEAKER_19059
lines.text: Calibration cool down in progress. Calibration complete. Checking parameters now. Good. Good. Good... Hold, discrepancies detected. Hold testing.

lines.speaker: CFDPLATFORMLOUDSPEAKER_19061
lines.text: Another recalibration has been scheduled to commence in t-minus 30 minutes.

lines.speaker: CFDPLATFORMLOUDSPEAKER_19063
lines.text: Calibration checklist. Main power line? Check. Backup power? Check. Second backup? Check. Third backup? Check. Fourth Backup? -- Hold. Fourth backup? Compromised.

lines.speaker: CFDPLATFORMLOUDSPEAKER_19065
lines.text: Do not consume any unauthorized liquids, viscous foodstuff, or edible gels while on the CFD Platform. Any personnel carrying or consuming said materials will be removed and penalized.

lines.speaker: ARISH_19079
lines.text: Faden, what are you doing! Keep fighting!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19081
lines.text: Let's go! Don't stop!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19083
lines.text: Don't just fucking stand there! Fight!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19086
lines.text: Defend the CFD! That is priority number one!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19087
lines.text: Don't let them reach the CFD!

lines.speaker: ARISH_4717
lines.text: Faden, report.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_4718
lines.text: We managed to take them down.

lines.speaker: ARISH_8504
lines.text: Casualties?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_8505
lines.text: I... I don't know. A lot.

lines.speaker: ARISH_19074
lines.text: Goddammit.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19075
lines.text: Arish, we're still--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29033
lines.text: Ngaah!

lines.speaker: ARISH_2347
lines.text: Where the hell are you going, Faden?

lines.speaker: ARISH_8478
lines.text: Did you forget that I can kill you with the press of a button? Get back here and fight!

lines.speaker: ARISH_8480
lines.text: Jesus, Faden, I knew you were useless, but I didn't think you were a coward.

lines.speaker: ARISH_19073
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: ARISH_33237
lines.text: You're done.

lines.speaker: ARISH_2350
lines.text: Faden, they need you at the front!

lines.speaker: ARISH_8482
lines.text: To the front, Faden! Move it!

lines.speaker: ARISH_8484
lines.text: You're wasting time, Faden! Keep moving toward the Evac building!

lines.speaker: ARISH_8486
lines.text: Dammit, Faden, get to the front!

lines.speaker: ARISH_33908
lines.text: Form up!

lines.speaker: ARISH_33910
lines.text: Don't get split up!

lines.speaker: ARISH_33909
lines.text: Advance!

lines.speaker: ARISH_33911
lines.text: Hold the line!

lines.speaker: ARISH_33912
lines.text: Push forward!

lines.speaker: ARISH_33913
lines.text: Stay together!

lines.speaker: ARISH_33914
lines.text: Advance to the Evac Building!

lines.speaker: ARISH_33915
lines.text: They're at the Evac Building!

lines.speaker: ARISH_2352
lines.text: --hell are you doing, Faden? If they destroy the CFD, it's all over! Stop them! NOW!

lines.speaker: ARISH_8510
lines.text: Everybody fall back to the CFD platform! Move it!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19094
lines.text: Fall back to the CFD platform! Go go go!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19097
lines.text: Faden, move it! Back to the CFD. NOW.

lines.speaker: ARISH_19099
lines.text: Get your ass back here, Faden! Retreat and defend the CFD!

lines.speaker: ARISH_29036
lines.text: All units, all units, fall back to the CFD platform! Defend the CFD!

lines.speaker: ARISH_29037
lines.text: Faden, get to the CFD platform! We're gonna have to activate it... I'll need your help.

lines.speaker: ARISH_29039
lines.text: Attention -- Prepare for CFD activation!

lines.speaker: ARISH_29040
lines.text: I don't care what Pope said! We have no choice!

lines.speaker: ARISH_33924
lines.text: Fall back! Fall back!

lines.speaker: ARISH_2354
lines.text: Pull the switch on the platform to activate the CFD! I can't reach it, Faden.

lines.speaker: ARISH_2355
lines.text: Did you hear anything I said? We have to activate the CFD!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19101
lines.text: Faden, move it or we're dead! I need you at that switch!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19102
lines.text: Dylan! Get to the switch NOW.

lines.speaker: ARISH_19104
lines.text: Are you trying to get us killed? Pull the goddamn switch!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19108
lines.text: Are you stupid, Faden? The switch is next to the CFD!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19109
lines.text: Where the hell are you going? Wrong way!

lines.speaker: ARISH_19111
lines.text: Get back on the CFD platform and pull that fucking switch!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71033
lines.text: Hey Zoe, looks like someone's set up traps for the Hiss and I don't think it's the FBC. Might be worth looking into...

lines.speaker: ZOE_71032
lines.text: Be my guest. But I have a hard time believing anyone's still alive out there.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71031
lines.text: Really? We mined a lot of the city, Dylan... But can't hurt to double check.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_30475
lines.text: Halt, intruder!

options.text: You're making things harder out here
You have a unique way of speaking

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16264
lines.text: Hello? What is this place--

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16263
lines.text: This is my fortress, my port in the storm. I built it with my very own hands!

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16265
lines.text: It's a bunker.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16266
lines.text: O-kay... I'm with the government. We can evacuate you to a safe place.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16270
lines.text: One must be ready for anything -- this is what I've been preparing for all my life.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71030
lines.text: You're making things harder out here for the people trying to help.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71029
lines.text: A lot harder...

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16281
lines.text: My meaning is not to harm innocents, though. Just the...

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16280
lines.text: ...the ones that are coming. It's either me or them!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16279
lines.text: Is there anyone in there with you?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16278
lines.text: Only I. Some people came knocking at my door, offering the very thing you're trying to tempt me with.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16277
lines.text: I could see them from my surveillance monitors, getting slaughtered by those... unearthly monsters.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16276
lines.text: They're not the ones I am waiting for. Or are they?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16283
lines.text: You seem to have a... Unique way of speaking.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16284
lines.text: And what of it? Perhaps it is you who has an ordinary, and I dare say, uninspired, way of speaking.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16285
lines.text: Listen, we can move you someplace safe. It'd be nicer than your bunker. More social at least.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16286
lines.text: Pshaw! What fool would believe a man who offers protection against monsters? You can not guarantee anyone's safety.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29394
lines.text: I'm not abandoning my safe haven. And there's nothing wrong with a few traps!

options.text: You're making things harder out here
You have a unique way of speaking

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16291
lines.text: My word! Your skills are beyond measure!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16303
lines.text: See? I can handle the monsters.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16300
lines.text: I do see. Interesting! You seem to be an oddity.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16297
lines.text: Are you one of the shape people?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16305
lines.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa. What are "shape people"?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16304
lines.text: Shh, not so loud! You seem not to be informed of their arrival. Unlike myself. Hence, the fort.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16302
lines.text: I've been called worse than an oddity.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16301
lines.text: So have I. Many a time.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16299
lines.text: I could use a man of your skills. Sadly I have become separated from my dear Granny and Olivia. Will you return them to me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16298
lines.text: Uh, sure, I guess I can do that.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16296
lines.text: Huzzah! You see, when the world began to end, I was at the gym I own when the city was besieged. I was in such a rush to reach my fort that I left them both behind. Granny and Olivia are all I have left in this world.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16295
lines.text: Well, there's my brother too but we don't even talk these days.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16319
lines.text: I thought you wanted solitude.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16318
lines.text: Like my wise old Granny used to say: a family does not a man make, a man makes a family. She came from a different time, of course.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16321
lines.text: I can relate. I don't have a lot of family left either. In fact, I've been looking for my sister Jesse she--

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16320
lines.text: Do not get distracted by personal drama - you're meant to aid me!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16317
lines.text: You own a gym?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16316
lines.text: Yes. I train rigorously; one has to stay fit to survive. Does that surprise you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29427
lines.text: No, you just don't sound... Nevermind.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16315
lines.text: Poor Granny was at home when I had to flee. You'll find the place with ease. It's your people that set up the "evacuation center" right next to it, after all. I've donned my door with a trusty digital lock. The code is 8521.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16314
lines.text: 8521, got it. And Olivia?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16313
lines.text: My sweet Olivia. Like a ray of April sunshine! She's trapped at the gym. You'll find the place on main street -- but last I saw, it was swarming with the monsters.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16311
lines.text: The gym, gotcha. I'll bring them here and then we can transport you all somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29408
lines.text: Only an oddity such as the shape people could handle the monsters like that.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29416
lines.text: I need your help reuniting me with dear Granny and my sweet Olivia.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16425
lines.text: I'm back with Granny. She isn't quite what I expected.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16421
lines.text: Is she in good spirits?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16427
lines.text: All right, I'm back with Granny. She's uh... quite light.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16426
lines.text: She and Olivia will have a lovely time together, I'm sure.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71026
lines.text: I've got bad news. Your... Your brother...

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16423
lines.text: You don't have to say it. There's not much chance for anyone out there, is there?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16422
lines.text: I just wish... He told me he wanted to go to your "evacuation center". He begged me to come with him, but I chose the bunker. He must not have wanted to go without me. Now I'm here. Alone.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16420
lines.text: All right, I found Olivia too. Although, she wasn't what I thought she'd be, either.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16419
lines.text: She can keep Granny company. Huzzah!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16418
lines.text: I'm back, and I've got both Granny and Olivia with me.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16417
lines.text: What a great relief! Thank you. Now, just carefully leave them there by the door. I'll bring them in when it's nice and safe.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16428
lines.text: You know what. I have to say, they weren't quite what I expected.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16429
lines.text: That's the trouble with expectations. One must keep an open mind!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16430
lines.text: I've lost people too. It's not easy, but you have to keep going. That's what they'd want.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16431
lines.text: That's what Granny always said.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16432
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16433
lines.text: It's not your fault. I'm thankful for your help.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16434
lines.text: You could say that.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16435
lines.text: Great, excellent!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16436
lines.text: When did your Granny die?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16437
lines.text: What a rude thing to insinuate about someone.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16438
lines.text: Oh, I found something. From your brother's place. It's a photo of him at a cabin with someone. Is that you?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16439
lines.text: We took that photo on a hiking trip upstate. Getting back to nature really elevates the soul -- I think he felt the same way.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16442
lines.text: You can leave it on the table for me. Thank you.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16444
lines.text: While I enjoy having Granny and Olivia back, it's not really... enough. Especially with what's going on. The end of times.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16445
lines.text: My brother and I had our differences, but I do miss his company. Could you go find him? Bring him here?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16452
lines.text: Now, carefully set Granny down there by the door. I'll bring her in when it's nice and safe.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16453
lines.text: But what of my darling Olivia? She's still out there! With those ghoulish monsters and the...

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16454
lines.text: ...the shapes. Watching. Waiting.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16455
lines.text: I'll get her too, don't worry.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16457
lines.text: I'm back. And I've got... Olivia.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16458
lines.text: Is she feeling all right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16459
lines.text: I can't really tell.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16460
lines.text: You have eyes, don't you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16461
lines.text: You said you two don't get along. Why?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29448
lines.text: My brother never took me seriously.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29449
lines.text: And he didn't believe that the shape people were going to un-shape Earth so they can re-shape it in their image. But look who had it right all along!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16462
lines.text: Is your brother an actual human being?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16463
lines.text: What an odd question. What else would he be?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16466
lines.text: Now what about Granny?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16467
lines.text: I'll go get her too, don't worry.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16469
lines.text: You can leave Olivia there by the door. I'll be sure to pick her up.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29450
lines.text: Okay, I'll see if I can find him.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_70827
lines.text: Wonderful! My brother lives in the northeast part of the city. I have a key to his abode. But it's in my trusted chariot, which I had to abandon on the chaotic streets. However, the keys to the chariot are in the side room.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16472
lines.text: Chariot?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29452
lines.text: My car. The keys to my car.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29453
lines.text: Okay, so get the car keys to get the key to your brother's apartment. Got it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16473
lines.text: She's in good shape. Full of life.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16474
lines.text: Ah, that's what I wanted to hear!

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29445
lines.text: I do worry about the lack of sunshine in my bunker, though.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29438
lines.text: How is Granny feeling? In good spirits still?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29444
lines.text: How is Olivia feeling? Is she all good?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29447
lines.text: I think having my brother here at the end of times would be... Kind of nice. Could you find him?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29476
lines.text: I wish I could've saved my brother. Or gone to the evacuation center with him. Maybe he'd still be here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29478
lines.text: You sure you don't want to go someplace safer?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29479
lines.text: I'm fine here. But wait! I want to give you something for your troubles. It's in the side room. The door's open.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71025
lines.text: Look, when my sister--

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_70831
lines.text: Enough! Leave me to grieve in peace.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71024
lines.text: Yeah, okay...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71023
lines.text: Hey, you still there? Hello?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71022
lines.text: I, uh... I found a photograph, of your brother. And you, I think...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71021
lines.text: Sorry for bothering you.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_70836
lines.text: Leave it on the table.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_70837
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71020
lines.text: Sure... You're welcome.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_72014
lines.text: You sure you don't want to go some place safer?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_70834
lines.text: I'm fine here. Wait! I left you something for your troubles. It's in the side room. The... The door's open. Farewell. Mon ami.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29466
lines.text: Make sure you leave Granny and Olivia on the table before you go!

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29467
lines.text: Granny. Olivia. Table?

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29470
lines.text: Place Granny on the table so I can retrieve her!

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29472
lines.text: Don't forget to leave Olivia on the table!

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29474
lines.text: Oh, please leave her on the table there.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_29481
lines.text: Leave it on the table. Thank you.

lines.speaker: SURVIVALIST_16503
lines.text: You're alone. I know what that means.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_74122
lines.text: Zoe, you know those traps I found? Somebody is still alive out here...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71017
lines.text: He's living in a bunker, and doesn't want to come out.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71016
lines.text: So... He doesn't wanna be rescued? Normally I'd say we shouldn't give him the choice. But we don't really have the resources to fight someone to let us save them.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71015
lines.text: He really wants to be alone, mostly...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71014
lines.text: I think he'll change his mind. At least he has the choice.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71013
lines.text: I guess we'll see.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71012
lines.text: He was looking for family... Sort of. His brother didn't make it. Probably died days ago...

lines.speaker: ZOE_71011
lines.text: That sucks...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71003
lines.text: I tried to help him, as much as I could, given... everything. But...  Can you be depressed and not know it?

lines.speaker: ZOE_71002
lines.text: Don't go armchair diagnosing people, Dylan.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71001
lines.text: But yeah. I'd say yeah... He wouldn't be the first.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71018
lines.text: Zoe, I found someone alive in the Evac Zone. He set up mines, managed to keep the Hiss back...

lines.speaker: ZOE_71010
lines.text: Dylan... It won't happen to Jesse. We'll get her back.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71009
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71008
lines.text: I don't blame him for not trusting the FBC.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71007
lines.text: The Bureau's idea of a "rescue" isn't always better than the alternative...

lines.speaker: ZOE_71006
lines.text: Yeah... Can't argue with that. I guess you would know.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71004
lines.text: He's survived this long, maybe the Bureau can catch up with him when the crisis is over.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16326
lines.text: Oh, Granny is... more compact than I expected.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16328
lines.text: So you're Olivia. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16186
lines.text: Ah, no. Damn it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16187
lines.text: Maybe I can still bring back something.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71028
lines.text: There must be something here to remember him by...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71027
lines.text: If it were me, I'd want something to remember Jesse by...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5497
lines.text: Made it inside the factory. There's a trail here -- like... lava.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5498
lines.text: Lava?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31865
lines.text: It leads into the furnace. Maybe I can follow the trail back the other way, see where it came from.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31866
lines.text: Just don't get burned, okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5499
lines.text: Zoe, I'm inside some kind of factory. Looks like it's been hit by Patterning. I think the furnace is overheating. Doesn't seem stable.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5500
lines.text: What, you're inside? I know the place, Dylan. It's definitely not stable. The thing is, it shouldn't even be running at all. We closed it down during the initial evacuation. Maybe you can find out what the hell is going on.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31867
lines.text: There's a trail of... lava, or something, leading into the furnace. Maybe I can follow it back the other way.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31868
lines.text: Try not to get burned, okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_236
lines.text: Zoe, I'm outside that factory in Central. It doesn't look stable.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5465
lines.text: Maybe you can get inside, find out what the hell is going on.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5467
lines.text: Zoe, I'm at some kind of factory in Central. It's been Patterned. I think it's overheating, too. It doesn't look stable.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5468
lines.text: I know the place, Dylan. It's not. Thing is, it shouldn't even be running -- it was one of the first places we closed in the initial evacuation. Now no one can get inside to shut it down, or even figure out what the hell is going on.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31856
lines.text: Maybe you'll have better luck.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_240
lines.text: Zoe, I found something stuck to the factory's pipes. I destroyed it, seemed to clear some of the steam. If I can find and remove more of it, maybe I can get inside the furnace. Find out what made this trail.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5489
lines.text: Watch your back, all right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5493
lines.text: Zoe, I'm inside what looks like a... Patterned factory. I think it's overheating. It doesn't seem stable.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5494
lines.text: I know the place, Dylan. It's definitely not stable. We don't even know how it's still running -- we shut it down during the evacuation. Or so we thought.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31869
lines.text: There's a trail here, almost like... lava. Some of it's stuck to the pipes, too. I destroyed it, cleared some of the steam. If I can find and remove more of it, maybe I can get inside the furnace. Find out what made this trail.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31870
lines.text: Just don't get burned, all right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31893
lines.text: Zoe, whoever was hiding out here knew about the FBC, and knew someone would be looking into this.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31892
lines.text: That's... Strange.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_242
lines.text: Zoe? I think someone was living down here in the tunnels. Or... hiding out.

lines.speaker: ZOE_12651
lines.text: Richest country in the world, you'd think we could support the people in need.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5506
lines.text: I uh... I used to know someone in a similar situation.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31874
lines.text: Anyway, hopefully whoever it was got evacuated.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31878
lines.text: The trail... looks like it might've started here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31879
lines.text: Shit. Keep investigating, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31880
lines.text: The Resonant Entity's trail... Zoe, I think it might've started here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31881
lines.text: Oh... Uh, we'll try to find and notify any family, as soon as we can. Shit.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5518
lines.text: Found a cooling pool, I think. Is it supposed to be empty?

lines.speaker: ZOE_5519
lines.text: The evac team didn't have time to decommission the place. So... No, definitely not.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31895
lines.text: Room's full of steam. Like the water just... vaporized?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_243
lines.text: Oh, no... Zoe, I found casualties.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31896
lines.text: Damn. They can't be ours. Maybe they're city workers who missed the evac? Can you tell what killed them?

lines.speaker: ZOE_5521
lines.text: Shit. How did I guess...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31898
lines.text: Looks like they were burned. Badly. They're right next to the trail I've been following.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31899
lines.text: It's hard to tell. But... they're right next to the trail I've been following.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31904
lines.text: I think I cleared the pipes, Zoe. I might be able to reach the furnace now.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31903
lines.text: Copy.

lines.speaker: THEBOARD_71596
lines.text: < A Hazy/Overbaked echo of a Resonance/Scream lingers >

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71597
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: HEATRESONANTWHISPERS_60817
lines.text: Heat Resonant Whispers

lines.speaker: HEATRESONANTWHISPERS_60812
lines.text: Heat Resonant Whispers

lines.speaker: LWFASCIENTISTMCALLEN_58242
lines.text: Preliminary notes on the Resonant... ambient temperature is still fluctuating, registering between 20% to 50% higher than in the surrounding area. Appears to be settling down, although the possibility of significant hotspots remaining within the nearby structures should not be discounted. Hypothesis: the Resonant affected local physics, which are slowly returning to baseline.

lines.speaker: LWFASCIENTISTMCALLEN_58243
lines.text: Lw Fa Scientist Mcallen

lines.speaker: LWFASCIENTISTMCALLEN_58244
lines.text: Very weird. Very interesting.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67723
lines.text: Hey, how'd you wind up in a place like this?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67724
lines.text: Aww. Did you get separated from your humans? Can I help?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67725
lines.text: Doesn't look like you're injured. Maybe you're hungry? Or... you want something to play with?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67726
lines.text: A... A toy? That's what you want?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67727
lines.text: Okay. I'll keep an eye out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67728
lines.text: Hey girl, you wanted a toy, right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67729
lines.text: Hold tight, I'm looking.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67740
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67741
lines.text: Still haven't found anything to play with, huh? I'll see what I can do.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67742
lines.text: Oh. How do you keep ending up in these places?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67743
lines.text: Still looking for a toy? I'll find one, hang tight.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67744
lines.text: You wind up in the strangest places, don't you?

Some die off, and some evolve further continuing to grow -- like... fastforwarding through evolution.  We can't possibly keep track of all of them. My focus is on the Mold as a whole. If you want to know more about any individual strains, you'll need to talk to my team below.

lines.text: Nevermind, sorry for bothering you.

lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59886
lines.text: In case it wasn't clear, I'm in the middle of something.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59887
lines.text: We've talked enough for now.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59889
lines.text: Hey, Dr. Underhill?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59890
lines.text: If you don't have something better to do, find it. Please.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59891
lines.text: If I had more staff, supplies, and time, I would be willing to answer any questions you have. But I don't, and I'm not. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59896
lines.text: Underhill, I--

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59893
lines.text: I need to focus now. Please leave.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59898
lines.text: Dr. Underhi--

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59897
lines.text: No. Turn around. Go away. Maybe I will have time later.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59900
lines.text: What are you working on here?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59901
lines.text: A way to stop the Mold from overtaking everything in our reality. Not just the world. All of it.

options.text: How did you join the FBC?
Will the Pattern stop the Mold?
Where did the mold come from?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59903
lines.text: You mean... like an antidote?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59904
lines.text: No. I created an antidote seven years ago, which worked against the old strain of Mold. Now, new strains seem to grow every hour, making another antidote ineffective and impractical. Preventing Mold infection is not enough.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59908
lines.text: What do you mean, "all of it"?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59907
lines.text: Our dimension and every dimension connected to it. And every dimension connected to those dimensions. And so on and so forth. The Mold is multiplying at a rate we have never seen. Which is why I don't have time for idle chat, so if that is everything--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59913
lines.text: Where did the Mold come from? I mean, originally?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59914
lines.text: From a Threshold to another dimension, inside the Oldest House.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59918
lines.text: How did the Mold escape the Oldest House?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59919
lines.text: Well, as usual, when something went wrong, everyone panicked. In the commotion, proper procedure was forgotten. It only takes one spore to seed trillions. And now here we are. All my work of the past seven years essentially wasted. So if that's all...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59921
lines.text: I was just wondering... How did you join the FBC?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59923
lines.text: Such a pressing question, well worth my interrupted work.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59928
lines.text: Is the Pattern Barrier holding back the Mold?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59929
lines.text: That would be a naive and dangerous assumption. The Patterning and the Mold are reacting to each other, certainly. For now, we think the Mold is held inside with us, but not necessarily because it cannot leave. The Mold is highly adaptable.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_59931

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59933
lines.text: Your sister--? Oh, yes. You're Faden, right? I did recognize you.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59936
lines.text: She was a perfectly adequate director.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_60006
lines.text: Let's keep this short, shall we?

options.text: How did you join the FBC?

Where did the mold come from?

lines.text: Welcome to The Park, Dylan. See that bluish-green stuff that looks like cotton candy and makes your mouth water? That's the paranatural fungus the FBC has creatively deemed "The Mold". Do NOT eat it.

lines.text: Where did you come from? Did you just walk through a bunch of Mold to get here? Uh, what's your name?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30758
lines.text: It's... Dylan.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30761
lines.text: I heard about you. P6, right?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30763
lines.text: Don't worry, I wasn't in the Oldest House when you... You know.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30764
lines.text: I just read some reports. Heard some things. You're different now, right? All... better? Yeah, of course you are. You must be, or they wouldn't let you out, right? What can I help you with?

lines.text: Wait, you're the one who saved the Oldest House, right?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30767
lines.text: I um... heard about what you did before, seven years back.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30768
lines.text: I wasn't there. But it, uh, you know, sounds uh, scary. I guess you're better now, right? Yeah, of course you are. Um... Sorry, what can I help you with again?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30771
lines.text: Oh! Faden. Of course! I know who you are.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30772

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30773
lines.text: Um, anyway, sorry, I'm wasting your time. Can I... can I help you with something?

options.text: Why would the Mold target you?
What if someone ate a new strain?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30775
lines.text: Uh, sorry, did you um... Did you need something?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30778
lines.text: How are you and your team holding up out here? Are you... Okay?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30777
lines.text: Oh, well, uh... I mean, we're fine, really. You know, just, a bit short on supplies, and staff... And, we got trapped here when the Mold grew suddenly out of control...

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30780
lines.text: Maybe you met Underhill, our team lead? She's... Uh, well, not happy with our work. But we're learning new things, so I guess that's... Something. Like, uh, well...

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30782
lines.text: And now, you know, we're missing our team lead. But uh...

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30783
lines.text: At least we're learning new things, so that's something. I guess. Like, uh, well...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30784
lines.text: Actually, is there something I can do to help you?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30787
lines.text: Umm... Yeah, okay. Sure.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30786
lines.text: I don't suppose you have an advanced degree in paramycology?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30788
lines.text: No, but, really, we're just trying to make sense of the Mold's behavior. I only just uh... "met" the Mold myself when the lockdown fell, so for me, everything's new. But, uh...

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30791
lines.text: The Mold is changing, getting smarter. Which is... Uh, a concern.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30790
lines.text: It's... targeting people, I think. Us. Luring the team away one by one... But umm... I guess we're doing okay.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30792
lines.text: At least the Mold keeps things interesting, I, um... suppose. It's changing every day. Becoming more intelligent. It's targeting our team. I mean, no one else thinks so. But it's not just paranoia! The Mold started, uh...

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30794
lines.text: Luring people away from camp.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30797
lines.text: What do you mean, the Mold is "luring people away"?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30796
lines.text: It's, well, just a few from our team so far. You know, we can... We can make do, though. I'm not complaining. It's um...  Well, after eating Mold, no one's turning into Mold Hosts right away like they, you know, should. Instead, they just... walk off. All in the same direction. Like, uh... They're being called somewhere...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30798
lines.text: Do you know why the Mold is changing?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30800
lines.text: We do! Well, no, no we don't, sorry. I mean we have theories. One of them could be true. I have a theory too, but I might be wrong. I'm probably wrong. I think it's the sunlight. Busken -- who's, not a scientist -- said there must be something in the air. But the leading theory is the Oldest House was, like kind of... Suppressing the Mold's growth before, and now the Mold is just free to... Well, spread. Grow.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30801
lines.text: Why would the Mold target your team? You're saying it... knows you're trying to stop it?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30803
lines.text: Um, well, maybe? Um... Underhill said that was unlikely. You know, that it's about us specifically, but... We're definitely being slowly... Uh, eradicated. The Mold could just sees us as uh, intruders. A potential threat. In any case, we're here trying to kill it, and it's trying to kill us right back.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30804
lines.text: Who knows who will win!

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30806
lines.text: We're also, um, seeing these... New strains of the Mold popping up... Which is... Worrying. Not that I'm worried.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30808
lines.text: Mycology isn't my favorite subject. I'm a paraflora expert first. But... now we're all assigned here!

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30810
lines.text: If it was, though, I'd be really fascinated by the Mold evolving into new strains.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30809
lines.text: But, uh... Well, I'm not.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30812
lines.text: I should get going. Thanks for taking the time to talk to me.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30813
lines.text: Oh, sure. No problem. Hey, uh...

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30814
lines.text: Come again soon!

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30815
lines.text: And if you do, maybe you could bring back a couple of Rangers and about ten Researchers, huh? Carry a few microscopes along? Ha-ha.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30816
lines.text: Anyway, uh, bye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30819
lines.text: What do you know about these new strains of Mold?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30818
lines.text: Well, um... They appear to have a different parachemical composition than that of the "old" Mold. The new strains are more um, more potent, I think. In some ways. But... specific, too. At least, that's what I think. But I'm not really an expert. But if I had to guess, um, I'd say the Mold seems like it's... Learning. Adapting. Reacting, at least. To us. To the world around it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30828
lines.text: Hey, you mentioned before that the Mold was evolving new strains, right?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30827
lines.text: Oh, I'm sort of umm... I was kinda in the middle of... Nevermind! I have time to talk. Umm... New strains, yeah. They're evolving rapidly in reaction to the environment around them. What uh... Did you wanna ask something about them?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30853
lines.text: The new Mold strains appear to be a product of umm... Some level of intelligence. Maybe. I think so. Not everyone agrees. But the Mold is... Reacting to what's around it. To the world. To us. Doesn't that sound like it's smart? Kind of?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30856
lines.text: What if someone were to, hypothetically, eat one of these new strains? Just a little bit?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30857
lines.text: Uh... Well, don't! But, theoretically if someone did... Uh, I don't know. You eat the "old" Mold, you turn into a Mold Host. These new strains... Maybe they just act less rapidly? Or it's... Something entirely different.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30858
lines.text: Like... What?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30859
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30860
lines.text: Could the Mold be reacting as in... becoming more tempting to eat? Maybe even to certain individuals?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30861
lines.text: You're suggesting the Mold is... Targeting specific people? People it wants...

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30862
lines.text: For... Something... Something we don't yet understand. It's... Possible. The Mold is experimenting. Trying new tactics. We've discovered it's reactive to certain external stimuli, but the "why" is still a question mark. Interesting... I mean, it's probably not true though.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30864
lines.text: Thanks, that was helpful.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30865
lines.text: Really? Uh, great. Bye.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30867
lines.text: Oh, you're back. Ummm... Do you need something else?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30868
lines.text: I found a Mold Resonant in the Park. I think it was the reason why the Mold is changing. Getting smarter. Is that possible?

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30870
lines.text: It... Uh, was the reason?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30871
lines.text: I killed it.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30872
lines.text: Oh. Oh, right, uh...

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30873
lines.text: That sounds plausible. And... If it's dead now, maybe... Maybe the Mold's evolution will slow down. Um, but I don't really know.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30874
lines.text: I hope it makes things better for you out here.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30875
lines.text: Oh, uh, thanks.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30877
lines.text: Actually, it's not important. I'll let you get back to work.

lines.speaker: ZONEMOLDFBCCREWMEMBER1_30878
lines.text: Oh. Oh, okay. Sure. Thanks. Uh... I mean, bye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_2027

lines.speaker: ZOE_2029

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30706

lines.speaker: ZOE_30732

lines.speaker: ZOE_30735

lines.speaker: ZOE_30736
lines.text: Wake the hell up! RIGHT, GODDAMN NOW!

lines.speaker: ZOE_30621

lines.speaker: ZOE_5137

lines.speaker: ZOE_14850

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14851

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30629

lines.speaker: ZOE_30630

lines.speaker: ZOE_30633
