lines.speaker: ZOE_30653
lines.text: Jesus Christ, Dylan. It's a miracle you're still talking to me. Are you okay? You're you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30654
lines.text: I felt something. Like I wasn't alone... It's still... Calling to me. In the back of my head. But... I'm here. I'm me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30655
lines.text: So... don't answer it. I don't know how you're still alive, but I'll take it. We'll get you checked out as soon as we can. No more taste tests, yeah?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30715
lines.text: I'm... I'm back. Uh, I'm back, Zoe. I'm okay.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30717
lines.text: The Mold is... Protecting something. Behind the gateway... It's... It's looking for... Connections, or, energies, to join it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30718
lines.text: Dylan, it's getting harder to pull you out. What if next time I can't?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30721
lines.text: It doesn't matter. I'm close.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30720
lines.text: This isn't your decision to make. I'm your handler, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30722
lines.text: I'm sorry. I just... I want to finish it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30899
lines.text: Yeah, fine. We're already this far in...

lines.speaker: ZOE_30900
lines.text: How much worse could it get?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30901
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30723
lines.text: You've gotten me out of worse.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30725
lines.text: Yeah, well maybe our luck is about to run out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30726
lines.text: Just trust me, okay?

lines.speaker: ZOE_30727
lines.text: Yeah, I do, Dylan. I think.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30729
lines.text: Guess I'll just go practice saying "I told you so".

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5281
lines.text: Zoe? Zoe... Zoe? Zoe, I'm okay... I'm here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5284
lines.text: Thank fucking god.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30673
lines.text: I saw something, felt something... A barrier, of Mold.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30674
lines.text: The gateway I found before.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30677
lines.text: The Mold is changing. Growing. Creating... Something. Something new... Dangerous.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30678
lines.text: I need to find out what this is, Zoe. Maybe I can stop it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30680
lines.text: You know, you really are a loose cannon, Dylan.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30682
lines.text: God, you're even more of a loose cannon than I expected.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30684
lines.text: I already ate it twice, Zoe. I'm still here. My mind's still working.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30683
lines.text: Would we have noticed if it wasn't?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30687
lines.text: Ha ha, are you agreeing?

lines.speaker: ZOE_30686
lines.text: If I have to make an incident report about your death, I'll lie and say you went rogue.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30688
lines.text: Isn't that why I'm here, Zoe? To take the risks no one else can?

lines.speaker: ZOE_30698
lines.text: Fuck it. Fine. But I want it on record that I don't think this is a good idea.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30692
lines.text: It's worked out pretty well so far.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30693
lines.text: Alright, you're here because you don't die as easily as everyone else.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30694
lines.text: If it turns out I'm right about this, I'm gonna make sure "Stupid" is written on your gravestone.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30695
lines.text: "Brother. Friend. Stupid."

lines.speaker: ZOE_30700
lines.text: Be careful.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5343
lines.text: Zoe? I'm awake. I'm... Uh, I'm all right. I know what's happening now. The Mold, it's not evolving alone. It's drawing people in. And... It's patterning. It's creating something new, Pattern and Mold and human.

lines.speaker: ZOE_5345
lines.text: Are you saying what I think you're saying?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30737
lines.text: The gateway... It's protecting a Resonant, Zoe. A Mold Resonant.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30740
lines.text: I can feel it now, nearby... It's a Mold Resonant, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30744
lines.text: Fuck.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30745
lines.text: You know what you have to do.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30747
lines.text: Thank you, by the way. For yelling at me back there.

lines.speaker: ZOE_30748
lines.text: Anytime, Dylan.

options.text: I've survived eating it so far

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14861
lines.text: Zoe, are you there? The Mold let me through the gateway. There's enough of it inside of me now. I can feel it. Pulling me in...

lines.speaker: ZOE_14862
lines.text: I'm here, Dylan, but the signal's cutting out. I won't be able to help you in there.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14863
lines.text: What if...

lines.speaker: ZOE_14864
lines.text: You can do this, okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30769
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14567
lines.text: Hey... you look like you need help. My name's Dylan. What's yours?

lines.speaker: HEIDI_14576
lines.text: I'm, uh, I'm Heidi. My... my... well, I don't know if she's okay...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14577
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: HEIDI_14578
lines.text: My sister, Hannah. We're twins. I need to know if she's safe. We had -- she was very upset.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14569
lines.text: I found your sister. You two really look the same.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_14570
lines.text: We're identical. Was Hannah okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14571
lines.text: She will be. You've both been exposed to the Mold, but the FBC's medical team will take care of you.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_14572
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14573
lines.text: Anytime. Just stay put.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_14575
lines.text: No, no, no... oh, God, this is bad.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_14582
lines.text: No, no! I need to find her! Maybe... maybe you can find her? She should be at our, her apartment. South from here. I never returned the rooftop access key... Please.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16165
lines.text: Sit tight. I'll find her, and then I'll come back for you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19601
lines.text: What happened between you two?

lines.speaker: HEIDI_19602
lines.text: We'd been fighting... About money. About everything. I-- I moved out, right before they called the evacuation. Oh my god, I left her. I have to find her.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19603
lines.text: You can't. It's not safe.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19605
lines.text: You can't stay here. I work for the FBC, they can keep you safe.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_19606
lines.text: No, I, No. I moved out. And then suddenly the stuff was growing everywhere... I tried to find her, but -- everything looks like, like another planet...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19607
lines.text: Then you know it's not safe to--

lines.speaker: HEIDI_31924
lines.text: Ohhh... what am I going to do?

lines.speaker: HEIDI_31926
lines.text: I shouldn't have left her. Oh, Hannah...

lines.speaker: HEIDI_31928
lines.text: Who... who are you?

lines.speaker: HEIDI_31930
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: HEIDI_31932
lines.text: I... I need to know that my twin sister, Hannah, is safe.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_31934
lines.text: You... you could take the rooftop access key. Find Hannah. The apartment's south from here, I think.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14553
lines.text: Hey, you're Hannah, right?

lines.speaker: HANNAH_14554
lines.text: Oh... hello. I thought I was alone. I thought... everyone left... Everyone. I can still feel her, though. She's not far, is she?

lines.speaker: HANNAH_31935
lines.text: That stuff outside, it smells sweet, doesn't it? Really sweet...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19614
lines.text: You mean Heidi? You look just like her. She sent me to find you.

lines.speaker: HANNAH_19615
lines.text: I knew she wouldn't leave. Not really. Not really really. She always looked out for me... She's older. By one, one... whole... minute.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19617
lines.text: You seem a little out of it. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: HANNAH_19618
lines.text: No... not really. I can't leave. She might come back. If I'm not here... Well, I have to wait, don't I? But it's getting worse out there. ...right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19621
lines.text: I'll let your sister know you're all right, then an FBC team will evac you both, okay? And hey -- don't eat the Mold.

lines.speaker: HANNAH_19622
lines.text: Oh... okay. Sure.

lines.speaker: HANNAH_32101
lines.text: I can still feel her...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14586
lines.text: Zoe, got a couple people who need rescue at the Park. They're identical twins. One is in an under construction building in the middle of the zone, and the other's in an apartment at the south end.

lines.speaker: ZOE_14587
lines.text: I'll send an evac team to get them. Solid work, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14697
lines.text: Zoe. I found Heidi... She's dead.

lines.speaker: ZOE_14698
lines.text: Ahh, damn it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14700
lines.text: I really wanted to help her...

lines.speaker: ZOE_31951
lines.text: I'm sorry, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14702
lines.text: What...? Heidi?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19707
lines.text: Or... Hannah?

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_31952
lines.text: Heidi... Hannah.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14706
lines.text: Which -- which one are you?

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_14710
lines.text: Heidi.

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_31954
lines.text: Hannah.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31955
lines.text: What... happened to you?

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_31956
lines.text: To you?

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_31957
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19710
lines.text: Uhh, Zoe? I'm seeing a bunch of the sisters. I mean a lot of them.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19711
lines.text: O-kay... I'm gonna need a little more context.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31960
lines.text: Well, there's more than two now. A lot more. They're just standing around... making this... noise.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31961
lines.text: Is that as creepy as it sounds?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31962
lines.text: I think... they're peaceful.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32102
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31966
lines.text: Heidi was right. It wasn't Hannah back at the Field Hospital. At least... not the only Hannah.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31967
lines.text: Shit. Never a dull day, huh?

lines.speaker: ZOE_31963
lines.text: Or just leave me hanging.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31968
lines.text: Let me know when you find out more.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_31971
lines.text: Dylan!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14717
lines.text: Heidi... Heidi! Hey, you're not one of those copies, right?

lines.speaker: HEIDI_14719
lines.text: No. It's me! I don't know what... what these other things are. They all have our face, but they're just -- empty...

lines.speaker: HEIDI_19715
lines.text: Hey! Hey! Oh, thank God!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19719
lines.text: You took off from the Field Hospital. What were you thinking?

lines.speaker: HEIDI_19720
lines.text: They kept telling me that thing in quarantine was Hannah, but I knew she was still out here. She's my sister. I had to come.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19722
lines.text: Listen, we need to get you back to the Field Hospital.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_19723
lines.text: No. Hannah, she's always had it harder than me. And I... I haven't been there for her. This is... If I'm gonna be there for my sister, now's the time, right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19727
lines.text: You didn't eat the Mold, did you?

lines.speaker: HEIDI_19728
lines.text: No, no I didn't. God, these things... They feel like Hannah, but there's something wrong. And they keep making that sound...

lines.speaker: HEIDI_19732
lines.text: Hannah's... behind this door. I -- I followed her. Lured her in and locked it. She's... changing... Please, you have to help her. Take the key.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19735
lines.text: Uh--

lines.speaker: HEIDI_19736
lines.text: Do something. Anything.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_31970
lines.text: I'm so glad you're here.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_31973
lines.text: How is this happening? What are these things?

lines.speaker: HEIDI_31975
lines.text: Please, Dylan. Take the key. Help my sister.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14725
lines.text: Hannah? Your sister is here. I'm gonna try to help you...

lines.speaker: MOLDHANNAH_14726
lines.text: Heidi? Where -- where is she? She's close...

lines.speaker: MOLDHANNAH_31978
lines.text: Heidi...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31981
lines.text: She's very worried about you.

lines.speaker: MOLDHANNAH_31980
lines.text: Heidi? She's... my sister.

lines.speaker: MOLDHANNAH_31982
lines.text: I... I'm... There's so many. I can't focus...

lines.speaker: MOLDHANNAH_31983
lines.text: Heidi! Are you here?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31985
lines.text: Hannah? Did you eat the Mold?

lines.speaker: MOLDHANNAH_31988
lines.text: I knew I shouldn't taste it. But I -- I had to...  To feel better...

lines.speaker: MOLDHANNAH_31987
lines.text: Where's Heidi?

lines.speaker: MOLDHANNAH_31986
lines.text: Heidi! Where are you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31990
lines.text: Listen, I know people who can help--

lines.speaker: MOLDHANNAH_31991
lines.text: Heidi!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31992
lines.text: Hannah, calm down.

lines.speaker: MOLDHANNAH_31993
lines.text: Heidi! I won't let you go!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_14730
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaahh!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_19748
lines.text: Heidi...

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32001
lines.text: Where are you? Heidi!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32002
lines.text: Heidi! Please! Don't leave me!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32004
lines.text: What did I do wrong?

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32003
lines.text: I can't do this alone!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32005
lines.text: Heidi, please!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32006
lines.text: I'm sorry, Heidi! I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32007
lines.text: Heidi! I need you with me!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_14730
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaahh!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_19748
lines.text: Heidi...

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32001
lines.text: Where are you? Heidi!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32002
lines.text: Heidi! Please! Don't leave me!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32004
lines.text: What did I do wrong?

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32003
lines.text: I can't do this alone!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32005
lines.text: Heidi, please!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32006
lines.text: I'm sorry, Heidi! I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32007
lines.text: Heidi! I need you with me!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_14730
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaahh!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_19748
lines.text: Heidi...

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32001
lines.text: Where are you? Heidi!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32002
lines.text: Heidi! Please! Don't leave me!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32004
lines.text: What did I do wrong?

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32003
lines.text: I can't do this alone!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32005
lines.text: Heidi, please!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32006
lines.text: I'm sorry, Heidi! I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32007
lines.text: Heidi! I need you with me!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_14730
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaahh!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_19748
lines.text: Heidi...

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32001
lines.text: Where are you? Heidi!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32002
lines.text: Heidi! Please! Don't leave me!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32004
lines.text: What did I do wrong?

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32003
lines.text: I can't do this alone!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32005
lines.text: Heidi, please!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32006
lines.text: I'm sorry, Heidi! I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: MOLDCOPIES_32007
lines.text: Heidi! I need you with me!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14826
lines.text: The "Hannah" at the Field Hospital, she's actually some kind of... Mold copy. And I found a lot more of them.

lines.speaker: ZOE_14833
lines.text: Mold copies? That's new.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14834
lines.text: Heidi's... well, not okay. But she's alive. She needs another evac.

lines.speaker: ZOE_14835
lines.text: What about the copies? How worried should we be?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14837
lines.text: I don't know. They seem passive now, but the rest of the Mold's pretty aggressive. And apparently they look human enough to fool a medical check...

lines.speaker: ZOE_14838
lines.text: Yeah, I had the same concern. Let's hope this is a one-off, and the Mold didn't learn a new trick. We'll send in a containment team.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14840
lines.text: They just... stand around. I mean, it's weird, but I don't think they're a threat. They don't behave like the rest of the Mold.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19771
lines.text: We're stretched pretty thin as it is. If you're sure, the Mold copies can wait. Hope you're right about this.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19766
lines.text: Hey Zoe. That situation with the twins? It's over.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19768
lines.text: The body at the apartment wasn't Heidi's. It was some kind of... Mold copy. And the "Hannah" at the Field Hospital is a copy, too. I found a lot more of them.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32017
lines.text: If you're not sure, we'll send in a containment team. Just to be safe.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14738
lines.text: I'm not sure it was really her anymore. Somehow, the Mold--

lines.speaker: HEIDI_14739
lines.text: You're wrong. She was screaming my name. Maybe she was changing, but... It was still Hannah, deep down.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14742
lines.text: If you'd been there, it would've happened to you too.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_14745
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_32015
lines.text: But I'll never know for sure.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19749
lines.text: I'm sorry. Hannah, she was...

lines.speaker: HEIDI_14732
lines.text: I heard. God. I did this to her. If I'd just been there, this wouldn't have happened.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19758
lines.text: You may not be ready to hear this, but... She's at peace now, for what it's worth.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_19759
lines.text: She's really gone, isn't she? Despite all of these -- these people that look like us... Like her.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19762
lines.text: I'm really sorry, Heidi. Just... wait here. Another team will come for you. You're gonna be okay.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_19764
lines.text: Yeah... Sure.

lines.speaker: HEIDI_32014
lines.text: It's my fault this happened to Hannah... I shouldn't have left.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21946
lines.text: Hey, are you guys with Dr. Underhill? I was told her team needed some help...

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66562
lines.text: We're supposed to be with Dr. Underhill. Except she's gone.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22286
lines.text: Hey, you guys need any help?

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66560
lines.text: Yeah, you could say that. We're here with Dr. Underhill. Or we would be, except she's gone.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22291
lines.text: Gone?

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66558
lines.text: Yep. We were out at our research site. A routine job, except she just walked off. Don't ask me why, I've been watching her back for almost seven years now. But she's not gonna waste her time explaining herself to ol' Busken. And she's not answering comms.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66557
lines.text: Like I was saying... Dr. Underhill walked off in the middle of a mission. No idea why.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22296
lines.text: If you have any idea where to start looking, I'll find her.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66555
lines.text: No shit? I heard about you. You're Faden, right? The Director's brother. I didn't expect...

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66553
lines.text: Well, I'd sure appreciate it. It's not exactly unusual for her to just... Do what she wants, but not like this.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22298
lines.text: So... You just left her there? You didn't follow?

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66611
lines.text: I couldn't charge after her without leaving the rest of the team in the middle of all that Mold. It was the right call. But it doesn't mean my responsibility for her ends.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22302
lines.text: What... She just left?

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66550
lines.text: Welcome to my world. Underhill's a character, you could say. All part of her charm. She's in charge, so technically, she can do what she likes. But sneaking off like that... I have a bad feeling she doesn't want to be found.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66549
lines.text: The research site's deeper in The Park, south from here. Maybe you could do some good old-fashioned detective work, find out where she went? Also... Underhill's usually... Well, Underhill. Stubborn. Determined. But lately, she's been, detached.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66548
lines.text: Dr. Underhill's usually focused. But lately, she's just... Not herself, you know? It's like... She doesn't care about anything.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22313
lines.text: I understand. She's part of your team, you're worried.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66546
lines.text: The way things are out there... Mold expert or not, she could be in a lot of trouble. We're all real tired now. It's too easy to slip up, with nobody watching your back... If it was me in that situation, I'd want someone to come after me. And we sure as hell need her expertise.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22315
lines.text: Do you think she's... Depressed?

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66544
lines.text: I mean... We spent seven years in lockdown. Now we get out, and it's suddenly the apocalypse. It's a lot to take. For all of us. She's got way more responsibility than most, and she doesn't exactly lean on anyone else, you know? So... I dunno, maybe.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66541
lines.text: Just... See what you find. Underhill's a pain in my ass but I-- I feel like I let her down. Well, I'm supposed to look out for her, you know?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22324
lines.text: I have an update on Dr. Underhill.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49421
lines.text: She said she's quitting and going home.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66537
lines.text: Home? What, England? Or...

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66536
lines.text: God, she's out of her mind!

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66535
lines.text: Shit, maybe she is out of her mind. You gotta track her down, okay? Before something out there gets her.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22330
lines.text: Hey, excuse me -- do you happen to work with a Dr. Underhill?

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66533
lines.text: Only for the last seven years. Have you seen her? She's missing. We need to -- we need to track her down.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66532
lines.text: Maybe she's just... Gone back to work. Established a new research site... Somewhere... And didn't tell anyone.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66531
lines.text: God, if nobody finds Underhill soon, she could... Well... Hopefully she's just... Gone back to her workstation at the research site... She's just working. Maybe.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22335
lines.text: Yeah, maybe she's working...

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66527
lines.text: Yeah, you're not convincing me anymore than I'm convincing myself. She's not working... If she was, she'd be here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22339
lines.text: She left a letter of resignation. It said she's going home.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66529
lines.text: What the fuck? We just spent seven years in the Oldest House. None of us have homes anymore. Not really. Or... does she mean England? Fat chance of that, as long as that barrier's up. I just... fuck.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66526
lines.text: Whatever's going on, Underhill needs help. Like, serious help. I'd do it myself if I could, but...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22347
lines.text: I've got it. Okay? Trust me.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48398
lines.text: If you have any idea where to start looking, I'll find her.

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66554
lines.text: No shit? You're the guy who took down the Hedron. Faden, right? I didn't expect...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48402
lines.text: Do you think she might have eaten the Mold?

lines.speaker: BUSKEN_66542
lines.text: No way. She'd be the last person to do that. But... She has spent literally years elbows deep in it. And with everything happening, I... Shit. I guess I can't say for sure there wasn't an accidental exposure. Even she could slip up.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21954
lines.text: Zoe, I just found a resignation letter from a Dr. Raya Underhill? Looks like she just left her office key. Says she went home.

lines.speaker: ZOE_21955
lines.text: Did you say Underhill? There's an alert out that she's missing... But if she just... Quit? And "home"? The entire city's fucked, how could she go home? This doesn't sound right, Dylan. Look into it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22373
lines.text: Dr. Underhill? I'm Dylan. What're you doing here?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49428
lines.text: Faden? The Director's brother? Not who I would've expected...

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_21977
lines.text: I used to live here... I hoped there'd be something left, but of course they cleared everything out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49429
lines.text: You didn't answer my question...

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49430
lines.text: They must all think I'm dead, you know. My friends. My children. If they're even still alive; a lot can happen in seven years. When lockdown activated, I thought, well, at least I have Casper. But of course that ended badly.

options.text: I have to take you in
How will you stop the mold?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_21986
lines.text: Incidentally, I wasn't implying I resented the decision to institute the lockdown because of Casper, or... My children, or any other personal reason. I know it was necessary.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21989
lines.text: You have children?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_21990
lines.text: I do. And an ex-husband. A nice man, really. Good father. My children will be adults now. Back in England, I would hope. Parenting was never my calling, but I wouldn't want them on this continent, caught up in all of this.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_21991
lines.text: I wonder what ridiculous story the Bureau told them...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21993
lines.text: The lockdown was... Hard on everybody.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_21994
lines.text: Yeah, of course. But for others, the Bureau is a career. A calling. For me, my time was a job -- a fascinating job, yes, but not a lifetime commitment to some cause. I was a contractor.  And being locked in a building indefinitely for seven years was not what I negotiated.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49431
lines.text: Although of course now it is a cause. It has to be.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21995
lines.text: Casper... You were friends with Dr. Darling?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_21997
lines.text: Yes, you knew him, of course. But in a very different context. We had a... close association, once. But he's long gone now. I'm afraid his replacement can match neither his insight nor his charm.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_21998
lines.text: Nor his excesses, I suppose.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22000
lines.text: All that's left to me is my work. But they won't let me do it. Stopping the Mold requires a more... Radical approach than the FBC will allow. So it's time to part ways.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22005
lines.text: The Bureau lacks the clarity of vision to take the kind of radical approach necessary to fight the Mold. It's infuriating, trying to make them see sense. So I gave up.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22106
lines.text: Yeah, but... Doesn't it make sense to be careful?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22107
lines.text: Of course. In fact, I designed many of the protocols they're so concerned with. But the point of containment protocol is to contain. And clearly, that proverbial ship has sailed. Sunk, even.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22109
lines.text: I'm not sure I like the sound of "radical approach."

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22110
lines.text: Well, clearly, you've adopted the Bureau mindset. Its name notwithstanding, at this point the FBC is not remotely in control. I think that calls for a new approach.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22113
lines.text: But... Why are you here? Are you... Are you okay?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22115
lines.text: Of course I'm not "okay." No one is "okay" now. I know a little of your background; you're not "okay," are you? All we can do is maintain a rational worldview. And search for something to make our continued existence worthwhile in the face of extinction.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22120
lines.text: Since you're here... I have a lab in the sewers.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_59858
lines.text: The area was favorable to Mold growth and therefore my studies, but unsafe for the wider team. The specimens I have cultivated there are even too dangerous for me to handle alone. I need samples of them harvested.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22121
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22124
lines.text: Glad you agree. There's the key to my lab.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22153
lines.text: I... I have your samples.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22154
lines.text: Finally. Let me take a look.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22157
lines.text: You used me. You made it sound like the FBC was just... Uninterested in your experiments. You didn't tell me you're going against orders. Pope wants you detained.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22158
lines.text: I can't believe how risk-averse she is. Honestly, I can't believe she was Casper's student.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22159
lines.text: I don't think I can do that. I have to take you in.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49435
lines.text: I should take you in.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22162
lines.text: Very well, take me in.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22163
lines.text: Or are you hesitating, because you once spent so long in a cell?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49436
lines.text: Am I supposed to make your mind up for you?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49437
lines.text: <sigh>

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22166
lines.text: Allow me to explain. Like the Mold, Patterning also transforms matter, and beyond that, spacetime itself. Now I have a working theory that I can use the Patterning to disrupt the Mold's operations, rendering it essentially inert.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22172
lines.text: I... I think your intentions are good. And you're the expert on Mold, so... Take the samples.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22174
lines.text: I'm sorry, Dr. Underhill. I know you mean well, but... I think your research is dangerous. I have to report you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22176
lines.text: I'm sorry, I can't let you have these samples. It's too risky. But I'm not going to report you, either. I don't think you deserve to be imprisoned.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22179
lines.text: I can't guarantee results, but I appreciate your trust. The Bureau, however, will be displeased.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22180
lines.text: I have to do what I think is right. ...Don't I?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22181
lines.text: I can't alleviate your uncertainty, Mr. Faden. I won't be here if you return, in case you change your mind. Either way.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22182
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22185
lines.text: I see you have become a company man. I suppose it runs in the family. Although your sister was more of an independent thinker.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22209
lines.text: You're letting me go?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48452
lines.text: I guess I am.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22211
lines.text: For your information, we are not the same. What happens to me is not a reflection of what happened to you.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22375
lines.text: Let me see the samples.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22377
lines.text: Well, Mr. Faden? Are you going to report me to the Bureau? Or hand over my samples so I can get back to work?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22667
lines.text: Excuse me -- who are you? How did you find me?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_22682
lines.text: You're back.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48419
lines.text: As I said, Patterning may be the key to stopping the Mold. The alternative is to watch it spread across the entire planet.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48424
lines.text: Your plan sounds... Iffy.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49441
lines.text: Iffy?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48429
lines.text: Maybe it is "iffy". For the moment. More research and experimentation is needed for me to confirm my hypothesis. But somebody needs to do something. Are we so afraid of failure we would rather stand back and watch the Mold eat everything than apply our knowledge to the problem?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48434
lines.text: The FBC already tried exploiting the Pattern with the CFD. How'd that turn out?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48435
lines.text: That was a foolish man deploying untested technology against the advice of experts. I am proposing a series of controlled experiments. I won't pretend there are no risks, but don't lump me in with Simon Arish. I am a scientist.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48437
lines.text: I fought a Resonant that was some kind of a combination of the Mold and Patterning. Is this--

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48439
lines.text: No, it's not the same at all. That was a creature. It had agency, an objective, however alien. What I'm talking about is a predictable biochemical process that uses Patterning to affect the structure of the Mold.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48441
lines.text: So. The decision falls on your shoulders. Will you give me the samples and let me go to work? Or would you have me detained?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48442
lines.text: That's not fair. I have no way to know how dangerous what you're proposing is. If you just explain it to them--

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48444
lines.text: Oh yes, I'm sure that the Bureau's famous flexibility will balance things in my favor.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48445
lines.text: They let me out. After everything.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48446
lines.text: And I'm sure I'll be treated exactly the same as the man with extensive paranatural abilities.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48447
lines.text: You gave me no choice. Look, you should see the Bureau psychiatrist.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48449
lines.text: Call it in. Send in the dogs. Obviously, I'm finished.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48450
lines.text: I'm sorry, I just can't--

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48451
lines.text: I'm really not interested in hearing how you feel about this.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48454
lines.text: If you've been moved by some assumption that you and I are alike, we're not.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48455
lines.text: Are you trying to talk me into detaining you?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48457
lines.text: Course not.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48458
lines.text: I don't know what I feel anymore. I used to have a life, once upon a time. Now, I don't even know what...

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48459
lines.text: I don't know whether I should thank you or not.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48460
lines.text: Just... Take care of yourself.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48461
lines.text: I know that. I'm doing this for you, not me.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48463
lines.text: Oh, please. I don't need your sympathy. What I needed were those samples.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_48464
lines.text: Leave. You give me some privacy, in my own home. Such as it is.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49433
lines.text: If you're going to be here, wouldn't you rather be useful?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49439
lines.text: The FBC... Pope wants you detained. Convince me not to listen. How can you stop the Mold?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49440
lines.text: "Mold" is a misnomer. It's actually the product of extradimensional micro-organisms which consume and transform matter, building what we see as the Mold as a colony of sorts.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49443
lines.text: You've already lost control of your research. Your "specimens" escaped your lab.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49444
lines.text: They were not yet combined with the Pattern.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49446
lines.text: But they could've been, right?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49445
lines.text: I have been doing this work a very long time. I know what precautions to take when.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49482
lines.text: Well? If you want to watch the city be consumed, you may as well start now.

options.text: I have to take you in
How will you stop the mold?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49427
lines.text: What do you want?

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49449
lines.text: You can't have anything more to say, Mr. Faden. Go. Make your call. Not here. I'd like some privacy.

lines.speaker: UNDERHILL_49451
lines.text: Go. Please. I need time alone.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22194
lines.text: Zoe?  You can send a team for Dr. Underhill at her old apartment. I don't think she's going anywhere. She's... Kind of done.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22197
lines.text: I'll send a Ranger team to pick her up. Nice work.

lines.speaker: ZOE_22135
lines.text: Dylan, orders just came through on Dr. Underhill. Pope's excommunicated her.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22138
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ZOE_22139
lines.text: Joke. But she thinks Dr. Underhill's gone AWOL and may be planning to use paranatural materials in an unauthorized manner. If you find her, orders are to have her detained.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22143
lines.text: I... Uh, copy that.

lines.speaker: FRONTLINEAIRLOCKRECORDING_6391
lines.text: Attention, you are now entering a new containment zone. Hiss resonance may be present in the zone. Protocol requires that you wear a Black Rock Injector at all times, carry backup vials when available, and use other zone-appropriate PPE before exiting the checkpoint.

lines.speaker: FRONTLINEAIRLOCKRECORDING_18777
lines.text: Personnel advisory: Black Rock Injectors insert resonance-dampening liquid into your bloodstream. This process is experimental and incomplete. Under ideal conditions, Black Rock Injectors will protect users for a maximum of six hours under direct Hiss exposure in a 24-hour time period. Individual results may vary. Note that your injector offers protection against Hiss corruption, not physical attacks.

lines.speaker: FRONTLINEAIRLOCKRECORDING_18779
lines.text: Attention, FBC employee. Be aware that the Manhattan AWE has caused drastic environmental and architectural changes across the city. Uneven terrain, sudden drops, and non-Euclidean structures are to be expected. Watch your step.

lines.speaker: RUDEGATEGUARD_18775
lines.text: Fuckin' freak.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58263
lines.text: Hey, any news from Arish?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58264
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58265
lines.text: I knew that mission was a bad idea.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58266
lines.text: It was obviously a bad idea. But he insisted. He wanted to go.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58267
lines.text: We made it through seven years of hell... and now we lose him?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58268
lines.text: I have to say, Dylan Faden is not the guy I expected to save Arish.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58269
lines.text: No shit. Wild.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58270
lines.text: All that Hiss at the Evac Site, though...

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58271
lines.text: The Hiss and Faden do tend to pop up together, huh?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58273
lines.text: That weapon Arish is having them build, the CFD? Thoughts?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58274
lines.text: Well... I admit that weaponizing a Resonant corpse is pretty out there. But... kind of awesome too.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58275
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Springburn

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58276
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58277
lines.text: Jesus, what a mess.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58278
lines.text: Well, it kind of worked, right? I mean, maybe--

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58279
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Springburn

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58280
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58281
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Springburn

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58282
lines.text: Know much about the new Head of Security and Operations? Ruboneka, was it?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58283
lines.text: I think I had lunch with him once...

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58284
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58285
lines.text: What the hell else was he going to do, twiddle his thumbs while the world burns?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58286
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58287
lines.text: We really need Director Faden back.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58288
lines.text: Ahh, hell. Arish.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58289
lines.text: He was a good guy.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58290
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Springburn

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58291
lines.text: Feels kind of crazy to do this without Arish. He was a rock.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58292
lines.text: Yeah. So, what do you think of Ruboneka, after chatting with him a bit?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58293
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58294
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Springburn

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58295
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58296
lines.text: Still, I guess... neither was Arish, before he was.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58297
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58272
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

options.text: I'm sure they'll get to it
What do you know about Mold?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30505
lines.text: Hey. What's the situation here?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30506
lines.text: Hi. How are you?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_2048
lines.text: You really wanna know?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_14273
lines.text: I've been calling for back-up from the Field Office for ages and they still haven't--

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30508
lines.text: Wait. You're not the back-up, are you? One person?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30509
lines.text: They just don't care, do they?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30511
lines.text: You really wanna know?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30512
lines.text: I've been calling for back-up from the Field Office for ages and they still haven't--

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30513
lines.text: Wait. Didn't I see you come through here before? You're not the back-up, are you? One person?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30514
lines.text: They just don't care, do they?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30523
lines.text: You know, I've told the higher-ups we need reinforcements in the Park over and over, but I never hear back. You'd think my radio's broken.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14275
lines.text: I think I might be the backup.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_14276
lines.text: Of course. Of course you are. That's great, that's really, really excellent. Who are you again? You know what, doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14278
lines.text: I'm sure they'll send more help as soon as they can.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_14279
lines.text: Aren't you the innocent little optimist. I take it you haven't been with the Bureau for long? Nothing but delays and red tape. You'll see.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14284
lines.text: You haven't... looked up lately, have you? We've got a lot on our plate.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_14285
lines.text: Hey, you have your thing, I have mine. The Park is assigned to me, so that's what I'm gonna worry about. You got a problem with that?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30521
lines.text: Nope. No problem.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_14281
lines.text: Nobody wants to hear it, but the Mold isn't just growing -- it's changing.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_14282
lines.text: You don't even wanna know what happened to the guy on the other guard shift.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30526
lines.text: The Mold isn't just growing out of control. It's changing too.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30527
lines.text: If I told you what happened to the other guy who worked this guard post, you'd probably lose your goddamn mind.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30528
lines.text: How much do you know about the Mold?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30529
lines.text: You really are new, aren't you? Look, I'm just the Security Guard. All I know is it's some kind of paranatural fungus that came out of the Oldest House when the lockdown fell. Apparently the Director did a real number on it a few years back, but now it's evolving. So we're fucked anyway. If you want details, you're gonna have to ask Dr. Underhill's team inside the zone. They're the ones studying it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30530
lines.text: What happened to the other guy?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30532
lines.text: Morbid curiosity, huh? Okay, sicko, here you go: I came to relieve Banks from his shift. Was a few minutes late, he whined about missing lunch service, nothing abnormal. Said he wanted to check something on the other side before he left. Two minutes later, I get a radio call, and he's just... breathing. And he wanders off and never comes back. My brother used to sleepwalk when we were kids. Kinda reminded me of that.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30535
lines.text: Do you know how the Mold is changing?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30534
lines.text: I don't have firsthand experience of what the Mold was like before, but everyone who does says it's... fuzzier. More "pillowy". "Inviting." And the old ways of fighting back aren't working anymore. Smells better, too, I hear.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30538
lines.text: I'll try to help out as much as I can.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30540
lines.text: Yeah, okay. Forgive me if I don't hold my breath while I wait for you to come back.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30541
lines.text: If you go MIA in there, trust me, they're not sending backup. Maybe if you fill out Form 657-B and wait two weeks.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30543
lines.text: Look, I'm doing what I can to help in there.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30544
lines.text: Oh great, Mr. Hero's on the case. Is that your superhero outfit? I don't think I caught your name? Actually, don't tell me. I'll find out when the mayor gives a speech about you saving the city. Good luck.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30537
lines.text: Yeah, it smells pretty good.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30548
lines.text: Look, I got calls to make, okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30549
lines.text: Okay. Thanks.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_30546
lines.text: Well, actually... Nevermind.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30551
lines.text: If anyone asks, I didn't let you in, okay?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30552
lines.text: I don't get paid enough.

options.text: I'm sure they'll get to it
What do you know about Mold?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30494
lines.text: No one's allowed beyond this point without proper PPE.

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30497
lines.text: Hey. Hey, where are you going?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30500
lines.text: You got PPE?

lines.speaker: AGENTUCHIDA_30503
lines.text: You could die in there. Don't say I didn't warn you.

lines.speaker: AIRLOCKLOUDSPEAKER_30556
lines.text: Attention, you are now entering a new containment zone. Hazardous Mold growth covers a significant portion of the region's landmass. Mold spores may be present in the air.

lines.speaker: AIRLOCKLOUDSPEAKER_30557
lines.text: Protocol requires that proper PPE is worn when passing through the zone. PPE may be removed only in designated research areas where air quality can be carefully monitored.

lines.speaker: AIRLOCKLOUDSPEAKER_30558
lines.text: Required PPE includes: A full containment suit, two layers of gloves, plastic boot covers, a Parafilter-equipped respirator, a backup respirator, and backup goggles. Failure to wear proper PPE when moving between designated safe areas in the zone, may result in effective death via rapid fungal overgrowth and loss of brain autonomy.

lines.speaker: AIRLOCKLOUDSPEAKER_30559
lines.text: Due to supply shortages, new PPE will not be issued.

lines.speaker: AIRLOCKLOUDSPEAKER_30561
lines.text: Do not ingest the Mold. Resist the urge.

lines.speaker: AIRLOCKLOUDSPEAKER_30563
lines.text: Be advised: This zone is heavily impacted by an extradimensional fungus called the Mold. The Mold is undergoing rapid, uncontrollable growth and unpredictable evolutionary leaps. The Mold may cause salivation, excessive hunger, and a distorted sense of smell and taste. Do NOT enter the zone on an empty stomach.

lines.speaker: AIRLOCKLOUDSPEAKER_30565
lines.text: Personnel advisory: If you previously received the Mold antidote, you may no longer be protected against new strains of Mold.

lines.speaker: AIRLOCKLOUDSPEAKER_30567
lines.text: Do not ingest the Mold. Resist the urge.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71180
lines.text: Hey! Wait! Is this...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71179
lines.text: ...Still Manhattan?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71177
lines.text: Uh, Zoe?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71176
lines.text: Can you hear me? I'm stuck in some kind of... Threshold, I think... Trying to get myself unstuck...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49257
lines.text: Dammit. Back here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49256
lines.text: I could use some help, Zoe...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49255
lines.text: Guess I took the wrong cab.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49260
lines.text: Again! Zoe? Come on, pick up... Please.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49259
lines.text: One of these cars has to be... different.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71175
lines.text: Zoe? Something's changed, but... But it's not enough yet.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49250
lines.text: Hey Zoe? You there?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49251
lines.text: I think I'm getting closer...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71182
lines.text: Okay... That did something...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71183
lines.text: That worked... I think.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71184
lines.text: No... That wasn't it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71185
lines.text: Nothing's changed...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71174
lines.text: Okay... I'm back. Where are you, Mila?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_10917
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLERUNKNOWN_10919
lines.text: Hello? Hello!? God, I've been calling forever! I...

lines.speaker: TAXICALLERUNKNOWN_49220
lines.text: I don't know where I am. Somewhere in the city, but I... I don't recognize it. I think... there's no way out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_10920
lines.text: Okay, hey, I can help you. I'm Dylan.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_10921
lines.text: I'm... I'm Mila. You... how can you help? You're not even here.

options.text: Tell me how you got there

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49222
lines.text: Because I'm here too... Somewhere near you, I think. I must be. So, we're in this together, okay?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49223
lines.text: Okay... That's good. I mean -- you know what I mean.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49225
lines.text: Tell me how you got to where you are, and maybe I can find you.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49226
lines.text: I... I was in a cab, going to my parents' house to do some laundry, and... It... dropped me off here.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49227
lines.text: God, I should've... tried to run after it. I didn't want to be rude. Or... weird. I thought, maybe I was just a few streets over.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49228
lines.text: What do I do?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49230
lines.text: Well, I'm with the government.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71178
lines.text: They'll... They can figure this out. Even if I can't.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49237
lines.text: Finding you isn't the hardest thing I've done.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49238
lines.text: Oh god. I should give up now.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49240
lines.text: Just... sit tight.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71181
lines.text: Look, I must be near you, but... on the wrong street, somehow. Just... sit tight.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49242
lines.text: I can... I can do that.

options.text: Tell me how you got there

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71173
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11058
lines.text: Hello? Is it you again?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71172
lines.text: Yeah, it's me. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11059
lines.text: No! No. Listen, I heard sirens just before I was dropped off here. Not normal ones, they were... Did... did something happen in the city? Do you know? My parents -- they live close by...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49275
lines.text: The city... There was an evacuation.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49277
lines.text: What? Why?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49280
lines.text: Let's talk about it when you're out, okay? We'll look for your parents together.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49279
lines.text: Oh my god... Oh no. They're... They're old. I... I...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49278
lines.text: We're gonna get you out of here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49284
lines.text: Uh, no, nothing happened that I know of. Just a... false alarm. The city's fine. I'm sure your parents are... fine.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49283
lines.text: Okay... Okay, that's good.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49282
lines.text: Now let's focus on getting you out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49288
lines.text: I just need a little more time. Wait there. I'll find you.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49289
lines.text: Hurry.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11070
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11071
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49290
lines.text: Looks like we're still not in the same place. But I'll keep trying.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11072
lines.text: You... you said that last time. There's no way out of here, is there?

options.text: I got out, so can you

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49292
lines.text: Uh, hey, what kind of movies do you like?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49293
lines.text: What? Movies? What are you... I don't know, something funny, I guess. Action comedy. I used to like thrillers, but... I think my tastes just changed.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49294
lines.text: I like action comedies too. You got a favorite? Okay just... Just tell me about it. The whole plot. I have to go, but you keep talking, okay? When you're done, I'll find you.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49295
lines.text: I... okay. Um... It starts with... a... a car chase...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49299
lines.text: No, listen. I've gotten out. More than once now. You can too.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49298
lines.text: What? But... if you're not trapped, then, you're nowhere near me! I need to go.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49297
lines.text: No, no, no, no, no, just wait.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49296
lines.text: For how much longer?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49301
lines.text: I... just trust me. Please. I'm coming.

options.text: I got out, so can you

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49303
lines.text: Mila? Are you there?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11081
lines.text: I want the truth. You know what's going on in this place, don't you? Just... be honest with me. Please.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49305
lines.text: No. It's just... construction in the city. Don't worry. Everything is fine. It will be fine.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49306
lines.text: I don't... I don't believe you. You're just some voice on the phone. For all I know, you're keeping me here. You drove the cab, didn't you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49307
lines.text: No. No, I swear. I'm here to help.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49312
lines.text: God... I... I gotta get out of here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49311
lines.text: You will. Soon.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49310
lines.text: Okay... We're in... something called a Threshold. It's like... another dimension. Or a parallel universe. I know it's hard to--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49309
lines.text: You're saying I'm not... I... I... I'm not in... Oh my god. Jesus. What do I... What do I do?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49308
lines.text: We can figure this out. This is no big deal. Trust me. Okay? Mila?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49313
lines.text: Okay... I... please, get me out of here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49314
lines.text: I will. Soon.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11101
lines.text: You're still not here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11103
lines.text: I know, I... I'm sorry. I can't seem to get to you...

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11102
lines.text: This is where I die...

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49317
lines.text: Maybe I should... just walk. Somewhere. In circles if I have to.

options.text: Find a cab and get in

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49319
lines.text: Just... stay in one place. I'm not giving up on you.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49320
lines.text: Okay... okay, I'll wait for you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49324
lines.text: Good. I'll see you soon, all right?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49322
lines.text: I don't even know you...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49325
lines.text: I swear. Just... I'll see you soon, all right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49327
lines.text: All right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49328
lines.text: Listen, there's a way in and out of this place. But it's... not easy. I was hoping I could...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49330
lines.text: Are there any taxis nearby?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49332
lines.text: I don't know, I've been... I didn't want to look around anymore.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49331
lines.text: I need you to look for a car. If you find the right one, it can take you back. There's a trick to it, you have to recognize a pattern in them...

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49344
lines.text: What was the point?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49342
lines.text: Please, just try.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49343
lines.text: I'll try.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49341
lines.text: Good. Don't give up.

options.text: Find a cab and get in

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11110
lines.text: Hello? Hello, Mila?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11111
lines.text: You're still not here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11112
lines.text: I... I'm so sorry. I won't stop looking.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11113
lines.text: Did you hear me? Hello?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49346
lines.text: I'm gonna find you. I will.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49349
lines.text: Mila? Did you try it?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49348
lines.text: It didn't work. I... can't make sense of it. Nothing works!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49353
lines.text: Just keep trying, okay?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49352
lines.text: I'm not... I'm not gonna answer anymore. I... you're just making things worse.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49351
lines.text: No, Mila--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49350
lines.text: Goodbye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49354
lines.text: Mila, find another cab! Hello?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49355
lines.text: Mila? Did you try it?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49358
lines.text: I'm... I am somewhere new. But I'm still trapped.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49357
lines.text: Then it's working. Find another cab. Find the pattern. You can do this.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49356
lines.text: Okay... I will. Hey, if we don't talk again... Thanks.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49359
lines.text: Just keep going.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11129
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11132
lines.text: Mila?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11130
lines.text: Hello...? I think this is, it's letting me record an answering message. Can payphones do that? I'm not sure if it's... really a payphone.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11131
lines.text: I can't wait here anymore, I'm sorry. I have to... I have to do something. I think I can climb this building. I do bouldering in my free time... I'm gonna see what's on the other side. Hopefully, I... won't be back here. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49360
lines.text: Goodbye...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49363
lines.text: Hello? Mila?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49362
lines.text: Are you there?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49364
lines.text: Mila...?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49368
lines.text: Hello? Mila?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49367
lines.text: Dylan? Dylan, listen, I think -- I think I saw someone else in here. I think she knows how to get out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49366
lines.text: Hey, hold on--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49369
lines.text: I'm gonna follow her. I have to go.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49373
lines.text: Dylan? Dylan, listen, I think -- I think I found the right cab.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49372
lines.text: That's good. I--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49371
lines.text: I have to go.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49375
lines.text: Mila--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49374
lines.text: I'm getting out of here this time. I'm sure of it. I won't be back. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49377
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19923
lines.text: I started digging through the file on you that Arish left behind. A lot's redacted, it's still a pretty rough read.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19924
lines.text: I don't usually leave my judgments up to other people's reports, but... I'm beginning to wonder if I made a mistake.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19925
lines.text: That wasn't me--

lines.speaker: ZOE_19943
lines.text: Fuck. Everything in your file can't be true, can it?

lines.speaker: ZOE_19944
lines.text: How many people must have died?

options.text: Regret putting me in the field?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19945
lines.text: I'm not denying it. I know what the file says, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19948
lines.text: Based on what I'm reading, you might want to rethink that answer.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19949
lines.text: I want to help. That's all.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19951
lines.text: I wish it was that easy.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19952
lines.text: Do you regret putting me in the field?

lines.speaker: ZOE_19953
lines.text: I'm kind of starting to.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19955
lines.text: Maybe Arish was right about you.

options.text: Regret putting me in the field?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20001
lines.text: <breathing rapidly>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20002
lines.text: Zoe... Maybe you did make a mistake trusting me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_20003
lines.text: People don't change, Dylan. So what kind of person are you really?

lines.speaker: ZOE_19987
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71145
lines.text: That's how many people died when... When the Hiss first invaded the Oldest House, seven years ago.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20015
lines.text: Ungh!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19961
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19981
lines.text: Zoe... I found some of the civilians. It's not good.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19982
lines.text: The tremors are getting worse. You need to figure out what's causing them.

lines.speaker: UNKNOWNVOICE_20044
lines.text: How the fuck did this happen?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20045
lines.text: Hold on, I'm coming!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20051
lines.text: Zoe, I think I found the source of the tremors...

lines.speaker: UNKNOWNVOICE_20009
lines.text: No. No, no! No, no, no, no, no. Goddamn it!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20010
lines.text: Zoe, I hear someone!

lines.speaker: ZOE_20011
lines.text: <static>

lines.speaker: UNKNOWNVOICE_20055
lines.text: No. No. No, no! No!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20057
lines.text: There's someone alive in there!

lines.speaker: ARISH_20206
lines.text: All those civilians... We fed them to the Hiss on a silver fucking platter.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20211
lines.text: You couldn't have known this would happen.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20213
lines.text: If I want your platitudes, I'll ask for 'em.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20214
lines.text: The FBC overestimated itself. Again.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20215
lines.text: Fuck you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20252
lines.text: Doors are jammed. Maybe we should take the stairs.

lines.speaker: ARISH_22222
lines.text: No time. I used to work in Maintenance.

lines.speaker: ARISH_74062
lines.text: <grunts>

lines.speaker: ARISH_20255
lines.text: Learned that from a janitor.

lines.speaker: ARISH_22279
lines.text: If I turn into one of those things, you kill me, Faden.

lines.speaker: ARISH_22280
lines.text: Let's go. Hit the button.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20234
lines.text: We need to get out of here.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20236
lines.text: What are you waiting for?

lines.speaker: ARISH_20239
lines.text: Call the elevator. I'll keep watch.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20192
lines.text: Snap out of it!

lines.speaker: ARISH_20193
lines.text: You wanna be left behind?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20194
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20201
lines.text: Elevator's down the hall.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20267
lines.text: There's more Hiss crap blocking up the elevator. We're not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20268
lines.text: I won't make it down the stairs, but you might. I've got an access key.

lines.speaker: ARISH_58604
lines.text: There's more Hiss crap blocking up the elevator. We're not going anywhere.

lines.speaker: ARISH_58605
lines.text: I won't make it down the stairs, but you might. I've got an access key.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20271
lines.text: I thought you wanted me dead.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20272
lines.text: Well, I owe a lot to your sister.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20273
lines.text: I'm not going to leave you here, Arish. That's not who I am.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20276
lines.text: Oh, so you're a fucking hero now?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20278
lines.text: I'll get the elevator working.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20277
lines.text: I made a deal to help the FBC. And the FBC needs someone who knows how to fight.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20279
lines.text: This doesn't change anything.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20280
lines.text: I'll get the elevator working, Arish.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20282
lines.text: Once you do, I can't wait. Not with an empty injector.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20284
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20283
lines.text: I don't want to wait for you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20285
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: ARISH_33286
lines.text: Here's the key.

lines.speaker: ARISH_33896
lines.text: Once it's working, I can't wait for you. And I don't want to.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33898
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: ARISH_33897
lines.text: Here's the key.

lines.speaker: ARISH_33899
lines.text: You want the key or not, Faden?

lines.speaker: ARISH_20263
lines.text: Shit! Fuckers blocked the elevator.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20264
lines.text: I'm in no shape to fight.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20289
lines.text: Arish! That should be it! Go!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20330
lines.text: No more.

lines.speaker: ARISH_21654
lines.text: Thomson and Cho were like... brothers to me.

lines.speaker: ARISH_70723
lines.text: Cho just had a kid.

lines.speaker: ARISH_70724
lines.text: I'm keeping it together for the Director, but you...

lines.speaker: ARISH_21653
lines.text: You're a fucking monster!

lines.speaker: ARISH_20035
lines.text: Your sister resisted the Hiss.

lines.speaker: ARISH_70725
lines.text: Why the hell couldn't you?

lines.speaker: ARISH_20036
lines.text: 536 people gone in one day.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20027
lines.text: I had a dream where you tried to fight the Hiss, and regretted it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20025
lines.text: The Hiss made your friends better. Just like they made me better.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20029
lines.text: You need to stop running. You need to see the truth.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21650
lines.text: We can be friends. You, me, and the Hiss.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21652
lines.text: You are a worm through time. The thunder song distorts you. Happiness comes. White pearls but yellow and red in the eye. Through a mirror the inverted is made right. Leave your insides by the door. Push the fingers through the surface and into the--

lines.speaker: THOMSON_19968
lines.text: Shit!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19970
lines.text: <Hiss incantation>

lines.speaker: THOMSON_19974
lines.text: Cho, it's him!

lines.speaker: CHO_19975
lines.text: Hurry!

lines.speaker: CHO_19976
lines.text: Don't!

lines.speaker: THOMSON_19977
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19994
lines.text: <Hiss incantation>

lines.speaker: ARISH_20104
lines.text: FUCK!

lines.speaker: ARISH_20105
lines.text: Dammit!

lines.speaker: ARISH_20108
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20109
lines.text: What the hell are you doing here?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20114
lines.text: Arish? You're alive!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20115
lines.text: Don't worry. I'm not Hiss.

options.text: Don't let it be in vain

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20117
lines.text: Pope cleared me to help. You can trust me. I swear.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20119
lines.text: I hate the Hiss too. You have no idea how much I hate them...

lines.speaker: ARISH_20122
lines.text: Pope should have never let you out of your cage. You're a--

lines.speaker: ARISH_20123
lines.text: Fuck!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20126
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: ARISH_20128
lines.text: I'm running out of injector fluid. I don't have much time. How could my team run out before I did?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20131
lines.text: This place is pure Hiss resonance. How are you still alive?

lines.speaker: ARISH_20132
lines.text: The team ran out of injector fluid. Mine's running low. I shouldn't have brought them here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20134
lines.text: We need to go.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20135
lines.text: Everyone's dead! The civilians. My team. We came here for a fight, but there's nothing to goddamn shoot! It's getting stronger, we can't stop it...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20136
lines.text: You're still alive, Arish. The FBC needs everyone they can get.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20138
lines.text: Seven years in lockdown and we never figured out how to defeat the Hiss. We've been chasing our goddamn tails. Nothing's changed.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20139
lines.text: Yes, it has. The Patterning is changing them. There's a chance.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20141
lines.text: If we don't go now, your team died in vain.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20143
lines.text: You don't get to talk about my fucking team

lines.speaker: ARISH_20142
lines.text: A leader should go down with his team.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20144
lines.text: Who's that gonna help, Arish?

lines.speaker: ARISH_20146
lines.text: You go first. I want you where I can see you.

lines.speaker: ARISH_20116
lines.text: Why the fuck did they let you out? After what you did!

options.text: Don't let it be in vain

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20538
lines.text: No, I don't want to be here. I don't want to see this again!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20177
lines.text: Over here!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71144
lines.text: Oh god. The civilians... They're the source...

lines.speaker: ARISH_20175
lines.text: I can't see anything but red!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20041
lines.text: <breathing rapidly>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19934
lines.text: Ahh!

lines.speaker: ZOE_19935
lines.text: I lost you there for a second. Do you read me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19936
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. I'm here. Just some bad memories.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71180
lines.text: Hey! Wait! Is this...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71179
lines.text: ...Still Manhattan?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71177
lines.text: Uh, Zoe?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71176
lines.text: Can you hear me? I'm stuck in some kind of... Threshold, I think... Trying to get myself unstuck...
