lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14762
lines.text: Yeah, sorry, where did the operator go? More urgent than this?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14763
lines.text: Well is someone else authorized to operate the-- no. No. Right. Protocol. Yeah, I get it.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14764
lines.text: So, just to double check, why do we need an engineer for this? Is it like a really complicated system...

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14765
lines.text: A lever? So, up down? Worried you're gonna scratch the paint? Hit something? Parking ticket?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14766
lines.text: You strike me as a risk-taker, Adams. If you don't tell, I won't.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14767
lines.text: Yeah, yes, protocol! You're right. Of course! Let's wait for the only person authorized to operate a lever!

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14770
lines.text: She's back? Fantastic.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14771
lines.text: There we go. Back on track.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13042
lines.text: Dylan. A big Hiss tremor just hit the surface.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14773
lines.text: Dylan, the bell's sensors are picking up a spike of Hiss resonance.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_1433
lines.text: It's destabilizing the Sinkhole! You've got to--

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14774
lines.text: ...find a way to clear it! Dylan?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_4877
lines.text: Dylan? Still with me? Respond.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13696
lines.text: Dylan! You okay down there?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12321
lines.text: Let's find out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13697
lines.text: I'm all right.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13698
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13699
lines.text: Listen, this is the furthest Pope's team made it, before... you know. We have no idea what's beyond this point.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14776
lines.text: Let me know when you're ready.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12326
lines.text: Let's see how deep this hole goes.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14785
lines.text: Looks like the disruption cleared. Nice work.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13155
lines.text: Problem solved.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13154
lines.text: Nice work.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12329
lines.text: Zoe, what was this place? Before the Sinkhole?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12331
lines.text: An apartment building.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12332
lines.text: Did everyone get out in time?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12330
lines.text: ZOE SPEAKER

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13092
lines.text: Dammit. Got another disruption. Keep your head up.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_67108
lines.text: Ready to go?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12359
lines.text: Zoe, did you have family in the city?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12360
lines.text: ZOE SPEAKER

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12363
lines.text: Look, are you ready to go or not?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12365
lines.text: You have my file. The FBC tracked everything I did, said, ate, for almost my entire life. It's already personal for me.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12366
lines.text: I do have your file, yeah.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12367
lines.text: Which means I know a lot of embarrassing details that I'm guessing you don't wanna get into right now.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12368
lines.text: It's my job to know you, Dylan. Doesn't go both ways.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12375
lines.text: Did they evacuate in time?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12376
lines.text: Okay, we're not friends, and you don't know anything about my family. So drop it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12378
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.speaker: PATTERNEDSPEECH_4517
lines.text: (Distant, ambient murmurs of strange, PATTERNED SPEECH, growing louder and more numerous as Dylan descends.)

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_1437
lines.text: We're almost out of tether, Dylan.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12380
lines.text: How deep is this thing?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67109
lines.text: <gasp>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_1449
lines.text: Zoe... I found the residents.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_7921
lines.text: Are they a threat?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_7922
lines.text: I don't think so.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12381
lines.text: Are they alive?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12382
lines.text: I hope not.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13097
lines.text: Looks like you hit bedrock, Dylan. Main probe has been released from the diving bell. Install the relays, then get out.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12408
lines.text: ZOE SPEAKER

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14789
lines.text: The bell's local radar should show you where to place each probe relay. Instructions say the relays will signal automatically when they're in the right spot. Easy.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_29138
lines.text: The relays will light up green when they're in the right location.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12425
lines.text: If their radio chatter is anything to go by, Research is very happy about the signals coming up so far. It's working, Dylan. Finish the job.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12441
lines.text: Don't forget to activate the relays once you place them.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_12449
lines.text: Remember to activate the relays, Dylan.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_15381
lines.text: That's it. You did it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_15382
lines.text: Zoe? Something's happening down here...

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13108
lines.text: ...fuck was that? What's spiking? What does that even mean?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13109
lines.text: Yes! Dumb it down for me, please!

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13110
lines.text: Dylan! Are you on the bell?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13111
lines.text: Get on the diving bell now.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13112
lines.text: ZOE SPEAKER

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13117
lines.text: Zoe, I can't reach it!

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13116
lines.text: Do you copy? What's going on down there? Dylan? Dylan!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12472
lines.text: Zoe?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13610
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67110
lines.text: Zoe! I'm here!

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13609
lines.text: Are you reading me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67111
lines.text: I read you! Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13608
lines.text: Please respond. Dylan?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14791
lines.text: Are you there?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14793
lines.text: Dylan? Hello?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14795
lines.text: Do you read?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14798
lines.text: I don't know if you can hear this, Dylan, but we lost the bell.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14799
lines.text: The Sinkhole shifted and closed up on us. Research thinks diverting the resonance weakened its structural integrity.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14800
lines.text: They could've figured that out before it happened...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13741
lines.text: Zoe? I'm here! Hello?

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13740
lines.text: Okay. Look, I'll try to organize a rescue party, but... I'm not sure we can reach you, Dylan.

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_67112
lines.text: Fuck!

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_13743
lines.text: ZOE SPEAKER

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67113
lines.text: DYLAN

lines.speaker: ZOESPEAKER_14801
lines.text: Listen, the bell's losing power. You might have to--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14803
lines.text: Zoe? Zoe?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14804
lines.text: Don't leave me here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_13615
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13614
lines.text: Zoe?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13617
lines.text: Zoe? I hear something...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13669
lines.text: Zoe, I can't follow the cable any further.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13670
lines.text: I'm not gonna make it out of here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14807
lines.text: Zoe, the exit's patterned shut.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14808
lines.text: I'm not gonna make it out of here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14810
lines.text: It's... It's starting to feel pretty tight in here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_13637
lines.text: Dylan? I'm... <static>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13638
lines.text: Zoe? Zoe, hello?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18312
lines.text: ...explosives lying around... ...gonna try to...

lines.speaker: ZOE_18313
lines.text: ...didn't work... ...Stay with...

lines.speaker: ZOE_18372
lines.text: ...something else... ...maybe we'll...

lines.speaker: ZOE_18373
lines.text: ...been six hours, Dylan...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18371
lines.text: Six hours? It hasn't been that long... has it?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18378
lines.text: ...gonna keep talking... ...I've... PA system... ...hear the music?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18377
lines.text: I hear it, Zoe. I hear it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18587
lines.text: ...ordered to give up the search... ...you... MIA...

lines.speaker: ZOE_67115
lines.text: ...reassigned... immediately... ...always another crisis...

lines.speaker: ZOE_67116
lines.text: Goddammit! ...sorry, Dylan...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18588
lines.text: No. Zoe, I'm still here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_67114
lines.text: ...gonna keep talking... ...I setup... speakers... for you.... ...hear the music?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18384
lines.text: ...more of your file... ...lost your whole family in one day... ...I didn't...

lines.speaker: ZOE_18382
lines.text: That really blows.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18390
lines.text: ...asked about my family...

lines.speaker: ZOE_18392
lines.text: ...mom left when... sixteen... ...three days after ...eenth birthday... Dad died... ...but, hey, I was... right?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18391
lines.text: ...I ...as bad as you... ...not that... competition... But... well, you win...

lines.speaker: ZOE_18388
lines.text: ZOE

options.text: Well, if you hadn't left me...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12606
lines.text: Zoe... Thanks. For not leaving me alone down there.

lines.speaker: ZOE_12608
lines.text: ZOE

lines.speaker: ZOE_67117
lines.text: And I don't abandon people I'm in charge of.

lines.speaker: ZOE_13620
lines.text: Dylan? You just pinged on my radar. Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13619
lines.text: Zoe? Yeah, I hear you. Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: ZOE_13621
lines.text: Loud and clear. Hey, let's not do that again.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13624
lines.text: Well if you hadn't left me down there in the first place...

lines.speaker: ZOE_13623
lines.text: Well maybe next time I won't help you get out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13627
lines.text: Great song, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_13626
lines.text: Sometimes that's all you need.

lines.speaker: ZOE_13630
lines.text: You're almost out. Keep going.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13629
lines.text: See you soon.

options.text: Well, if you hadn't left me...

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTKONTOS_57714
lines.text: Lw Laundromat Agent Kontos

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTGREEN_57715
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTGREEN_57716
lines.text: Hey, keep up the good work!

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTKONTOS_57717
lines.text: Lw Laundromat Agent Kontos

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTGREEN_57718
lines.text: Did you hear the Sinkhole was filled with civilians?

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTKONTOS_57719
lines.text: Yeah, Patterned to hell and back.

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTGREEN_57720
lines.text: A grim way to go.

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTKONTOS_57721
lines.text: Lw Laundromat Agent Kontos

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTGREEN_57722
lines.text: Falling asleep in a field of flowers, listening to bird song, the sun shining on your face.

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTKONTOS_57723
lines.text: Wow, you just had that right in the chamber?

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTGREEN_57724
lines.text: Lw Laundromat Agent Green

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTKONTOS_57725
lines.text: Lw Laundromat Agent Kontos

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTGREEN_57726
lines.text: Yeah. That sounds pretty good.

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTKONTOS_57727
lines.text: Of course, in our line of work...

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTGREEN_57728
lines.text: Lw Laundromat Agent Green

lines.speaker: LWLAUNDROMATAGENTKONTOS_57729
lines.text: Yeeep.

lines.speaker: ZOE_6399
lines.text: I'm in the Watchtower.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18782
lines.text: How do I find you?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18783
lines.text: Hear the music? You'll find me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_6446
lines.text: Dylan, I need you to know: As your handler, I'm responsible for you. You step out of line, I lose my career.

options.text: Why did you fight for me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18929
lines.text: Why did you take that risk for me?

lines.speaker: ZOE_18930
lines.text: Because I saw what you're capable of. The FBC needs all the help we can get right now. Can't afford to be picky.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18933
lines.text: Thank you for taking a chance on me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18934
lines.text: I don't need a "thank you". You're the best tool for the job. That's it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18935
lines.text: If I step out of line, I'll be locked in a containment cell for the rest of my life. Between the two of us, I have a lot more to lose.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18936
lines.text: Good reason to stay in line then.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18940
lines.text: So don't screw it up, okay?

options.text: Why did you fight for me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18942
lines.text: Zoe, there's a dead Ranger down here.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18943
lines.text: Ah, shit. Got a few MIAs, but I was hoping for good news. I'll call it in. Thanks.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18951
lines.text: Zoe, more dead Rangers.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18950
lines.text: Zoe, I found a group of dead Rangers.

lines.speaker: ZOE_18954
lines.text: Fuck. Dylan, any Rangers on that supply route would have been armed to the teeth. Keep your head up.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_3432
lines.text: Hello, Fra? Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_3568
lines.text: Shepard. Hello! Yes, be ready.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20502
lines.text: I've got some good news. Your Director's Office is ready. You can move in right away.

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_20503
lines.text: Ooh, my plate and all. Curtain rod.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_20567
lines.text: Okay, now I just need to go back to the container and shut the door.

lines.speaker: ZOE_20568
lines.text: Let's hope this works.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31075
lines.text: So you're heading to the office now, right?

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_31077
lines.text: Yes, yes! You are petite and snail, Shepard.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31078
lines.text: Glad to hear it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31080
lines.text: You're not going to understand this, but I'm sorry, Fra.

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_31081
lines.text: Where? You're a sticky champ, Shepard.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12121
lines.text: Hey Zoe, I just got frozen by a camera, along with everything around me -- and then it... I don't know, jumped away.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12129
lines.text: Found some photos too, taken from around the city. Maybe they're related?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49103
lines.text: Frozen like those Hiss you found in the West Incursion Zone?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49107
lines.text: Not exactly.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49105
lines.text: Found a photo, too, taken from somewhere in the city. Maybe they're related?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49108
lines.text: Frozen like... in a block of ice?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49112
lines.text: Too traumatizing to talk about, huh?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49116
lines.text: No. I mean I couldn't move. Not even blink. Like I... was in a photograph.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49115
lines.text: You know, you get yourself into a lot of trouble, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49118
lines.text: Isn't that the job?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49117
lines.text: If you're doing it wrong.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49119
lines.text: Yes. I was a popsicle a second ago, but now I'm fine and talking to you.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49120
lines.text: Okay, have fun catching it. Bye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49121
lines.text: You asked.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49123
lines.text: Okay, so you found an Altered Item. Maybe you just need to... sneak up on it? Worth a try.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12133
lines.text: I think I stopped the Altered camera. The scene unfroze.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49124
lines.text: Did you get it contained?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49125
lines.text: No. It disappeared again. But I don't think it's coming back this time. At least not here...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12136
lines.text: Hey Zoe, I'm pretty sure I found an Altered Item. A camera. It had frozen everything in its view, kind of like... In a photograph.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49126
lines.text: Did you contain it?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49127
lines.text: I got the scene to unfreeze, but no... The camera disappeared.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12141
lines.text: I might go ask Langston about it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12143
lines.text: I found some photos, taken from around the city. Maybe they're related?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49128
lines.text: Try asking Langston. He's in the Field Panopticon.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49130
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12193
lines.text: Zoe, I've been chasing this camera all over town, but it just keeps escaping and then reappearing somewhere else.

lines.speaker: ZOE_12195
lines.text: Do you think there's a bunch of them, or... just one that exists in all those places at once?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49153
lines.text: You're unfreezing scenes, right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12194
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: ZOE_12196
lines.text: And the camera's not returning to where you caught it? So you're making progress. Keep at it.

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICOAKLEY_58133
lines.text: Lw Fow Mechanic Oakley

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICCLUSKY_58134
lines.text: Not me. I always knew this could happen. And now that it did, we were ready.

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICOAKLEY_58135
lines.text: Pretty lucky.

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICCLUSKY_58136
lines.text: Lw Fow Mechanic Clusky

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICCLUSKY_58137
lines.text: Makes me proud, man.

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICOAKLEY_58138
lines.text: So... what do you think? Are we good?

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICCLUSKY_58139
lines.text: You tell me. The walls are holding, the zones are doing their job...

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICOAKLEY_58140
lines.text: So far.

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICCLUSKY_58141
lines.text: You getting pessimistic on me?

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICOAKLEY_58142
lines.text: Lw Fow Mechanic Oakley

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICCLUSKY_58143
lines.text: You and me both, pal.

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICOAKLEY_58144
lines.text: Lw Fow Mechanic Oakley

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICCLUSKY_58145
lines.text: Just thinking about logistics. Which walls to take down first, how to stagger the work...

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICOAKLEY_58146
lines.text: Lw Fow Mechanic Oakley

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICCLUSKY_58147
lines.text: Lw Fow Mechanic Clusky

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICOAKLEY_58148
lines.text: Lw Fow Mechanic Oakley

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICCLUSKY_58149
lines.text: Never say never.

lines.speaker: LWFOWMECHANICOAKLEY_58150
lines.text: Lw Fow Mechanic Oakley

lines.speaker: ZOE_49407
lines.text: Huh...

lines.speaker: ZOE_49408
lines.text: Damn.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49409
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49410
lines.text: Right...

lines.speaker: ZOE_49411
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ZOE_49412
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: ZOE_49413
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ZOE_49414
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: ZOE_49415
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: ZOE_49416
lines.text: <sighing>

lines.speaker: ZOE_49417
lines.text: <frustrated noise>

lines.speaker: ZOE_49418
lines.text: You know I can hear you, right?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49419
lines.text: You're just gonna stand there, Dylan?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49420
lines.text: You must have something better to do than hang out with me, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_34373
lines.text: That explains why they're barely paying me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_34372
lines.text: If that explains it, I need to figure out who's writing lies about me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_34605
lines.text: Hey, Dylan, don't forget: Arish wants to talk to you in the Central Field Office. He's in the tower lobby.

lines.speaker: ZOE_34606
lines.text: Don't we have a CFD to build? Let's not add "procrastinator" to the list of reasons Arish hates you.

lines.speaker: ZOE_34607
lines.text: Dylan, hey, I forgot to tell you: FBC's sent out mapping equipment to every zone via balloon. But they need some setup to work. If you see one, take care of it. It'll give us data that's gonna make your job a lot easier. Well, a little easier.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_34608
lines.text: Hey, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_34609
lines.text: Dylan, you're gonna get me into trouble with the new sole Acting FBC Director if you keep talking to me when she's waiting to see you. Go talk to Pope about her research team, okay?

lines.speaker: ZOE_34610
lines.text: Dylan, I meant to tell you: We finally managed to get a recovery team into the West Incursion Zone to pick up your partygoers. They're a little shaken up, but they'll be okay. Physically, at least... Good work.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_34611
lines.text: Hi, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_34612
lines.text: Dylan, I'd love to chat, but I have a lot of work to do and so do you. How about we talk while you work, yeah? Come back another time.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_34613
lines.text: Hey, Zoe?

lines.speaker: ZOE_34614
lines.text: Remember, you have very limited break time. You really wanna spend it all talking to me? You know what, don't answer that -- I have other things to do, okay? Come back later.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_34615
lines.text: Zoe?

lines.speaker: ZOE_34616
lines.text: Sorry, Dylan, I can't chat now.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_34617
lines.text: Hey, uh, Zoe?

lines.speaker: ZOE_34618
lines.text: I'm slammed with work, Dylan. We'll talk more later, all right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_34619
lines.text: Hey, Zoe.

lines.speaker: ZOE_34620
lines.text: Heya.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_34621
lines.text: Zoe?

lines.speaker: ZOE_34622
lines.text: Yes, break time is over. That's right. Come back when you've done some more work.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_34623

lines.text: So the incidence of Altered items in Manhattan is... Huh. But we know they can form in AWEs, but that doesn't explain the number...

lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: OLDESTHOUSELOBBYRESEARCHER_64703
lines.text: Oh... I just keep thinking... If the Barrier ever fails... The Hiss and Patterning could get out...

lines.speaker: OLDESTHOUSELOBBYRESEARCHER_64701
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: POPE_64700
lines.text: And the barrier is made up of Pattern Resonance. We can hope it's geographically contained to our location, but if so it's... It's only by its own nature, or... potentially, choice.

lines.speaker: OLDESTHOUSELOBBYRESEARCHER_64699
lines.text: Oh yeah... I guess you're right.

lines.speaker: OLDESTHOUSELOBBYRESEARCHER_64698
lines.text: Uh, Pope? Did you get a chance to check out my PTO request? I know the city's, well... how it is. But, I could still use some time off. I'll just spend it in the Field Office cafeteria, maybe.

lines.speaker: POPE_64697
lines.text: Ah, oh, right. Uh... Uh... No, not yet. I'm... I'm... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: OLDESTHOUSELOBBYRESEARCHER_64696
lines.text: No, that's okay, that's fine. I'll remind you later.

lines.speaker: OLDESTHOUSELOBBYRESEARCHER_64695
lines.text: Should we categorize hostile Pattern formations by main presenting Patterned material, or object? Like, if it's a light pole, do we file it under "Light Pole" or "steel" or, umm...

lines.speaker: POPE_64694
lines.text: Well they're not Altered Items, so unless we later discover the object involved somehow impacts behavior or paranatural presentation, it doesn't matter. Neither does the material, actually. What really differentiates them from one another are their duplicating, Patterned movements -- all unique manifestations, but likely each a piece of the larger Pattern whole.

lines.speaker: OLDESTHOUSELOBBYRESEARCHER_64693
lines.text: Oh yeah, that makes sense. Let's do that.

lines.text: Hey, Pope? I think... I looked at the Hedron too long, and it... It got into my head... What if, what if I become a Resonant Entity?

lines.speaker: POPE_64688

lines.speaker: POPE_64687
lines.text: We need to focus.

lines.speaker: POPE_64686
lines.text: No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no. No... These, These numbers can't be right.

lines.speaker: POPE_64684

lines.speaker: OLDESTHOUSELOBBYRESEARCHER_64683
lines.text: That's not the saying.

lines.speaker: POPE_64682

lines.speaker: POPE_64681

lines.speaker: OLDESTHOUSELOBBYRESEARCHER_64680

lines.text: Fantastic, thank you.

lines.text: What can we learn from the failed attempt at evacuating Manhattan?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57306
lines.text: Other than that it was obviously doomed from the start?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57307
lines.text: Besides that. I believe there were very early signs of the approaching AWE, weeks in advance of when they were first noticed. Had we identified them sooner, we might have succeeded.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57308
lines.text: So the question is - how to detect minute but critical early warning signs in the future.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57309

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57310
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57312
lines.text: Pro: the Hiss are sealed inside. Con: so are we.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57313
lines.text: Another pro: the Patterning likely affects only the inside. Con: it might be amplified by its spatial restrictions -- reverberating, multiplying exponentially.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57314

lines.text: Lw Map Ranger Pham

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57464
lines.text: Hey, you think that Threshold that chopped off all those heads is still a threat?

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57465
lines.text: Lw Map Ranger Garcia

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57466
lines.text: Yeah, we can never really be sure, can we?

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57467
lines.text: I guess any more bodies with missing heads will be the tip-off.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57468
lines.text: If you ask me, if we wanna make sure no more people lose their heads, we should blow up the whole Threshold site.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57469
lines.text: Is that your answer to everything, explosives?

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57470
lines.text: Lw Map Ranger Garcia

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57471
lines.text: Lw Map Ranger Garcia

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57472
lines.text: Lw Map Ranger Pham

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57473
lines.text: Nothing wrong with survivalism. I do take offense to the guy stealing our gear, though.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57474
lines.text: Yeah, we gotta beef up the security on our warehouses. Somebody just walks away with our land mines and blows up our people?

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57475
lines.text: Fucking embarrassing.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57476
lines.text: Lw Map Ranger Pham

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57477
lines.text: Lw Map Ranger Garcia

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57478
lines.text: Lw Map Ranger Pham

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57479
lines.text: Lw Map Ranger Garcia

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57480
lines.text: Rogers said he bumped into someone dressed in old FBC gear. Old old, like from the original manuals.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57481
lines.text: Are we running out of uniforms?

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57482
lines.text: Lw Map Ranger Garcia

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57483
lines.text: Huh. Interesting. Fishy.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57484
lines.text: Are you thinking - a mole?

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57485
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57316
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57317
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57318
lines.text: It does have many characteristics of a self-amplifying system. I can only assume the concentration will either continue to escalate until it reaches a culmination point or, conversely, that it eventually runs out of energy and burns out.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57319
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57325
lines.text: A shame about Clarke and Ryder. I believe they were decent people. Hard-working. But... I suppose they knew the risks.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57326
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57327
lines.text: Uh-huh. Well.. our predecessors have researched that to the best of their ability back in the day. So we have a starting point for further study, if needed.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57328
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57329
lines.text: Never mind.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57330
lines.text: The crew noted some interesting findings down in the subway tunnels. Apparently, the Mold is now interacting favorably with electricity.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57331
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57332
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57333
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57334
lines.text: So the Patterning is reaching downward, underground. What do we make of that?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57335
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57336
lines.text: Unexposed to open air. Closer to groundwater?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57337
lines.text: Closer to continental drift energies?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57338
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57339
lines.text: Could the Sinkhole be just the first of many? Is the Patterning aiming to create more of them?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57340
lines.text: As in... a network? A means of getting around faster? Or aiming to amplify through interconnectedness?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57341
lines.text: Building from the ground up?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57342
lines.text: Or the other way around, rather. Hmm.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57343
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57344
lines.text: What else could they do? It was either that or the Hiss destroying us all.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57345
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57346
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57347
lines.text: I guess you were right about the Hiss. They reached a culmination point. Though being proven right on a theory is not as important as preventing catastrophe.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57348
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57349
lines.text: We should consider the likely consequences of the CFD... event.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57350
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57351
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57352
lines.text: Better. Anyway, I think the consequences will reveal themselves to us, whether we like it or not.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57353
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57354
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57355
lines.text: Is the fact that it took place underground relevant, do you think?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57356
lines.text: Could be, could be. There are so many fantastic avenues to go down! For instance, the different consciousnesses that exist in all of the temporal variations simultaneously... they are able to observe themselves, but are they a part of a greater whole, or wholly independent manifestations of the self?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57357
lines.text: Huh. Beats me.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57358
lines.text: What feels crucial to me about the Underpass excursion is this: could there have been a way out of the spacetime anomaly the research team was stuck in?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57359
lines.text: Or were they just caught in a pre-determined chain of events the moment they stepped foot in the affected area?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57360
lines.text: I think the latter is a more merciful concept.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57361
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57362
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57363
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57364
lines.text: Your words, not mine.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57365
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57366
lines.text: Yes, obviously the Patterning frequency is a Hedron resonance. It counteracts the Hiss... and reshapes the world.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57367
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57368
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57369
lines.text: The links the Hedron is trying to form with the Earth - what is their purpose? Their mechanism? A funnel of energy, boosting it? Or just a tether, tying the Hedron to our dimension?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57370
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57371
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57372
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57373
lines.text: The Oldest House is a Place of Power. A nexus point of ley lines and paranatural energies. And it has housed a Hedron in the past. Is it any wonder this one would be drawn to it?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57374
lines.text: Do you think the House will hold?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57375
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57403
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57404
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57405
lines.text: Given that apparently the structural integrity of the entire building was -- or is -- depending on it... yes. Something a little off about this one.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57406
lines.text: I concur.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57407
lines.text: The Camera is another interesting Altered Item. Langston must be thrilled.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57408
lines.text: The folks captured by it were less than thrilled, I hear.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57409
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57410
lines.text: That would require active testing.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57411
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57398
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57399
lines.text: I would prefer to not be brainwashed myself.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57400
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57401
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57402
lines.text: Well, not quite that. That would be too silly.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57394
lines.text: What do you make of this Fra Mauro fellow? Are we pleased with how we dealt with him? Is he?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57395
lines.text: We should prepare for the eventuality that he finds his way out of containment again.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57396
lines.text: Hmm. I doubt we have the bandwidth for it now, but after this AWE has been dealt with, we should develop more robust containment procedures.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57397
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57389
lines.text: I wonder... could we draw any parallels between the Speaker Items and the Karaoke Machine? They have some basic similarities.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57390
lines.text: As in, they share a functionality based on auditive influence?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57391
lines.text: Yes, and while their effects differ, they could be grouped in the same subcategory of Altered Items. Of course, interaction with them does produce vastly different consequences...

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57392
lines.text: I think that would be the correct categorizing method. We can cross-reference, too, of course.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57393
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57387
lines.text: We of course have seen people be host bodies to a number of entities before, too. But these speakers are interesting in that the speaker item seemed to both possess a host body and subsume a human consciousness.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57388
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Markson

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57376
lines.text: Apparently Padmore and Leckie overheard Langston talking to himself about his, uhm, pet. According to him, quite the Hiss-killer.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57377
lines.text: Those two say a lot of things.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57378
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57379
lines.text: I guess. Could be a third kind altogether. Camouflaging itself as a harmless domesticated animal?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57380
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Caldwell

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57381
lines.text: Come on. You know Padmore and Leckie are full of shit.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57486
lines.text: Any ideas?

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57487
lines.text: Nah.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57488
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57489
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57490
lines.text: I wonder if... Hmm. No.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57491
lines.text: What about... Um...

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57492
lines.text: Need a think.

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERPHAM_57493
lines.text: What are we even looking at here?

lines.speaker: LWMAPRANGERGARCIA_57494
lines.text: Hmm. Maybe if we-- No...

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57320
lines.text: What do you make of the Resonant Entity? Quite the combination of both known and unknown factors, resulting in a, in a...

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57321
lines.text: A horrific abomination?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57322
lines.text: I suppose that is the strictly human point of view. But in terms of physics, what an exciting prospect - possibly a power transfer process caused by the Patterning colliding with an element vibrating on the same frequency...

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57323
lines.text: Or an abrupt and violent mutation suffered by an unlucky citizen.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57324
lines.text: Well, both can be true.

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57495
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57496
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57497
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57498
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57499
lines.text: You know, I... Before the Lockdown failed, I... lost someone close to me.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57500
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57501
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57502
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57503
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57504
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57505
lines.text: I have to try. There has to be a way.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57506
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57507
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57508
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57509
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57510
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57511
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57512
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57513
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57514
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57515
lines.text: So what chance does my boyfriend have?

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57516
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57517
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57518
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57519
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57520
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57521
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMILLER_57522
lines.text: Lw Oh Scientist Miller

lines.speaker: LWOHRANGERCONNOR_57523
lines.text: Lw Oh Ranger Connor

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58263
lines.text: Hey, any news from Arish?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58264
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58265
lines.text: I knew that mission was a bad idea.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58266
lines.text: It was obviously a bad idea. But he insisted. He wanted to go.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58267
lines.text: We made it through seven years of hell... and now we lose him?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58268
lines.text: I have to say, Dylan Faden is not the guy I expected to save Arish.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58269
lines.text: No shit. Wild.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58270
lines.text: All that Hiss at the Evac Site, though...

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58271
lines.text: The Hiss and Faden do tend to pop up together, huh?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58273
lines.text: That weapon Arish is having them build, the CFD? Thoughts?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58274
lines.text: Well... I admit that weaponizing a Resonant corpse is pretty out there. But... kind of awesome too.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58275
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Springburn

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58276
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58277
lines.text: Jesus, what a mess.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58278
lines.text: Well, it kind of worked, right? I mean, maybe--

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58279
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Springburn

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58280
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58281
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Springburn

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58282
lines.text: Know much about the new Head of Security and Operations? Ruboneka, was it?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58283
lines.text: I think I had lunch with him once...

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58284
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58285
lines.text: What the hell else was he going to do, twiddle his thumbs while the world burns?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58286
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58287
lines.text: We really need Director Faden back.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58288
lines.text: Ahh, hell. Arish.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58289
lines.text: He was a good guy.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58290
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Springburn

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58291
lines.text: Feels kind of crazy to do this without Arish. He was a rock.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58292
lines.text: Yeah. So, what do you think of Ruboneka, after chatting with him a bit?

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58293
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58294
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Springburn

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58295
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERSPRINGBURN_58296
lines.text: Still, I guess... neither was Arish, before he was.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58297
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: LWFOTRANGERBERNIER_58272
lines.text: Lw Fot Ranger Bernier

lines.speaker: LWROADWORKERSTONE_57614
lines.text: Hey, you! Wrong way.

lines.speaker: LWROADWORKERMCKENNA_57615
lines.text: Lw Road Worker Mckenna

lines.speaker: LWROADWORKERSTONE_57616
lines.text: Lw Road Worker Stone

lines.speaker: LWROADWORKERSTONE_57617
lines.text: Can you believe this guy?

lines.speaker: LWROADWORKERMCKENNA_57618
lines.text: We got stuck with the shit job. That Black Rock is heavy.

lines.speaker: LWROADWORKERSTONE_57619
lines.text: Lw Road Worker Stone

lines.speaker: LWROADWORKERMCKENNA_57620
lines.text: Lw Road Worker Mckenna

lines.speaker: LWROADWORKERSTONE_57621
lines.text: At least we got out of the Oldest House! Finally.

lines.speaker: LWROADWORKERSTONE_57622
lines.text: Lw Road Worker Stone

lines.speaker: LWROADWORKERMCKENNA_57623
lines.text: Yeah, you gotta love New York in autumn.

lines.text: LW AGENT SCRIVER

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57604
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57605
lines.text: The gravity anomaly!

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57606
lines.text: Depends on who you ask.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57607
lines.text: LW AGENT SCRIVER

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57608
lines.text: LW AGENT MUIR

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57609
lines.text: LW AGENT SCRIVER

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57610
lines.text: How much longer are you going to be staring at this... gravitational thing?

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57611
lines.text: LW AGENT SCRIVER

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57612
lines.text: It was over hours ago.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57613
lines.text: LW AGENT SCRIVER

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_58211
lines.text: LW AGENT MUIR

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_58212
lines.text: LW AGENT SCRIVER

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_58213
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_58214
lines.text: Sometimes I think you have no capacity for sense of wonder in your heart.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_58215
lines.text: Sounds about right.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_58216
lines.text: Nonsense. You have a better heart than that.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_58217
lines.text: ...thanks?

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57730
lines.text: Would you look at that.

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57731
lines.text: LW AGENT MUIR

lines.speaker: LWAGENTSCRIVER_57732
lines.text: LW AGENT SCRIVER

lines.speaker: LWAGENTMUIR_57736
lines.text: It is pretty impressive.

lines.text: There you go.

lines.text: Lw Checkpoint Ranger Frost

lines.speaker: LWCHECKPOINTRANGERHIGGINS_57654
lines.text: Okay, pay up, then.

lines.text: Lw Checkpoint Ranger Frost

lines.speaker: LWCHECKPOINTRANGERHIGGINS_57656
lines.text: Lw Checkpoint Ranger Higgins

lines.speaker: LWCHECKPOINTRANGERFROST_57657
lines.text: Lw Checkpoint Ranger Frost

lines.speaker: LWCHECKPOINTRANGERHIGGINS_57649
lines.text: Lw Checkpoint Ranger Higgins

lines.speaker: LWCHECKPOINTRANGERFROST_57650
lines.text: Lw Checkpoint Ranger Frost

lines.speaker: LWCHECKPOINTRANGERHIGGINS_57651
lines.text: You saw what the CFD did to the Hiss out there. Close enough.

lines.speaker: LWCHECKPOINTRANGERFROST_57652

lines.speaker: POPE_16230
lines.text: Look, I'm sorry, Dylan, but we had to test it. Protocol. Your file shows that Doctor Darling had you wearing this years ago during your Prime Candidate training. You're familiar with how it works?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16233
lines.text: When the MCD is activated, it first incapacitates the wearer. Activated long enough, it kills them.

lines.speaker: POPE_16234
lines.text: After fifteen seconds to be precise -- well, depending of course on output calibrations and factors relating to the subject  -- in this case, you.

lines.speaker: POPE_16235
lines.text: Sorry, you probably didn't want all the details. Your sister says I'm always doing that. Oh, I... I haven't introduced myself. I'm Emily Pope, Head of Research. Well, technically Acting Co-Director with Simon Arish now that Jesse's...

lines.speaker: POPE_60564

options.text: Jesse always knows what to do

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16239
lines.text: I saw her. It's bad, but she'll be okay. Even when we were kids, no matter how bad it got... She always knew what to do.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17606

lines.speaker: POPE_16243
lines.text: No, you're right, of course. I guess she hasn't changed much.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16240

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17607

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60565

lines.speaker: POPE_16245
lines.text: In situations like this, I find it helps to... To focus on what's in front of you. Work. Research. Data.

lines.speaker: POPE_17608
lines.text: Jesse will be back. We just have to hold down the fort.

options.text: How well do you know Jesse?
Do you know why she left?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16253
lines.text: How well do you know my sister?

lines.speaker: POPE_16258
lines.text: Better than most. We've worked together closely over the past seven years. Since the... The first day of the lockdown. Jesse is-- Well she's-- She's a great director.

lines.speaker: POPE_16331
lines.text: Look, I think she knew something was going to happen. See, in the past few months, Jesse was pushing to accelerate our research into methods of protection against the Hiss. Or alternatives for HRAs. See, she must have known she'd eventually have to leave.

lines.speaker: POPE_16332
lines.text: But unfortunately, we ran out of time. And we've had to fall back on an old idea of mine I'd abandoned due to some unreliability issues: The Black Rock Injectors.

lines.speaker: POPE_16333
lines.text: They don't provide consistent coverage against Hiss corruption, but well they're better than nothing. Lucky for us, the Hiss is spreading less efficiently. So with the injectors, we... We stand a chance. Which is a good thing, in theory.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16273
lines.text: Do you know why she left? Did she say anything to you?

lines.speaker: POPE_16272
lines.text: All she told me was that she had a bad feeling, but couldn't place it. Jesse's been... Distracted. Not herself. Darling was the same way, before he disappeared.

options.text: As long as I can kill them

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16336
lines.text: Why only in theory?

lines.speaker: POPE_16340
lines.text: Because we have no way of knowing what it will do next. Unprecedented means unpredictable. At least until we collect a robust dataset.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16338
lines.text: As long as the Hiss can still be killed.

lines.speaker: POPE_16344
lines.text: Something we learned over seven years with the Hiss: Individual Hiss can be killed, but silencing a resonance is another task entirely.

options.text: What do you need from me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16345
lines.text: So what do you need from me?

lines.speaker: POPE_16347
lines.text: Sorry, I get carried away. Everything that's happening is just so... Fascinating. And terrifying. But fascinating too.

lines.speaker: POPE_16348
lines.text: We need your help fighting the Hiss, of course. But that Patterning-related creature that you fought -- which we've classified as a "Resonant Entity" -- well, we believe there are more of them.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16351
lines.text: That... Pattern... Creature. The one I fought--

lines.speaker: POPE_17613
lines.text: We've classified them as "Resonant Entities", until we can find a more specific term.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17614
lines.text: Right, the Resonant Entity. I saw it kill Hiss.

lines.speaker: POPE_17615
lines.text: Yes. Agent de Vera reported the same thing. It's, it's incredible. I mean, this could be the key to finding a real weapon against the Hiss.

lines.speaker: POPE_17616
lines.text: But right now, the Patterning is a threat in and of itself. We believe there are more Resonant Entities out there.

options.text: You want me to fight them

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16356
lines.text: You want me to fight them.

lines.speaker: POPE_16355
lines.text: Well, yes. But beyond that, I need more data.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16358
lines.text: She was a human before, wasn't she? The Resonant Entity?

lines.speaker: POPE_17617
lines.text: We believe so. But we don't yet understand the implications. We need more data.

lines.speaker: POPE_16361
lines.text: Now, I've modified your MCD to include a resonance meter of sorts. Fight another Resonant Entity, and it will transmit invaluable data back to me.

lines.speaker: POPE_60593
lines.text: Now my theory is that where there's patterning, there's likely a Resonant. I'd search the West Incursion Zone first, you'll see what I mean.

lines.speaker: POPE_16363
lines.text: Look, I'm sure wearing the MCD brings back bad memories. But given the situation, protocol is all we have, and protocol dictates that you wear it any time you're outside of your cell. So we might as well use it, right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16367
lines.text: Hey, I just wanted to say... I'm sorry... If anyone you cared about died because of me.

lines.speaker: POPE_16366
lines.text: I wasn't really close to any of my coworkers back then. But we lost a lot of lives that day. Dylan, Jesse was convinced that you're a good person. But keep in mind that not everyone in the Bureau agrees.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_16369
lines.text: If there's nothing else.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60594
lines.text: I'll get to work.

lines.speaker: POPE_16368
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: POPE_16412
lines.text: For whatever reason, it seems you're resistant to the Hiss, Dylan. Jesse cleansing you of Hiss corruption seven years ago may have inoculated you against them. Now Agent de Vera thinks you're the best option we have, and I agree.

lines.speaker: POPE_17619
lines.text: So she'll be your handler.

lines.speaker: POPE_60595
lines.text: I want to be clear:

lines.speaker: POPE_60596
lines.text: De Vera is authorized to activate your Mobile Containment Device if she deems necessary.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17620
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: POPE_17640
lines.text: Report to Agent de Vera in the Watchtower. Follow the signs.

lines.speaker: POPE_16410
lines.text: Dylan.

lines.speaker: POPE_60597
lines.text: Arish was against your release... But I don't know what else to do.

lines.speaker: POPE_60598
lines.text: Prove him wrong.

lines.speaker: POPE_17611
lines.text: But we have a new problem. Two days before the lockdown fell, an uncategorized resonance appeared in Manhattan. Now this creature you killed, the refractive patterning in the city, the chasm that separated us from the outside world -- See, I believe they're all connected to the same phenomenon.

lines.speaker: POPE_17612
lines.text: Now this... Patterning might also be the reason the Hiss are changing. See, Hiss resonance used to expand to fill all available space, corrupting every unprotected organism it could find. But now it's spreading well, incompletely. Unevenly. But the causality is impossible to confirm. At least yet.

lines.text: To reach me at the Watchtower, you gotta go through the Central Checkpoint. But Hiss keeps knocking out the power, which means we're cut off. And the engineer assigned to fix it had a disagreement with his Ranger.

lines.speaker: ZOE_70874

lines.speaker: ZOE_70873
lines.text: Difficult to work with.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_69637

lines.text: I'm not sure I can--

lines.speaker: ZOE_69646

lines.speaker: DYLAN_70887
lines.text: Actually, I did find some instructions, but--

lines.speaker: ZOE_69649
lines.text: I'm sure you'll figure it out.

lines.speaker: ZOE_69682
lines.text: Dammit. We'll send someone out for the body. But for now -- finish the job.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_69684
lines.text: He didn't want me guarding him, Zoe. He--

lines.speaker: ZOE_69683
lines.text: It's not your fault he did something stupid.

lines.speaker: ZOE_69688
lines.text: What? He was supposed to wait for you at the--

lines.speaker: ZOE_69687
lines.text: Okay. We'll send someone for the body, but it looks like you're on your own. Finish the job.

lines.speaker: ZOE_69694
lines.text: Okay, power is up and--

lines.speaker: ZOE_69693
lines.text: Not again.

lines.speaker: ZOE_69697
lines.text: Dylan? If you're still alive, I'll meet you on the other side of the checkpoint.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17778
lines.text: Pope?

lines.speaker: POPE_17779
lines.text: After you disrupted the Hedron's link to the Oldest House, it began stabilizing independently. And much faster than we anticipated. See we've never seen a Place of Power get damaged in this way before. Certainly not to this extent. Its recovery is... Well it's, it's, incredible. But we don't know if it will ever be the same again.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17780
lines.text: So... It's safe?

lines.speaker: POPE_17781
lines.text: I canceled the evacuation. Everyone can return to work. Of course, with the Hedron now in our dimension, our situation is, well, precarious.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17783
lines.text: It's hard to believe it's a Hedron.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_70733
lines.text: I grew up thinking they were... Friendly. Even Darling thought they wanted to protect us.

lines.speaker: POPE_17782
lines.text: You're looking at this the wrong way. I don't think we mean anything to it. See paranatural entities don't adhere to human emotions or relationship dynamics. We can't assume they are remotely similar to us in any way.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17785
lines.text: I hurt it once. I can do it again.

lines.speaker: POPE_17784
lines.text: It'll take time before we understand the science behind what you accomplished. But yes you're right: You did hurt it. Well, at least, we can hypothesize as much. The readings we're getting have changed. A break in the resonance waveform. Small, but not insignificant. And lasting. I mean this could change everything we think we know about paranatural resonance. Way beyond the Hedron. But no... Let's, let's not get ahead of ourselves.

lines.speaker: POPE_17788
lines.text: The Hedron is here to destroy the Hiss. We have documented evidence of a large-scale conflict between these two forces. Slidescape-36 may have just been one of many dimensions consumed by their war.

lines.speaker: POPE_70857
lines.text: We're just collateral.

options.text: Why didn't we recognize it sooner?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17790
lines.text: How is it that we didn't recognize the Hedron resonance in the Patterning before?

lines.speaker: POPE_17789
lines.text: The waveform is incredibly complex. We didn't even have data precise enough to see the similarities until--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17791
lines.text: Grist.

lines.speaker: POPE_17792
lines.text: Yes. And even with Grist's research, it still wasn't obvious. But I did find something in the data. A single thread amongst thousands. Like a...

lines.speaker: POPE_70734
lines.text: A fingerprint. Unique, but almost the same.

lines.speaker: POPE_70735
lines.text: Except we thought the last Hedron died in the Oldest House. And the only source of that type of resonance that I knew of is...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17793
lines.text: You thought it was Jesse. You thought she was the cause of all of this.

lines.speaker: POPE_19172
lines.text: Obviously, I'm relieved to be wrong.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17794
lines.text: Can it be killed?

lines.speaker: POPE_17795
lines.text: In theory, yes. I mean, we know the Hedron can die. But killing one is another task entirely. If you're asking my opinion, well... Before joining the FBC, I thought reality is governed by immovable laws of physics. But as you know, that's bullshit, of course. See, the funny thing is that whenever a new scientific theory is proven, it often disproves a previously established "truth" that was accepted for years, decades even. The point is, anything is possible.

lines.speaker: POPE_19238
lines.text: But Dylan, I need to ask you about Jesse. Do you think she...

lines.speaker: POPE_17803
lines.text: The Hedron wouldn't be here unless something happened to Jesse. Right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17797
lines.text: Why didn't you say anything?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_70736
lines.text: You should have told me.

lines.speaker: POPE_17796
lines.text: It wouldn't have made a difference in our approach. Knowing the Patterning might be caused by Hedron resonance doesn't help us when we don't know how to stop Hedron resonance.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17798
lines.text: You still should have told me.

lines.speaker: POPE_17800
lines.text: I didn't want to doubt Jesse, not until I was absolutely sure. Look, while we're on this subject. Do you think she...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17802
lines.text: How could you think Jesse was behind the Patterning?

lines.speaker: POPE_17801
lines.text: I didn't think she was doing it on purpose. But it wouldn't be the first time a Director has lost control of their powers. Look, while we're on the subject. Do you think she's...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17805
lines.text: Last time I saw her...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_70737
lines.text: It didn't look good.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_70738
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: POPE_17806
lines.text: No, no. Jesse is strong. She... She's come back from worse.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17807
lines.text: Has she?

lines.speaker: POPE_17809
lines.text: Well, there was the-- Look that's not the point, Dylan. She never gave up on you. Don't give up on her.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17812
lines.text: It doesn't matter. This can't be the end.

lines.speaker: POPE_17811
lines.text: I agree. Jesse has an affinity with the Hedron. That's possible that could offer some amount of protection. And you know, we can't jump to conclusions one way or the other. Trust your sister to survive impossible odds. She's the strongest Director we've ever had and certainly the most stubborn. No, she can't be dead.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17814
lines.text: She isn't.

options.text: She means a lot to you

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17816
lines.text: Jesse means a lot to you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_70739
lines.text: Doesn't she?

lines.speaker: POPE_17815
lines.text: I care about your sister very, very much. And we can't let her down.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17819
lines.text: You're still Acting Director, at least for now. Are you up for it?

lines.speaker: POPE_17818
lines.text: Jesse didn't have a choice. Neither do I.

lines.speaker: POPE_17821
lines.text: Now, readings indicate the Hedron has tethered itself to our world. Disrupting these links seems to damage the Hedron. As things stand right now, Dylan, you're our only shot at survival. There's a lot of shitty things in the world, but it's worth protecting.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17820
lines.text: I can do it. I'll sever the Hedron's links to our dimension. And then I'm gonna kill it.

lines.speaker: POPE_17822
lines.text: You'll have the FBC's full support going forward. Anything and everything you need. Now, I'm sending some research balloons up to better understand the Patterning going on above us. Next time you head up the elevator, find a balloon and I'll get in touch. I may be able to help.

options.text: I won't be a prisoner anymore

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17823
lines.text: Thank you... For trusting me.

lines.speaker: POPE_17824
lines.text: You deserved better from the FBC, Dylan. From all of us.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17825
lines.text: When this is over, I'm not going back to being a prisoner.

lines.speaker: POPE_17827
lines.text: No. No, of course not. Speaking of...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17834
lines.text: Just like that? After everything? It's that easy?

lines.speaker: POPE_17833
lines.text: You saved the Oldest House, Dylan. You've more than proven yourself.

lines.speaker: POPE_17836
lines.text: I think it's time we remove your Mobile Containment Device. We never should have--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_17837
lines.text: No. There's still Hiss inside of me. If I get too close to the Hedron or the links... The Hiss could take over.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_70847
lines.text: It's better we have an insurance policy.

lines.speaker: POPE_17838
lines.text: The Hiss inside of you does seem to react to the Hedron's presence. We'll leave it on if that's what you want.

lines.text: It's kind of pretty, huh? Pope says the barrier's beginning to break down now that the Hedron's dead. No idea how long it will take though.

lines.speaker: ZOE_29339
lines.text: Guess we're stuck with each other for awhile. Speaking of, how's it feel to be an FBC contractor?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29340
lines.text: Well, they re-issued my birth certificate so I'm officially a living person again.

lines.speaker: ZOE_29341
lines.text: So what are you gonna do with all your new found independence?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29344
lines.text: Honestly, I never thought I'd make it this far. I'm still getting used to having a choice.

lines.speaker: ZOE_29343
lines.text: If it makes you feel any better, I don't have it all figured out either.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29342
lines.text: Yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: ZOE_29345
lines.text: Oh, I was trying to commiserate, asshole.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29346
lines.text: The city still needs help. The Hiss, the residual Patterning, the Mold. I'm good at this, so that's as far as I'm planning now.

lines.speaker: ZOE_29350
lines.text: Well the FBC is glad to have the help. I am too. Good to have a partner who's tough to kill.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29349
lines.text: I guess you would know, huh?

lines.speaker: ZOE_29348
lines.text: For the last time, you fucking told me to press the button. And it didn't even work!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29347
lines.text: Well, I've always wanted to travel. If we ever get out of here... I haven't even seen the Statue of Liberty. Can you believe I've lived in New York for 24 years and never even seen it once?

lines.speaker: ZOE_29351
lines.text: I'll add it to the list, right behind your first concert.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29352
lines.text: The list?

lines.speaker: ZOE_29353
lines.text: Ah, don't worry about it. I've got plans.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29355
lines.text: I was kinda hoping you'd help me figure that out.

lines.speaker: ZOE_29354
lines.text: Well, you're a 34-year-old with no credit history, no resume, and a fifth grade education. I think the FBC might be your best bet for now. But, when we get out of here, you could start selling those drawings of yours.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29356
lines.text: You think they're good enough to sell?

lines.speaker: ZOE_29358
lines.text: Never hurts to try.

lines.speaker: ZOE_29357
lines.text: Oh, before I forget, here's your stuff.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29361
lines.text: My stuff?

lines.speaker: ZOE_29360

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29359
lines.text: Oh, wow. My favorite CD's still in it! You were wondering about my taste in music, right?

lines.speaker: ZOE_29362

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_48972
lines.text: This isn't me. I'm... Where's my body? Dead? Who are you?

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_48973
lines.text: The gate... It had to be opened. No, it didn't. Something got out.

options.text: You asked to stop the ritual?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48979
lines.text: There's nothing here. It's over. Whatever it was, it's gone. I promise.

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_48978
lines.text: You opened the gate. Why? Why why why why? You had to.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48981
lines.text: I don't--

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_48980
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48984

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_48983
lines.text: I didn't... I don't... I don't remember. It wasn't me. Because of the gate. You opened the gate! No.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48985
lines.text: Hey, hey. What's your name?

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_48986
lines.text: My... I'm... Daaa-- elsea-- ames-- ecca-- Ame-- ohnathon-- Lee-- issa-- stasia-- I'm... Me. Not me. What?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48987

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_48988
lines.text: This is... Not me. Not mine. Who am I... In? The gate... The gate is open. What did you do? It could get out.

options.text: Is there someone else with you?

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_48990
lines.text: The gate... It could get out. I don't know! I didn't! I had to.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48995
lines.text: Were you in one of the speakers?

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_48996
lines.text: No! I was in my... My body. Where is it? This isn't mine! It's mine!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48997
lines.text: Maybe you just need to get used to being you again?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_48998
lines.text: Is this... thing that could get out... Invisible, maybe? Is it... here, next to me?

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_48999
lines.text: What? No... You're not, you're not... Listen----ing! You opened the gate. Anything -- anything could get out! Everything. Everything. Everything.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49000
lines.text: Is there... someone else with you?

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_49001
lines.text: In here? In me? I was dead... I'm here. I'm here too. Me. My brain. Not mine. There's more of them. Us. So many. What did you do? Give it back!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49002
lines.text: You mean... There's more than one of you in there?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49003
lines.text: The gate? What do you mean? To where? What could get out?

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_49004
lines.text: Everything! Anything. Don't you get it? You had to. No, you didn't. Not worth it. Should have let me die. Them too. What? No!

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_49006
lines.text: I don't wanna be here... Take me out. Put me back! Me too. Why did you do this? This isn't me! Where am I?

options.text: Careful what you tell the FBC

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49010
lines.text: Why did you even do this? You shouldn't have messed with the paranatural...

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_49011

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_49013
lines.text: Never said. How would I know?

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_49014
lines.text: I don't...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49017
lines.text: Just trust me.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49016
lines.text: Hey. Oh, oh. Okay, okay. Calm down. I know people who can help you. At least... They can try.

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_49018

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_49020

lines.speaker: AUCTIONHOUSECIVILIAN_49023

lines.text: The civilian isn't okay, Zoe. I don't know what's wrong with her. This Altered Item... It was messy. Lots of people came to a bad end.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49038
lines.text: I don't know...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49039

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49040

lines.speaker: ZOE_49041

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49042
lines.text: The civilian is dead, Zoe. I lost her.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49130

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12194

lines.speaker: ZOE_12196

I don't know what they were doing there, but I know Grant had project sites all over the place. Find them and put an end to... Whatever it is that went wrong.

lines.text: Listen, this time we're going to try something new. Once the probe relays are set up, they'll emit a signal, a resonance of our own so to speak. lines.text: Dylan? You're at Point 0. The geographical center of the entire cluster. Deploy the probes.
