lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57382
lines.text: I have a theory.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57383
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57384
lines.text: There seems to be a connection between some paranatural entities or items and resonances - in this particular case, musical resonances.

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTCALDWELL_57385
lines.text: You mean the Karaoke Machine Altered Item might not only be using resonances to allow itself to operate, but that it might have been created by them? A symbiotic, or near ouroboric, relationship between the Item and its mode of operation?

lines.speaker: LWOHSCIENTISTMARKSON_57386
lines.text: Uh, well, no, I... uh, I was thinking... something else. But this is better.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68289
lines.text: Zoe? It looks like... Gravity's broken here. It's blocking my path forward.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68290
lines.text: Wow, something Dylan Faden can't do.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68291
lines.text: Well... Not yet.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68292
lines.text: Maybe I can find another Fault...

lines.speaker: ZOE_68293
lines.text: What? I didn't catch that?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68294
lines.text: You said the Patterning hit the West Incursion Zone the worst?

lines.speaker: ZOE_68295
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68296
lines.text: Maybe I'll come back.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68028
lines.text: I made it to the West Incursion Security Checkpoint.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68029
lines.text: That's great, but you're not getting in without a security keycard. You know, kinda like the one I told you to get.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68031
lines.text: Twice now.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68032
lines.text: Yeah, okay, find a keycard, I get it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68033
lines.text: Do you though?

lines.speaker: ZOE_68030
lines.text: From the Field Office.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71230
lines.text: Hey, I think I can see the Watchtower from here. Can you see me?

lines.speaker: ZOE_71231
lines.text: Uh, I don't know. Why don't you jump up and down or fly in a figure eight or something?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71232
lines.text: Uh--

lines.speaker: ZOE_71233
lines.text: Kidding. You do know I have other things to do than visually confirm your every move, right?

lines.speaker: ZOE_71234
lines.text: But yes, I do see you. Hi there.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12121
lines.text: Hey Zoe, I just got frozen by a camera, along with everything around me -- and then it... I don't know, jumped away.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12129
lines.text: Found some photos too, taken from around the city. Maybe they're related?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49103
lines.text: Frozen like those Hiss you found in the West Incursion Zone?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49107
lines.text: Not exactly.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49105
lines.text: Found a photo, too, taken from somewhere in the city. Maybe they're related?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49108
lines.text: Frozen like... in a block of ice?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49112
lines.text: Too traumatizing to talk about, huh?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49116
lines.text: No. I mean I couldn't move. Not even blink. Like I... was in a photograph.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49115
lines.text: You know, you get yourself into a lot of trouble, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49118
lines.text: Isn't that the job?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49117
lines.text: If you're doing it wrong.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49119
lines.text: Yes. I was a popsicle a second ago, but now I'm fine and talking to you.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49120
lines.text: Okay, have fun catching it. Bye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49121
lines.text: You asked.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49123
lines.text: Okay, so you found an Altered Item. Maybe you just need to... sneak up on it? Worth a try.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12133
lines.text: I think I stopped the Altered camera. The scene unfroze.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49124
lines.text: Did you get it contained?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49125
lines.text: No. It disappeared again. But I don't think it's coming back this time. At least not here...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12136
lines.text: Hey Zoe, I'm pretty sure I found an Altered Item. A camera. It had frozen everything in its view, kind of like... In a photograph.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49126
lines.text: Did you contain it?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49127
lines.text: I got the scene to unfreeze, but no... The camera disappeared.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12141
lines.text: I might go ask Langston about it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12143
lines.text: I found some photos, taken from around the city. Maybe they're related?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49128
lines.text: Try asking Langston. He's in the Field Panopticon.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49130
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12193
lines.text: Zoe, I've been chasing this camera all over town, but it just keeps escaping and then reappearing somewhere else.

lines.speaker: ZOE_12195
lines.text: Do you think there's a bunch of them, or... just one that exists in all those places at once?

lines.speaker: ZOE_49153
lines.text: You're unfreezing scenes, right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_12194
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: ZOE_12196
lines.text: And the camera's not returning to where you caught it? So you're making progress. Keep at it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68359
lines.text: Finished.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68392
lines.text: Just a little off.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68397
lines.text: No... It's not ready.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68396
lines.text: Hmm, something's off.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68395
lines.text: Not quite.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68394
lines.text: Almost.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68398
lines.text: Hmm, doesn't look right.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68393
lines.text: Needs some work.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68391
lines.text: Doesn't feel complete.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68390
lines.text: Hmmm... No.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68389
lines.text: Almost there...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68388
lines.text: It's not ready yet... Huh.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68387
lines.text: Still needs something...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68386
lines.text: It's not quite there...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68385
lines.text: Something's still not right...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68384
lines.text: Getting close. I think...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68415
lines.text: Wonder if the Bureau would ever issue me some paint...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68360
lines.text: Awesome -- looks like a set-up for a band. Maybe I can get the "band" back together here and sketch something... Always wanted to play.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68358
lines.text: If things had been different in Ordinary, I would've loved to start a band with friends...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68356
lines.text: Maybe we'd still be playing today...

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_6462
lines.text: Hey! Hold up.

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_18980
lines.text: No entry to the Field Office without authorization.

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_6465
lines.text: Faden, right? I can't believe they let you out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_6467
lines.text: I'm under orders from Agent de Vera to--

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_18982
lines.text: Here's the thing: Pope authorized your release. Not Arish. So I'm not playing ball.

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_18983
lines.text: With me on this, Jackson?

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_18984
lines.text: I'm with you, Larsen!

lines.speaker: ZOE_18987
lines.text: Dylan, I've pulled up the security feed on the gate. I'm seeing all of this. I can help.

options.text: Say what you have to say

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19010
lines.text: Look, all I want to do is help.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19011
lines.text: Dylan...

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_19012
lines.text: I think you helped enough seven years ago. Didn't he, Jackson?

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19013
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19015
lines.text: Dylan, repeat after me. Tell him: "Go fuck yourself."

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19021
lines.text: Whatever it is you need to say, just say it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19020
lines.text: Dylan...

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_19019
lines.text: Oh, I'll say it. You're the reason my team died seven years ago.

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19018
lines.text: Except me.

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_19017
lines.text: Except Jackson.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19016
lines.text: Dylan, repeat after me. Tell him: "Go fuck yourself."

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19027
lines.text: I get it, you hate me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19026
lines.text: Hey. That's not what I said.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19025
lines.text: But the sooner you let me through, the sooner I'm gone.

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19029
lines.text: Don't let him through, Larsen!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19034
lines.text: Go... Go fuck yourself.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19033
lines.text: God, your delivery is terrible.

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_19031
lines.text: You want me to shoot you?

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19030
lines.text: Personal insults are an HR violation!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68017
lines.text: That's not gonna convince him to let me through, Zoe.

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_19037
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19036
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ZOE_68020
lines.text: Okay, now you're making it worse.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68021
lines.text: I'll handle this.

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19044
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19045
lines.text: Agent de Vera? I--

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19046
lines.text: Hold on--

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19047
lines.text: Can't be serious.

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_19049
lines.text: Jackson? What's going on?

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19048
lines.text: We're, uh, we're letting him through.

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_19050
lines.text: What? Why?

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_19052
lines.text: That was de Vera. She's crazy, man.

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_19630
lines.text: This is bullshit.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19633
lines.text: Dylan, those guys were assholes. But you have to get into the Field Office.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19635
lines.text: You've gotta get through that gate, Dylan. I'll help, okay?

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_19673
lines.text: I'm watching you, Faden!

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_21695
lines.text: Why would we let you in?

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_21697
lines.text: Now what do you want?

lines.speaker: ZOE_21698
lines.text: Alright. Come on, Dylan, repeat after me: "Go fuck yourself". That's an order.

options.text: Say what you have to say

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_58298
lines.text: Oh, this guy again.

lines.speaker: GATEGUARDJACKSON_58299
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: GATERANGERLARSEN_58300

lines.speaker: ZOE_68329
lines.text: Yeah, it's an FBC front. We were already set up in the area, so it made sense to build the Field Office around it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68330
lines.text: A front?

lines.speaker: ZOE_68331
lines.text: We don't exactly operate in the open. Officially, that's the Verconn building. Importers of the finest low-end vacuum cleaners and home electronics.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68332
lines.text: "Verconn"

lines.speaker: ZOE_68333
lines.text: The FBC's home away from home. When I first started, they put me on door-to-door sales duty.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68334
lines.text: You? Sales?

lines.speaker: ZOE_68335
lines.text: Yeah, pretending to sell cheap electronics all across the country while actually investigating potential AWEs or Altered Items. Most of the time it was a false alarm.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68338
lines.text: At some point, we started getting enough bad reviews that it was compromising the operation, so they started sending out rebranded stuff from generic manufacturers. Didn't help the reviews much.

lines.text: Hi. You aren't Matthews, are you?

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_1202
lines.text: What? I- No. No, I, uh... I don't know a Matthews. Never met anyone with that name. I can't help you, sorry.

options.text: Were you in West Incursion Zone?

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_4862
lines.text: I swear I still hear the team on the radio. Not voices. But... noises. Shuffling...

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31520
lines.text: You're Faden, right? If you go out there, find them. Save them.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31463
lines.text: I said I don't know a Matthews, okay? Never met a Matthews in my life. Not even a Matthew.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31466
lines.text: Are you absolutely sure?

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31467
lines.text: About... my name? Yeah. Yeah, I-- how could I mess up my own--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31468
lines.text: That you don't know a Matthews.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31469
lines.text: You know what? Yeah, now that I think about it... Yeah, maybe I heard about a Matthews. He and a team went MIA in the West Incursion Zone, right? Sad story. But like I said, he and I never met. Good luck.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31471
lines.text: Were you ever in the West Incursion Zone?

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31472
lines.text: The West...? Uh, no, actually. No, not me. I've just been stationed here in Central. The Field Office. For the whole crisis. Never been deployed into the field actually anywhere. And not there.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31473
lines.text: Gets a... gets a little boring here, but hey, at least I'm in the first lunch slot.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31474
lines.text: I heard an FBC team went missing in the West Incursion Zone.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31476
lines.text: Yeah, I, I heard about that too. From... a friend.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31477
lines.text: Did you... Do you know if anyone survived? I sort of knew people on that team. I mean, not personally. Just, acquaintances. I didn't know them well.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31479
lines.text: They didn't make it.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31480
lines.text: Damn...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31482
lines.text: I'm not sure. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31483
lines.text: Oh, okay...

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31485
lines.text: The FBC never should've sent anyone into the West Incursion Zone. Whoever this "Matthews" guy is that you're looking for, I hope he somehow survived. I guess... it's not likely.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31487
lines.text: Look, someone reported seeing Matthews here. I think you're him. You're lying, I just don't know why.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31488
lines.text: Some people look a lot alike, okay? I... I've had a really shitty day, so...

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31489
lines.text: I don't-- I don't wanna talk about this anymore.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31491
lines.text: Zoe thinks you're dead. So do a lot of other people.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31492
lines.text: Oh, de Vera barely even--

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31493
lines.text: Okay. I'm Matthews. I was in the rescue team in the West Incursion Zone. But... things went wrong, in ways you can't even imagine, and I... I... I retreated, all right? Is that what you want to hear?

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31495
lines.text: I abandoned my team.

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31496
lines.text: Please. Please don't tell anyone.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31498
lines.text: If you're not Matthews, then who are you? What's your name?

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31499
lines.text: Just leave it alone, okay? I've got a kid. I'm trying to do right by him, even if it's not right to you. I was just trying to stay alive out here. Surely you can understand that.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31500
lines.text: Well, sorry for bothering you. I'll let you get back to... whatever you were doing.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31502
lines.text: No, that's... fine. Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31504
lines.text: Just let it go. I already told you, I'm not who you're looking for. I'm not Matthews. How many times do I have to say it?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31506
lines.text: Okay, you win. I'll leave you alone.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31507
lines.text: Good. Yeah, thanks.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31510
lines.text: You abandoned your team, didn't you? That's how you survived when everyone else went MIA. That's the only reason I can think of for why you'd lie about who you are.

lines.speaker: NOTMATTHEWS_31509
lines.text: God, man. What do you want from me? I'm not gonna talk to you, so just leave me the fuck alone. Please.

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31512
lines.text: Are you here to give me a lecture? Tell me how awful I am? Have me fired? Do you know what it's like out there? God...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31513
lines.text: Why'd you desert your team?

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31515
lines.text: We wanted to save those civilians. I wanted to. Okay? We went in armed to the teeth. If it had just been the Hiss, we might've been fine. But... there was something else out there with us. We never saw it, but we felt it. Us, the Hiss -- we couldn't fight back. My team lead, she was... pulled away, like... like attached to a rope.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31518
lines.text: What exactly happened out there?

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31519
lines.text: We... we were almost at the theater when all the voices over comms started repeating, like, umm... An echo, or... singing. Then the streets started stretching, bending. Everyone was screaming. I... I just ran. I didn't look back.

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31523
lines.text: Find my team in the West Incursion Zone. Please. Maybe they're still alive...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31526
lines.text: I'm sorry, but they didn't--

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31527
lines.text: No. No, stop, I can't -- I can't heard this. Please. Just... go.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31528
lines.text: I... I never found them, actually.

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31529
lines.text: Damn.

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31530
lines.text: God, I hope they're okay.

lines.speaker: MATTHEWS_31532
lines.text: Hey! Did you... Did you find my team?

lines.text: He wouldn't admit it, but... I think it was him.

lines.text: Dammit, Matthews. If he's lying, then it's safe to assume he didn't do anything heroic out there. He abandoned his post. I have to report him.

lines.text: No... No, it wasn't him, after all.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31561
lines.text: He deserted, didn't he? Shit, I'm gonna have to report this.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31567
lines.text: Dylan, we've gotta get eyes on whatever's happening in the West Incursion Zone. As soon as possible.

lines.text: Were you and Matthews close?

lines.text: He helped me through some scrapes in college. But I dropped out, and he joined the military. Showed up a few months ago begging for a job. Guess I felt like I owed him one.

lines.text: Sorry, Matthews.

lines.text: Yeah, of course he will.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31578
lines.text: Look, if you're feeling sorry for the guy, don't. He's not cut out for the job. It's that simple.

lines.speaker: ZOE_49567
lines.text: You see the problem. Don't worry, I've got a plan. You just get to the Field Office.

lines.speaker: ZOE_6470
lines.text: Now that that's out of the way: Welcome to the FBC Field Office. Head into the Verconn tower lobby, and help yourself to a keycard from Arish's desk. Just act like you belong.

options.text: What did you say to the guard?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19122
lines.text: Zoe, what did you say to the guard back there?

lines.speaker: ZOE_19123
lines.text: I just used the magic words. "Please" and "thank you", "Let him in or I'll stick you on fridge duty".

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19124
lines.text: Fridge duty?

lines.speaker: ZOE_19676
lines.text: Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19127
lines.text: That's your plan? Steal a keycard off his desk?

lines.speaker: ZOE_19126
lines.text: It's just one minor federal crime.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19125
lines.text: I don't wanna be locked up again.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19128
lines.text: Relax. It's not really a crime.

lines.speaker: ZOE_19130
lines.text: Or is it?

lines.speaker: ZOE_19132
lines.text: Get in, get out.

options.text: What did you say to the guard?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68034
lines.text: Zoe, I got the security keycard.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68035
lines.text: Great. When you're ready, pick your poison: West for the worst of the Patterning, southeast for Hiss tremors. Anywhere else for a fucking surprise.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68036
lines.text: Everything's urgent, Dylan. Do what you can.

lines.speaker: SECURITYSTATIONRECORDING_6484
lines.text: Attention. Please remain calm. Proceed through the checkpoint in an orderly fashion. This is an emergency evacuation. A magnitude 8 earthquake has caused severe damage across the city. This has also resulted in a gas leak in downtown Manhattan. Symptoms of exposure to this gas include headache, paranoia, and auditory and visual hallucinations.

lines.speaker: SECURITYSTATIONRECORDING_19309
lines.text: Please follow all instructions given by federal agents. It is important that you remain calm. You may be suffering from hallucinations and paranoia. You cannot trust everything you see. Medical attention will be provided inside. Repeat: This is an emergency evacuation. Enter the checkpoint in an orderly fashion and await processing.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68022
lines.text: Zoe? I think I found the way to the Evac Site...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68023
lines.text: It's locked.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68025
lines.text: Yeah, Arish shut down access when the Hiss took over that zone. No one's allowed in or out. You know what would come in handy right about now? A security keycard.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68026
lines.text: Yeah, okay, find a keycard, I get it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68027
lines.text: Do you though?

lines.speaker: ZOE_68024
lines.text: Yeah, Arish shut down access when the Hiss took over that zone. No one's allowed in or out. But if you have a security keycard, you can ignore those rules. Like I said, if you want to get anywhere, you need a keycard from the Field Office.

lines.speaker: POPE_64659
lines.text: POPE

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64669
lines.text: If this works, it could all be over soon, right? Arish is pretty convinced.

lines.speaker: POPE_64668
lines.text: Arish is, for lack of a better word, a soldier. He deals in certainties. I am a scientist. All I can say is, I have a hypothesis I want to prove.

lines.speaker: POPE_64667
lines.text: Are you positive this data is correct?

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64666
lines.text: That's what the on-site research crew gave me.

lines.speaker: POPE_64665
lines.text: POPE

lines.speaker: POPE_64664
lines.text: POPE

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64663
lines.text: Ma'am? Arish wanted me to check. What's our ETA?

lines.speaker: POPE_64662
lines.text: Again?

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64661
lines.text: He's worried about the Hiss resonance's... Progression, at the Evac Site.

lines.speaker: POPE_64660
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64658
lines.text: A ballpark...?

lines.speaker: POPE_64657
lines.text: POPE

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64656
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64655
lines.text: Hey, I'm just curious, Ma'am... Uh, once the CFD is activated... Will we still have power?

lines.speaker: POPE_64654
lines.text: POPE

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64653
lines.text: Should?

lines.speaker: POPE_64652
lines.text: POPE

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64651
lines.text: Right, a scientist, not a clairvoyant Person of Power. Nevermind.

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64650
lines.text: Uh, Co-Director Pope?

lines.speaker: POPE_64649
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64648
lines.text: It's not possible to be Hiss and not even know it, right?

lines.speaker: POPE_64647
lines.text: POPE

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64646
lines.text: Huh... Thanks... For the info...

lines.speaker: POPE_64645
lines.text: If we could just unpick the implied frequencies... map them out, we could begin to understand the para-quantum relationship between resonance expressions...

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64644
lines.text: Oh, yeah, hey, I actually have this theory, that, well... Nobody on the Research team will hear me out on... What if none of this is even real, and we're actually inside of a giant, metaphysical--

lines.speaker: POPE_64643
lines.text: Oh, sorry, I was just thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: VERCONNLOBBYRANGER_64642
lines.text: Oh. Yeah. Of course. Nevermind.

lines.speaker: POPE_2342
lines.text: Dylan. The CFD is making wonderful progress. Arish just left to prep a test run. It's exciting! I mean the calculations involved are just -- no look, I, I'm... I'm sorry, that's... That's not why you're here. I wanted to thank you in person. We couldn't have done this without your help. No one else could have survived that Sinkhole.

options.text: What do you need from me?
What happens when time runs out?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_4660
lines.text: What do you want me to do?

lines.speaker: POPE_4661
lines.text: Well, I have one idea to accelerate testing...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_4663
lines.text: What exactly will happen when time runs out?

lines.speaker: POPE_4664
lines.text: If their frequency keeps increasing, the tremors will eventually create a feedback loop of sorts. They'll overlap, amplifying each other, growing in power exponentially.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19782
lines.text: Which means...?

lines.speaker: POPE_19783
lines.text: Nothing good, as Jesse would say.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_4666
lines.text: Is cutting corners really such a bad idea, if we're in as much of a hurry as you say?

lines.speaker: POPE_4667
lines.text: Something you only learn after a lot of impatient mistakes: The corners always matter.

options.text: You don't need to thank me.
Couldn't have done it without Zoe.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9418
lines.text: You don't need to thank me. I made a deal with Zoe to help the FBC.

lines.speaker: POPE_9419
lines.text: Still, I wanted to say something.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9423
lines.text: I wouldn't have survived without Zoe's help. She's a good agent.

lines.speaker: POPE_9424
lines.text: I know Agent de Vera is under investigation. Arish is the head of her department. And whatever happens to her is... Is up to him. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9428
lines.text: You're, uh, you're welcome.

lines.speaker: POPE_9427
lines.text: Keep up the good work!

lines.speaker: POPE_9432
lines.text: Now, on to why I called you here. The Hiss tremors at the Evac Site are becoming more powerful and more frequent. We're running out of time to complete the CFD. Now Arish wants to cut corners. I'm trying to speed up, but testing for viability, safety, the proper calibrations -- it will take weeks. Days if we rush.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19785
lines.text: Then let's hurry. How can I help?

lines.speaker: POPE_19786
lines.text: Well, I do have one idea to accelerate testing.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19788
lines.text: Do you think the CFD will even work?

lines.speaker: POPE_19789
lines.text: Well, the only way to know is to test it. But luckily, I have an idea on how to accelerate that process.

lines.speaker: POPE_19790
lines.text: To get answers quicker, we'll need real Hiss resonance. We need somebody sturdy to lure a few Hiss to the CFD target area. That's you.

lines.speaker: POPE_19792
lines.text: Now, we'll start testing small at 0.005% power, anything more than that would be wildly reckless.

lines.speaker: POPE_19793
lines.text: Arish has made it clear he does not want you anywhere near the CFD. He still refuses to believe you're on our side. But you're the only one who can do this. If you're willing to help, find Arish and convince him.

options.text: You don't need me to agree

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19796
lines.text: Are you asking or ordering?

lines.speaker: POPE_19798
lines.text: No, I... I'm asking, Dylan. It's your choice.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19799
lines.text: Oh. I'm sorry. I... I want to help.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19801
lines.text: The Hiss used me. I'm happy to use them for your tests.

lines.speaker: POPE_19802
lines.text: I think Arish hates the Hiss almost as much as you do. It's a wonder you two can't get along.

lines.speaker: POPE_19803
lines.text: Listen, Dylan, before you go... I'm worried about Arish. He used to be a considerate, level-headed leader. But now he's impatient, bitter. He hardly sleeps and his hatred for the Hiss is borderline obsessive.

options.text: He'll be fine when Hiss is gone
I couldn't care less about Arish

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19806
lines.text: I'm sure Arish will be fine... Once we've destroyed the Hiss.

lines.speaker: POPE_19809
lines.text: I hope you're right. In the meantime, try not to provoke him.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19810
lines.text: I don't care about Arish, or how he feels, or how much he's sleeping. I follow the FBC's orders, so I follow his orders. That's it.

lines.speaker: POPE_19811
lines.text: I'm not asking you to feel sorry for him, Dylan. I'm just warning you.

lines.speaker: POPE_19812
lines.text: Good luck, Dylan. And whatever happens next, I think it'll happen fast. So stay safe.

lines.speaker: POPE_21930
lines.text: Thank you for all the work you've done on the CFD. Really. No one else could have gotten those probes set up in the Sinkhole.

lines.speaker: POPE_21931
lines.text: I don't blame Arish for wanting to cut corners. But there's only so much we can do to speed up development of the CFD.

lines.speaker: POPE_21932
lines.text: In any case, time is of the essence to get the CFD working.

lines.speaker: POPE_21933
lines.text: You are the only one who can help us in testing the CFD, Dylan. We could really use your help.

lines.speaker: POPE_21934
lines.text: Arish is a different person to the man I used to know. Now he's impatient. He's bitter. He hardly sleeps. He's falling apart and I don't know how to help him.

options.text: What do you need from me?
What happens when time runs out?
You don't need to thank me.
Couldn't have done it without Zoe.
You don't need me to agree
He'll be fine when Hiss is gone
I couldn't care less about Arish

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32538
lines.text: I think I found an FBC research site, Zoe... And another headless body.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32539
lines.text: Lovely.

lines.speaker: ZOE_33088
lines.text: Uh, looks like you're at the Dig Site Threshold. The expedition team there was supposed to be reassigned to crisis control after the lockdown fell. Guess they didn't make it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32541
lines.text: Zoe, I think I found the research team's Threshold. Something happened here too. There's blood everywhere and...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33089
lines.text: Another headless body.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32542
lines.text: I'm already tired of hearing that.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32543
lines.text: I'll see what else I can find.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32545
lines.text: Do you know anything about the Threshold?

lines.speaker: ZOE_32546
lines.text: The Dig Site was discovered a couple weeks before the crisis kicked off. Research was very excited. A Threshold appearing in Manhattan was a little shocking at the time, but given what's happened... Maybe it was just the rain before the storm.

lines.speaker: ZOE_33090
lines.text: Apparently the Threshold is experienced via auditory and visual phenomena. Must be trippy.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32522
lines.text: I think I found an FBC research site, Zoe. Something happened here. There's a body... Missing a head.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32521
lines.text: Missing a head? Any idea where it might have gone?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32520
lines.text: I think it's... All around me.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32519
lines.text: <groaning>

lines.speaker: ZOE_33087
lines.text: Looks like you're at the Dig Site Threshold. The expedition team there was supposed to be reassigned after the lockdown fell. You should investigate this, Dylan. See what else you can find.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32219
lines.text: Zoe, I think I found another member of the Threshold expedition team... Dead. Same way as the others.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32220
lines.text: Ugh... Dammit. I'll send a team to collect the body. Thanks for the report.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32633
lines.text: I found a note from the Expedition Team's Ranger. Sounds like he was headed for the Field Office loading Docks.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32632
lines.text: Maybe you can still find him there.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32588
lines.text: I'm inside the Threshold team's research station.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32590
lines.text: Sounds like a couple of them headed to the Field Hospital.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32604
lines.text: One was reassigned to the Field Office Loading Docks.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32593
lines.text: Another -- Wilson -- was accused of murder.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32594
lines.text: What? God, I think I know him...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32595
lines.text: Whatever's going on here, the team is in trouble. Maybe I can find them.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32596
lines.text: Just keep your head up, okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32599
lines.text: Wilson's name came up again, Zoe. This time accused of murder.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32598
lines.text: Shit.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32600
lines.text: If I find him, maybe I can figure out what's really going on.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32603
lines.text: Wilson's name came up again, Zoe. This time accused of murder.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32602
lines.text: Shit. You gotta find him, Dylan.

options.text: How well do you know Wilson?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32605
lines.text: Zoe, how well did you know Wilson?

lines.speaker: ZOE_32607
lines.text: We weren't exactly friends, but I know he was pretty well-liked. Smart. Polite. Guess you never really know anyone.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32610
lines.text: We don't have the whole story yet.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32609
lines.text: I guess we'll see.

options.text: How well do you know Wilson?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32620
lines.text: Zoe, I found a recording of the Threshold Expedition Team. One of them accused Wilson of murder.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32622
lines.text: Well, I'm not surprised tensions were running high. Must've been scary.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32625
lines.text: She was wrong. He didn't kill anyone.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32626
lines.text: Hope you're right.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32627
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32629
lines.text: What if I don't have all the pieces?

lines.speaker: ZOE_32630
lines.text: Just keep looking.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32270
lines.text: You are not going to believe this -- A Ranger just spotted Wilson heading for a warehouse behind the Field Office, near the northern perimeter.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32271
lines.text: I'll check it out.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32272
lines.text: Dylan, be sure you know what you're getting into before you confront him.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32647
lines.text: Zoe? There's a body in the Field Hospital... Missing a head.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32646
lines.text: Missing a head?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32645
lines.text: Yeah. It... It looks like it exploded.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32644
lines.text: Ugh. Okay... The Bureau's medical team is stretched thin, Dylan. See if you can do something to help.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32650
lines.text: Zoe, I found another body... Without a head.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32651
lines.text: Copy that. You're in the Field Hospital?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32652
lines.text: Yeah. I'll see what I can find out.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32653
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32655
lines.text: Zoe, I think I found another member of the Threshold expedition team at the Field Hospital... Dead. Just like the others.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32656
lines.text: Dammit. Guess the report hasn't reached me yet. Thanks for letting me know.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32677
lines.text: Zoe? There's a locked cabinet near the body here. Any chance you've got the Field Hospital codes?

lines.speaker: ZOE_32676
lines.text: Oh, right, the codes. No. No one there will either. Security just updated all access codes, for "security reasons". Problem is, they haven't delivered them yet, and it'll probably be awhile. Bureau's not exactly known for efficiency.

lines.speaker: ZOE_33094
lines.text: Your best bet is to head directly to the Security Station. You can get the code from there.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32362
lines.text: Got the medical cabinet open, Zoe. Found a Quarantine List related to the body.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32684
lines.text: It's for the Threshold team.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32686
lines.text: It mentions... An FBC Expedition Team?

lines.speaker: ZOE_32687
lines.text: From the Dig Site Threshold? That's just behind the Field Office. That team was supposed to be reassigned to crisis control. I guess they didn't make it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32688
lines.text: The theory here was they caught a paranatural disease.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32691
lines.text: It lists a location for the Team Ranger -- the Field Office loading docks.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32693
lines.text: One name's underlined: Wilson.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32694
lines.text: I think I know a Wilson...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32695
lines.text: Whatever's going on, the team is in trouble. Maybe I can find them.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32698
lines.text: Wilson's name is underlined. If I find him, maybe I can figure out what's going on.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32697
lines.text: Speak of the devil. I just got a report -- A Ranger spotted Wilson heading for a warehouse past the northern perimeter of the Field Office.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32702
lines.text: Dylan, be sure you know what you're getting into before you confront him.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32700
lines.text: They think it's contagious? Damn.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32701
lines.text: I've gotta find Wilson. Before someone else dies.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32719
lines.text: Zoe, I found a body at the Field Office loading docks... Her head, uh... It looks like it exploded.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32718
lines.text: Did you say her head exploded?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32717
lines.text: ID badge says she's a parabiologist in a... Threshold expedition team?

lines.speaker: ZOE_32716
lines.text: Must be the Dig Site, behind the Field Office. Most of the team never showed up for reassignment after the crisis hit. Wonder what the hell happened...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32715
lines.text: Maybe I can find out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32722
lines.text: Zoe? Found another body, at the loading docks. No head.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32723
lines.text: That's getting old fast.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32724
lines.text: ID badge says she's a parabiologist in a... Threshold expedition team?

lines.speaker: ZOE_32725
lines.text: Must be the Dig Site, behind the Field Office. Most of the team never showed up for reassignment after the crisis hit. Wonder what the hell happened...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32726
lines.text: Maybe I can find out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32731
lines.text: Zoe. Think I found another member of that expedition team... Guess what.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32732
lines.text: No head?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32733
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32734
lines.text: I'll look around.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32729
lines.text: Zoe, think I found another member of the expedition team at the loading docks. Dead, just like the others.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32730
lines.text: Damn. We'll send a team to collect the body. Thanks for letting me know.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32742
lines.text: Hey, Zoe? The loading docks have a security camera. Whatever happened here might've been caught on tape.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32741
lines.text: Oh yeah, good thinking. FBC's got access to most CCTV around the city. You might be able to find the footage at the Security Station.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32744
lines.text: Does the FBC always have access? Is that... Legal?

lines.speaker: ZOE_32746
lines.text: We pulled the feeds for the crisis, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32747
lines.text: But... You can do that at any time?

lines.speaker: ZOE_32748
lines.text: I'm not saying it's right.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32397
lines.text: I just watched the CCTV footage from the loading docks. There was someone else with the dead woman. He was terrified.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32758
lines.text: Zoe, when she died, it was like... I don't know, like something jumped out of her and into him.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32751
lines.text: He said something strange, too. A name, maybe? Wilson.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32752
lines.text: I think I know a Wilson... He was part of the expedition team. Keep digging, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32754
lines.text: Then he said a name: Wilson. If I find Wilson, maybe I can figure out what's really going on.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32755
lines.text: Speak of the devil. I just got a report -- A Ranger spotted Wilson heading for a warehouse past the northern perimeter of the Field Office.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32760
lines.text: Dylan, be sure you know what you're getting into before you confront him.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32757
lines.text: You mean like... Something from the Threshold?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32759
lines.text: I don't know... But I'll find out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32769
lines.text: What if I got it wrong?

lines.speaker: ZOE_32768
lines.text: We might never know for sure, Dylan. At least it's over now.

lines.speaker: ZOE_32772
lines.text: I don't think we'll ever know exactly what happened, Dylan. At least it's over now.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32765
lines.text: Zoe? I just watched CCTV footage from the loading docks. The expedition team member who died there -- she wasn't alone. The Ranger was with her.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32770
lines.text: When she died, it was like... I don't know, like something jumped out of her and into him...

lines.speaker: WILSON_32780
lines.text: Somebody! Help!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32786
lines.text: Please! We need help in here!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32790
lines.text: Can anyone hear me?

lines.speaker: WILSON_32789
lines.text: Hurry! Anybody!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32788
lines.text: Please!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32787
lines.text: Help!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32807
lines.text: Oh no no no...

lines.speaker: WILSON_32810
lines.text: Somebody! Please! Help!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32815
lines.text: I need help! Dammit!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32814
lines.text: Hello? Can anyone hear me?!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32813
lines.text: We're in here!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32812
lines.text: Hello? Is anyone out there?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32827
lines.text: Hey! I'm here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32857
lines.text: You're Wilson? What's going on here?

lines.speaker: WILSON_32856
lines.text: We have to get to the Threshold. They're both about to die. It could happen at any second.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32876
lines.text: Slow down. What do you mean? What could happen?

lines.speaker: WILSON_32877
lines.text: More people will die! Cox will die! We could die! Don't you get it? We need to go back to the Dig Site Threshold. Now.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32878
lines.text: It's too late to save Cox.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32884
lines.text: Field Hospital staff thought your team was exposed to a contagion in the Threshold.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32885
lines.text: Of course they would think that. Listen, I'd be the first to panic if that were true, believe me. I've explained this over and over, but no one listens. It's not what you think.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32886
lines.text: I thought I saw... I don't know what, jump from someone else into the Ranger here. Did something escape that Threshold?

lines.speaker: WILSON_32887
lines.text: Escape? No. No, you've got it wrong. It was an accident. He's stuck here. He wants to go home.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32888
lines.text: Please. You have to believe me.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32899
lines.text: Okay, calm down. I believe you. I'm listening.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32900
lines.text: You can't tell the FBC the truth or they'll never leave the Dig Site alone.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33947
lines.text: I gave him the designation AVP-3. He's from the Threshold. He can't survive our dimension without a human host. I think he's young -- an infant -- and scared. He didn't hurt anyone on purpose.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33948
lines.text: We need to get him back to his Threshold, but his host is dying. If that happens, he could jump into one of us. He can't control it.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32922
lines.text: Hello? I said we need to go. I need help carrying him.

options.text: What did you do to him?

lines.speaker: WILSON_32925
lines.text: WILSON

lines.speaker: WILSON_32926
lines.text: You clearly have no understanding how urgent this is. The Threshold is the only way.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32928
lines.text: Explain it to me.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32929
lines.text: Both of them are going to die. It could happen at any minute. Any second. You need to listen.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32932
lines.text: You need to help me carry him back.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32934
lines.text: What did you do to him?

lines.speaker: WILSON_32935
lines.text: Why does everyone keep blaming me? Hiss attacked us. I barely survived myself. I'm trying to help. We have to return to the Dig Site.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32936
lines.text: Are you even listening to me?

lines.speaker: WILSON_32939
lines.text: Hey, hey! Come back!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32945
lines.text: What the hell...

lines.speaker: WILSON_32941
lines.text: Look, I'll answer any questions you have. Just please. Hurry.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32942
lines.text: Your colleague said the Threshold changed you. She thought you were a murderer. Is that true?

lines.speaker: WILSON_32944
lines.text: She thought the Threshold gave me powers, like something out of a comic book. And she's a biologist! Ridiculous. It's not what you think, trust me.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32947
lines.text: We're out of time.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32948
lines.text: He's dying.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32951
lines.text: We have to act now!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32950
lines.text: Trust me.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32955
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I think you did kill your colleagues. I won't let you hurt anyone else.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33955
lines.text: No. Wait!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33954
lines.text: Zoe, send a team to my location. I think Wilson--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32958
lines.text: I think you're right. It's not contagious. But that Threshold changed you. You killed your colleagues.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33956
lines.text: No. Wait!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33957
lines.text: Zoe, send a team to my location. I think Wilson--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32959
lines.text: You're not making any sense. You were at the loading docks, weren't you? The Ranger said your name. You've been around every time someone died.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33958
lines.text: No. Wait!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33959
lines.text: Zoe, send a team to my location. I think Wilson--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32961
lines.text: I believe you didn't kill anyone, but the Threshold did change you, and it's likely contagious.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33965
lines.text: No. Wait!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33964
lines.text: Zoe, send a team to my location. I think Wilson--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32963
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I have to trust the experts on this. For everyone's safety, I can't let you leave this room.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33963
lines.text: No. Wait!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33962
lines.text: Zoe, send a team to my location. I think Wilson--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32965
lines.text: I think something did escape that Threshold: A contagion.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33961
lines.text: No. Wait!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33960
lines.text: Zoe, send a team to my location. I think Wilson--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32979
lines.text: I can't explain how, but he might be able to jump into me without taking control. I might even be able to take him back and survive. Maybe.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32972
lines.text: Right. Right, yeah, you're... You're Faden, aren't you? You're a parautilitarian, a Person of Power. Maybe... Maybe you can. Hurry before it's too late.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32977
lines.text: If he's responsible for those deaths, he's too dangerous. I should know.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32976
lines.text: What? No--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32975
lines.text: Zoe, there's a Threshold Escapee in need of containment at--

lines.speaker: WILSON_32987
lines.text: Do something!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32991
lines.text: We need to go.

lines.speaker: WILSON_32993
lines.text: Where are you going? Wait!

lines.speaker: WILSON_32995
lines.text: We'll tell everyone it's a contagion. They'll cordon off the Threshold, stay away...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33050
lines.text: I've got him. I'll take him back to the Threshold.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33049
lines.text: I'll tell the FBC a contagion caused this. They'll send me to containment, probably indefinitely, because this will never be solved. But it's the only way to ensure no one goes near the Dig Site Threshold again.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33056
lines.text: I understand... If that's what you want.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33953
lines.text: Uh, say goodbye for me, will you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33054
lines.text: You don't want that. Believe me.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33053
lines.text: If they know the truth, they'll capture more like AVP-3. Experiment on them. I've made my decision.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33952
lines.text: Say goodbye for me, will you?

options.text: What did you do to him?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33019
lines.text: Another expedition team member is dead, Zoe. Wilson was here, but he disappeared.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33095
lines.text: Said something about going back to the Threshold.

lines.speaker: ZOE_33018
lines.text: Find him.

lines.speaker: RANGERCOX_33005
lines.text: <inhuman noise>

lines.speaker: WILSON_33006
lines.text: No! No no no-!

lines.speaker: ZOE_33015
lines.text: Dylan? What's going on?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33014
lines.text: Something happened. I'll call you back when I figure out what.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33000
lines.text: Hey...

lines.speaker: RANGERCOX_32999
lines.text: <inhuman noise>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33011
lines.text: Let's get you home.

lines.speaker: WILSON_33010
lines.text: He's dying! Hurry!

lines.speaker: RANGERCOX_32837
lines.text: Willllllllsssssss...

lines.speaker: RANGERCOX_32851
lines.text: Soooooooooooonnnnnnnn...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33030
lines.text: Zoe? I found Wilson.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33042
lines.text: He's dead.

lines.speaker: ZOE_33029
lines.text: Dammit. Whatever killed that team, let's hope it ends here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33035
lines.text: I was wrong, Zoe. I thought Wilson was a murderer, but if someone killed the team, it wasn't him...

lines.speaker: ZOE_33036
lines.text: Then let's hope it wasn't murder. You can't win them all, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33037
lines.text: The FBC was reckless with the Threshold Zoe. No one should have authorized expeditions unless they were sure it was safe. Didn't the Bureau learn anything from the Hiss?

lines.speaker: ZOE_33038
lines.text: The Dig Site was discovered before the FBC outside of the lockdown knew anything about the Hiss, Dylan. We'll update our procedures, of course, but--

lines.speaker: ZOE_33041
lines.text: You're right. It shouldn't have happened like this.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33039
lines.text: I got so close to figuring it out. I was hoping I could save at least one of them...

lines.speaker: ZOE_33040
lines.text: You can't save everyone, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33062
lines.text: Agh...!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33067
lines.text: Wilson says goodbye...

lines.speaker: ZOE_33076
lines.text: Dylan? I just got word. Wilson's turned himself in. Says his team caught a disease in the Threshold. They're gonna quarantine him in containment until we figure out how to treat it. Once we get resources on it, we'll close off the Dig Site too so no one else gets hurt.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33084
lines.text: I can't let Wilson ruin his life. It's not a disease, Zoe. His team found intelligent life in that Threshold. The situation is secure now, but he was afraid that if the FBC knew the truth, they wouldn't leave the Dig Site alone.

lines.speaker: ZOE_33086
lines.text: His fears are warranted.

lines.speaker: ZOE_33085
lines.text: But you did the right thing by telling me. Probably just saved him from a lifetime of containment. Though I doubt he'll get to keep his job.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_33082
lines.text: Understood. Sorry I couldn't do more to help.

lines.speaker: ZOE_33083
lines.text: Can't solve them all, Dylan. Thanks for trying.

lines.speaker: ZOE_33080
lines.text: At least it's over now.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14636
lines.text: Hey, Hannah, how are you? I'd like to talk to you about your sister...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_32098
lines.text: Hannah? I'd like to talk to you about your sister...

lines.speaker: FAKEHANNAH_32099
lines.text: <Mold noises>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31941
lines.text: I'm trying to find Heidi. I could use your help with that. Do you know where she is?

lines.speaker: FAKEHANNAH_31943
lines.text: <Mold noises>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31942
lines.text: Heidi said you aren't... well, you. Do you know why she would say that?

lines.speaker: FAKEHANNAH_31944
lines.text: <Mold noises>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31940
lines.text: ...okaaay.

lines.speaker: DRFLOREZ_14668
lines.text: Did you find out where Heidi went?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14670
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: DRFLOREZ_14669
lines.text: She must've left something behind.

lines.speaker: DRFLOREZ_31947
lines.text: Please. She's my patient. Take another look.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14665
lines.text: That's Mold growing around you. You didn't eat it, did you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19678
lines.text: Hannah? Did you... eat the Mold? It's growing around you...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14692
lines.text: Hey, Zoe, got an update on the twin sisters I found at the Park.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31949
lines.text: One of them's missing? Yeah, I just heard.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31948
lines.text: The coordinator forgot that little detail when he relayed the doc's request. Heidi, right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31950
lines.text: Yeah. I think I know where she is. I'll call you back.

lines.speaker: DUMPSTERSPEAKER_324
lines.text: <static>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_326
lines.text: Zoe, I think I found an Altered Item. It's under control, for now.

lines.speaker: ZOE_7181
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14068
lines.text: A speaker, like for a stereo. Which makes me wonder if it's not the only one...

lines.speaker: ZOE_14069
lines.text: Yeah... They do come in sets. Keep an eye out.

lines.speaker: COFFEESHOPSPEAKER_14416
lines.text: <static>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_330
lines.text: Zoe, I just found a new Altered Item. I think I subdued it... For now.

lines.speaker: ZOE_7186
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14084
lines.text: A speaker, like for a stereo. Which makes me wonder if it's not the only one...

lines.speaker: ZOE_14085
lines.text: Yeah... They do come in sets. Keep an eye out.

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER1_3428
lines.text: I think things are going to be just fine now that Fred's taking charge.

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER2_20158
lines.text: Oh yeah, definitely. Fred knows what he's doing. He's going to be great.

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER1_3561
lines.text: They finally gave Fred that promotion. Well-deserved. How hasn't he always been the Director?

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER2_20398
lines.text: He really should have been. No one could do a better job than Director Fred. The future's looking bright for the FBC!

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER1_31425
lines.text: You know what Director Fred said to me the other day? I showed him my paperwork. He called it "grainy". I felt so special.

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER2_31424
lines.text: God, I wished he'd say that to me.

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER1_20590
lines.text: Do you feel a little funny? Like we're forgetting something?

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER2_20592
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, something about a... Fred? Who's that?

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER1_20593
lines.text: Beats me.

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER2_20594
lines.text: Let's just get back to work. What we can't remember won't hurt us.

lines.speaker: LWFBCWORKER1_20595
lines.text: A good motto for life.

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_20173
lines.text: You're frisbee!

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_31016
lines.text: Grainy clamp.

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_31188
lines.text: Lead Fred. Sounds gripe.

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_31189
lines.text: Lead's clamp.

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_31191
lines.text: Premium lead of bead.

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_31209
lines.text: Topsy-turvy turnaround.

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_31211
lines.text: River chicken station!

lines.speaker: FRAMAURO_31213
lines.text: Such a printer in the flower pot, that Shepard. So windy and far.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49364
lines.text: Mila...?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49368
lines.text: Hello? Mila?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49367
lines.text: Dylan? Dylan, listen, I think -- I think I saw someone else in here. I think she knows how to get out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49366
lines.text: Hey, hold on--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49369
lines.text: I'm gonna follow her. I have to go.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49373
lines.text: Dylan? Dylan, listen, I think -- I think I found the right cab.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49372
lines.text: That's good. I--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49371
lines.text: I have to go.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49375
lines.text: Mila--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49374
lines.text: I'm getting out of here this time. I'm sure of it. I won't be back. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49377
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_69719
lines.text: Uh, sorry.

lines.speaker: RANGER1_70840
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: RANGER2_70841
lines.text: Shut that off!

lines.speaker: RANGER1_70842
lines.text: My ears are ringing...

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65502
lines.text: Goddammit! Stupid thing won't work.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65501
lines.text: Can't even change the channel.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65500
lines.text: Wish I had the remote...

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65499
lines.text: Stupid, shit job.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65498
lines.text: This job is ass.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65497
lines.text: I should just leave.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65496
lines.text: I guess it's better than no TV.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65495
lines.text: Great. The freak is here.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65494
lines.text: Look who it is.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19007
lines.text: Have you seen a cat go by recently?

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65435
lines.text: Yeah, sure. It was chasing a mouse and then I gave it a saucer of milk.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9584
lines.text: Any chance you're part of the research team Pope sent down here?

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_70789
lines.text: Schultz's team? They wish. I turned them down before they could even ask! I think those geeks were actually excited. Guess they're suicidal.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18044
lines.text: I heard Langston's apartment is somewhere down here. Know anything about that?

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65492
lines.text: Did Pope send you down too? Listen, she's just trying to get Langston to shut up about his cat.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65475
lines.text: Look, this mission is a joke. But if you feel so strongly about it then, hey, it's yours. Langston can tell you more. I don't remember his whole "mission briefing". It was long.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65474
lines.text: We forgot to ask for his key anyway.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65476
lines.text: Look, I'm not gonna put my skin on the line for a cat. But if you want this shit job then be my guest.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18052
lines.text: I've got Langston's key. I'm going in.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65472
lines.text: You're wasting your time.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18056
lines.text: What are you doing down here anyway?

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65490
lines.text: Pope sent us to look for Langston's apartment.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22026
lines.text: Did you happen to see the research team Pope sent to the Underpass?

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_70791
lines.text: Schultz's team? I saw them. I think those geeks were actually excited. Guess they're suicidal. I could tell they wanted me to join, but I turned them down before they could even ask!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18046
lines.text: The cat's name is Alfred and Langston sent me to find him.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65486
lines.text: Oh really? His name is Alfred? Does he like belly rubs and is his purr just the sweetest? I don't care.

options.text: Didn’t try to rescue your friend?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60049
lines.text: Aren't you worried that this... "monster" could just come find you here?

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65484
lines.text: As soon as anything even remotely gives me the creeps, I'm running. Getting sick of this job anyway. They expect us to die out here, and don't even give us hazard pay.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60051
lines.text: Is "monster" really a scientific, FBC term? If someone's going in, we should try to figure out what it actually--

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65482
lines.text: Oh yeah, maybe we could get Research down here to classify it, and write reports on what kind of paranatural power it uses to kill and eviscerate it's victims. That'll help.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60055
lines.text: You... didn't try to rescue your friend?

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65480
lines.text: We weren't friends. And I did say "It's just a dumb cat. Don't bother." Not my fault no one ever listens when I talk.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60057
lines.text: So you're just gonna... not do your job?

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65478
lines.text: Nope. I'm gonna sit here and stare at this stupid TV in hopes that it eventually starts working, so I don't die of boredom while I run out the clock.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65488
lines.text: Look, I already told you. There's some kind of monster in there, which I have no plans of fighting just to save some stupid cat. I'm not ending up like my partner.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65489
lines.text: My partner was stupid enough to go in to mark the tape lines to the location. I heard screaming, then, you know, some point the scream... You know, died out. Partner never came back. So the new plan is to hang here for a bit, then head back up to tell Langston we didn't find anything. He accepts that his stupid cat is long dead and we all move on. And I don't get killed by whatever monster's in there.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_65477
lines.text: Look, rescuing that idiot's kitty isn't going to make us forget what you are. But hey, if you want this shit job, be my guest.

options.text: Didn’t try to rescue your friend?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18512
lines.text: Uh, I don't want to freak you out, Langston, but I found some blood on the floor.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18513
lines.text: Is it Maria's blood? Did Alfred scratch her?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18514
lines.text: I don't- How would I know that? It's a lot of blood for a scratch, though...

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18536
lines.text: Whoa whoa whoa. You're gonna need the cat carrier to transport Alfred. It should be in the apartment somewhere.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18094
lines.text: So you can see me?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18095
lines.text: I can see everything! This way I can help you find Alfred. It's like I'm there in-person.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18499
lines.text: Why isn't your apartment patterned? Everything else down here is.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18500
lines.text: Do I look like a scientist to you, Dylan? Do I wear a lab coat? Do I have big rubber gloves on my hands? Do I handle beakers and microscopes?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18502
lines.text: There's no one else here. I guess Maria didn't stick around.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18503
lines.text: Hey, Maria was a great neighbor. She shared her amazing tamales with the whole building. If she left, I'm sure she had a good reason.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18504
lines.text: Like if her apartment building fell into a paranatural sinkhole.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18505
lines.text: I don't see a cat anywhere, Langston.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18507
lines.text: He may be hiding. We used to play hide and seek all hours of the night. Sometimes I'd find him in the silliest places. One time he got into the walls and, oh man...

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18509
lines.text: But let's stay focused. Go search the apartment for Alfred!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_5879
lines.text: Dylan! It's me.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_6519
lines.text: Langston? Where are you?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_6520
lines.text: I'm inside the cat feeder. Well, not inside inside. But it has a built-in camera and speaker. Fancy, right?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18090
lines.text: First thing I did when the lockdown fell was go get my old phone out of the lockers in the lobby. No modern tech past the lobby elevator. I can't believe it still works!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18091
lines.text: It's a pretty high-tech cat feeder. Alfred deserves the best.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18092
lines.text: Come on, come over here and check it out! This is going to be fun. Imagine I'm your handler. You're on a dangerous mission, and it's only my expert guidance that can save you from a drawn-out, horrific death.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60063
lines.text: Dylan?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18529
lines.text: Put me down next to the cat carrier. Or put the feeder down. You know what I mean.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18527
lines.text: Okay, now put me in the cat carrier. That way I can come along for the ride.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18528
lines.text: Great.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18532
lines.text: All right, now we're ready. Pick up the carrier and we can begin the search!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18538
lines.text: Nobody knows Alfred like I do. First of all, plants are his natural enemy. Find any destroyed plants and follow them.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18520
lines.text: It's clear now that my worst fears are realized: Alfred has gotten out. We need to go after him. Quick, pick me up and find the cat carrier. It should be in the apartment somewhere.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18522
lines.text: Hurry up! Alfred needs us! Take the cat feeder to the carrier!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18516
lines.text: I found some scratch marks on the wall. They look fresh.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18518
lines.text: Ugh, sounds like Alfred's been sharpening his little claws again. Sometimes he scratches right through the drywall.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60064
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18646
lines.text: I remember the day I got Alfred from... Wait, who sold me Alfred? Oh well, it's been a long time.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60071
lines.text: You don't remember where you got him?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60072
lines.text: Hey, I've been under a lot of stress at work. Not professional stress, mind you, more like "constant physical danger" type stress.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19185
lines.text: I didn't know cats like TV.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_19186
lines.text: Oh, Alfred loves his soaps! We would watch them together every night. Of course, that was before my workplace became a literal prison.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_19188
lines.text: Though I guess for you it was always a-- er, sorry. I didn't mean to, uh, remind you of your, lifetime of, uh... Let's just find Alfred.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19179
lines.text: So have you ever actually seen Alfred?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_19180
lines.text: Define "seen". Do you mean perceived? With my eyes?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60077
lines.text: Yes. How else do you see things?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60078
lines.text: I don't have time to answer that properly right now.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60079
lines.text: Yes, I've seen Alfred with my eyes. Before the lockdown, he slept on my bed every night.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60080
lines.text: He always left me "gifts" too.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_19181
lines.text: One time he got out and came back with a dead coyote. I didn't even know we had coyotes in New York!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19182
lines.text: Coyotes are bigger than cats, right?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_19183
lines.text: Oh yeah. Way bigger. But Alfred's never been afraid of a fight.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18643
lines.text: <distant yowling>

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18644
lines.text: Oh, I just heard Alfred! I'd recognize that dulcet meow anywhere! Quick, put the carrier down on a comfy bed. Oh, and there has to be a TV on nearby. He loves his stories.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18645
lines.text: If we can create the perfect conditions, then he'll walk into this carrier all on his own. He's a very particular cat. He always has been.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_6541
lines.text: This spot is perfect! Now all we need is some music. Alfred has the ear of a young Beethoven.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_29451
lines.text: This should work. Not as well as the theremin. Alfred always loved listening to me play. But it'll do.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_6543
lines.text: Okay, last step, make sure there are no plants in there. None! Alfred gets upset if I even smell like leaves.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60082
lines.text: Well, either way, just one more step to go. Make sure there are no plants in there. None! Alfred gets upset if I even smell like leaves.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60084
lines.text: Langston, are you sure Alfred is really just a cat?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60085
lines.text: What else would he be?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60086
lines.text: Ooooh... Ooh. Well, that would be really awkward... if he was... And I didn't realize... Huh.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18649
lines.text: No, no, no. This won't do. No TV, no Alfred.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_5887
lines.text: There's no TV here. Alfred won't like that.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18650
lines.text: No, Alfred needs a TV! He's a cultured gentleman!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60074
lines.text: We need a room with a TV on. Alfred isn't going to stare at a blank rectangle. Find somewhere else.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60076
lines.text: Did you not hear me say the TV needs to be on? I feel like you're not taking this very seriously.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18541
lines.text: Does this look like Alfred's handiwork?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18542
lines.text: Oh yeah. I can tell from the way this has been knocked over that Alfred is in one of his moods. You know, one time he got really angry and knocked my couch upside-down.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60070
lines.text: Aren't couches... Heavy?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_5888
lines.text: Everything seems right.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18653
lines.text: Farther! If I can hear you breathing then Alfred definitely can.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60091
lines.text: Listen, the "monster" the Ranger mentioned...

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60090
lines.text: You can't possibly think Alfie could be--

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60092
lines.text: Oh, we really need to find him.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60094
lines.text: You have to disappear.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18651
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18652
lines.text: Go. Leave. Alfred won't come if you're hanging around. He's a very private feline.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18655
lines.text: Mew.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_5889
lines.text: Dylan! Dylan, come back! Alfred's here!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_5890
lines.text: Did you miss me all that time I was gone? Yes, seven years is entirely too long to be apart, yes it is.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18656
lines.text: Did you get enough to eat?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18657
lines.text: Where did Maria get off to, Alfie? Do you know? No? That's okay, I'm sure she's fine.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18658
lines.text: Langston.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18659
lines.text: I still have to get her that fruit basket for taking care of you, yes I do. Oh, I missed you!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18662
lines.text: Langston!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18663
lines.text: Yes, Dylan, I hear you! Grab the carrier and get us all out of here. We can figure out what to do about Alfred's... Possible containment needs, later.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60101
lines.text: Dylan? What happened? Alfred's blocking the view.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5892
lines.text: He's dead.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60102
lines.text: This proves it! Alfred's not the monster!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_6551
lines.text: And what matters now is getting the survivors to safety. Namely Alfred.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18666
lines.text: If I don't kill whatever did this, other people will be in danger.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_60103
lines.text: Meow.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60105
lines.text: Wait. I know that meow!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60104
lines.text: Alfred, are you sure?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60106
lines.text: I think he wants you to follow the trail.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60107
lines.text: He... wants me to--

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18668
lines.text: Alfie, sniff out the murderous creature for uncle Dylan, okay sweetie? Follow his meows, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DOMBROW_5891
lines.text: Fuck you! No! No! Arrrrggghhh!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_6550
lines.text: Okay, now I know that scream sounded bad, but let's not get distracted by whatever that was.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18664
lines.text: He's in trouble!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_29456
lines.text: Oh, come on. You're going towards the scream?

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_5893
lines.text: Meow.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_6553
lines.text: Alfred seems to think the creature went directly down from this spot.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18670
lines.text: Mrroowr.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18669
lines.text: Those meows mean he's on the creature's trail. Keep going.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18675
lines.text: Meow.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18676
lines.text: Alfred thinks we're getting close.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18677
lines.text: Meow.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18679
lines.text: Alfred thinks we're going the wrong way.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18681
lines.text: Meow.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18682
lines.text: Oh, that meow means we're very close.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18684
lines.text: Meow.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18683
lines.text: Alfred's lost the trail. We should head back to that ranger's corpse so Alfred can pick up the scent again.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_60108
lines.text: Meow.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60110
lines.text: Not this way!

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_60113
lines.text: Meow.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60114
lines.text: Back on track!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60115
lines.text: Wrong way.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60117
lines.text: We're getting close!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60116
lines.text: Go directly down.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_5901
lines.text: Well, I guess this is goodbye, Alfred...

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18776
lines.text: Meow.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18713
lines.text: Okay, Alfred, show me what you can do.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_5897
lines.text: Alfred, if it gets too scary, you just come right back to the crate, okay?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18716
lines.text: Hey, I can't see anything but a wall! Is Alfred okay? Where is he?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18717
lines.text: Uh, just give us a second, Langston.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60121
lines.text: Help him, Dylan!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60122
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_19193
lines.text: Maybe I can... Show him where the Hiss is?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18724
lines.text: Uh... Over here, Alfred!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18726
lines.text: Umm, it's here!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18727
lines.text: The Hiss is here!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18728
lines.text: Alfred! This is the spot!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18729
lines.text: Alfred! Pss, pss, pss.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18730
lines.text: Alfred! Right here!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18731
lines.text: Here's the Hiss, Alfred!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60125
lines.text: Uh, here, kitty kitty?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60126
lines.text: Over here!

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18736
lines.text: Rrwooor!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18737
lines.text: I think it's working!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60127
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18738
lines.text: Hyiiisssss!

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18740
lines.text: Yeeeoowrr!

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18747
lines.text: Mewr.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18748
lines.text: Too late.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18749
lines.text: Mrawr.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18750
lines.text: Missed.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18751
lines.text: Meeoow.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18752
lines.text: Sorry, Alfred...

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18753
lines.text: Meewr.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18754
lines.text: Damn.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18755
lines.text: Mwwor.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60128
lines.text: You're upsetting Alfred!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60130
lines.text: I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60129
lines.text: I'll try again.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71764
lines.text: It's dead... We actually did it...

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60131
lines.text: He did? Good work, Alfred! I always knew you were special.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60132
lines.text: Remember this, Dylan: Every cat, or... Cat-like paranatural entity, is a special flower.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60133
lines.text: Now, come back to the carrier, Alfie. We'll get you home.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18706
lines.text: Meow!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_5895
lines.text: Is that Maria? Oh, yeah, that is definitely Maria. I really should have seen this coming.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18707
lines.text: I think the Hiss is... Behind the walls.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_5896
lines.text: Meeeooow! Meow! Meeeeoow!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_6560
lines.text: Alfred, what's the matter?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60118
lines.text: Uh, I think He wants to fight...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_18708
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18711
lines.text: Meow!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18712
lines.text: Dylan, take the carrier to that crack over there.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_60119
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60120
lines.text: I've never been more serious in my entire life. We have to trust him.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_18769
lines.text: Are you okay, Alfie? You did such a good job, yes you did.

lines.speaker: ALFREDTHECAT_18773
lines.text: Purr.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60134
lines.text: Poor Maria.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60135
lines.text: If only I'd been here...

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60136
lines.text: Dylan, take the carrier back to where you found that dead Ranger. They'll be sending someone anyway to collect the body. They can bring Alfred back at the same time. I'm worried you'll, jostle him.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_5894
lines.text: Where are you going? You can't leave Alfred alone down here!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_29458
lines.text: Whoa, don't leave us here!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_29460
lines.text: Hey, aren't you forgetting someone?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_29462
lines.text: Dylan, hey! What about us?

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_29463
lines.text: Uhhh, cat carrier.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60067
lines.text: Hey, hey! Where are you going? You can't leave me behind!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60069
lines.text: Don't forget the carrier!

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60141
lines.text: You can't leave Alfie here! Take him back to where the Ranger was. He can watch TV while he waits for rescue.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60142
lines.text: Where are you going? If you think this is "close enough", you're wrong.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_60143
lines.text: Wrong one, Dylan! Take Alfred to the other one! They're not going to come in this far -- always trying to get out of doing the hard work.

lines.speaker: LANGSTON_6558
lines.text: Alfred and I are very disappointed in you, Dylan. I was about ready to come down there and get him myself.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71180
lines.text: Hey! Wait! Is this...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71179
lines.text: ...Still Manhattan?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71177
lines.text: Uh, Zoe?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71176
lines.text: Can you hear me? I'm stuck in some kind of... Threshold, I think... Trying to get myself unstuck...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49257
lines.text: Dammit. Back here.
