lines.text: Dylan? Dylan, listen, I think -- I think I saw someone else in here. I think she knows how to get out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49366
lines.text: Hey, hold on--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49369
lines.text: I'm gonna follow her. I have to go.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49373
lines.text: Dylan? Dylan, listen, I think -- I think I found the right cab.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49372
lines.text: That's good. I--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49371
lines.text: I have to go.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49375
lines.text: Mila--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49374
lines.text: I'm getting out of here this time. I'm sure of it. I won't be back. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49377
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11123
lines.text: I'm back here?

lines.speaker: ZOE_14876
lines.text: Dylan, a distress call just came in. We've got Rangers stranded near your location.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14877
lines.text: Here? How?

lines.speaker: ZOE_14878
lines.text: We're still trying to figure that out, as well as a viable rescue plan. But Dylan -- they think Arish is up there too. Sounds like he's in trouble.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14879
lines.text: What if it's a Resonant? Okay, how will I find them?

lines.speaker: ZOE_14880
lines.text: They said they're in some kind of Patterned, copied version of Central. Look for the Verconn building.

lines.speaker: ARISH_14899
lines.text: Does anyone read me? Please...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14900
lines.text: Arish? Is that you?

lines.speaker: ARISH_14901
lines.text: Faden? Faden, okay. You can help me. My head hurts so much I can barely think, but... I think I found something. I am going to find something. It's--

lines.speaker: ARISH_31599
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: ARISH_31600
lines.text: --everything.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31601
lines.text: What are you talking about? Hello?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_14914
lines.text: It's good to see a friendly face up here, Faden. De Vera said you were on your way.

options.text: How did you end up here?
I'll get you out of here

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_31604
lines.text: Glad you're here, Faden. We were startin' to feel a little cut off up here. Radio's barely workin'.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31612
lines.text: How did you get up here?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_31614
lines.text: Wish we knew. We were at the Field Office. When the city Patterned upward, it... Somehow took us with it.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_31616
lines.text: Think we're patterned too?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_31615
lines.text: Stop.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31617
lines.text: Okay. Listen, I'm gonna figure out a way to get you out of here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31618
lines.text: We need to move. Now.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_31620
lines.text: Move where?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31621
lines.text: I don't know yet, but I'm gonna figure out a way to get you out of here.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_31623
lines.text: No. We're not leaving without Arish. He needs backup.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_31625
lines.text: Faden, we gotta find Arish, and fast. He needs backup, and we're gonna give it to him.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31627
lines.text: Is he... Okay? I heard him, on the radio and, he seemed...

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_31628
lines.text: Yeah, he's not doing great. You can say it.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_31630
lines.text: He's been drinking.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_31629
lines.text: Off-duty.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_31631
lines.text: He's under a lot of stress.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31633
lines.text: You still trust him? After the CFD?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_31632
lines.text: We've known Arish a long time. Since all the way back when he ran security for the Maintenance Sector.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_31635
lines.text: He's a good guy.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_31637
lines.text: Real good guy.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31636
lines.text: I'll come back for Arish. Let me help you first. He's not worth your lives.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_31639
lines.text: With all due respect, it's not your call to make.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_31640
lines.text: You don't know the real Arish, not like we do.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_31641
lines.text: He's been through a lot.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_31643
lines.text: With Faden here now, we'll find him in no time, right? We'll take your lead.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_14907
lines.text: Damn. That was close.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_14906
lines.text: Appreciate the assist, Faden.

options.text: How did you end up here?
I'll get you out of here

lines.speaker: ARISH_14922
lines.text: I get it now, Faden. I'm gonna--

lines.speaker: ARISH_31649
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: ARISH_31650
lines.text: Maybe I was supposed to mess up then, so that I could be here now. I just... I don't know why yet... Hurry.

lines.speaker: ARISH_31651
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14923
lines.text: Hurry where? Arish?

lines.speaker: ARISH_31652
lines.text: Hnh.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_14925
lines.text: He's getting worse, isn't he?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_14926
lines.text: We need to haul ass.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_70806
lines.text: The hell is this?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_70807
lines.text: Any ideas, Faden?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_14929
lines.text: Don't have the keys for that.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_31653
lines.text: Faden, anything you can do, get to it.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_70808
lines.text: Hey, is one of them moving differently?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_70809
lines.text: What if you just, like... Hit one?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_70810
lines.text: One of them's out of sync. Right?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_70811
lines.text: Hey, one's out of sync again.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_70812
lines.text: Maybe just... Try a different one?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_70813
lines.text: Hey, that did something!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_70814
lines.text: The pattern changed. Keep going.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_14932
lines.text: Shit, Faden, you're earnin' your keep.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_74146
lines.text: Hey! You did it! Let's go.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_14935
lines.text: The fuck is that?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_14937
lines.text: Ah, Jesus.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_31654
lines.text: <pained grunt>

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_31655
lines.text: <pained grunt>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14936
lines.text: <pained grunt>

lines.speaker: ARISH_14939
lines.text: Did you... Feel that too?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31656
lines.text: Yeah, what was that?

lines.speaker: ARISH_31657
lines.text: It's getting closer. I think... I think I'm here to stop it.

lines.speaker: ARISH_31658
lines.text: Just hurry.

lines.speaker: ARISH_31659
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_14942
lines.text: I think we're clear. For now.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_14943
lines.text: You've got some serious combat skills there, Faden.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14944
lines.text: Uh, thanks.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_14946
lines.text: Ah, I think we're blocked again.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_14954
lines.text: Not again.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_14953
lines.text: It's getting worse...

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_31662
lines.text: Come on...

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_14955
lines.text: <pained grunt>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31663
lines.text: <pained grunt>

lines.speaker: ARISH_14957
lines.text: Dylan, are you still there? There's something here with me, closing in on me. I don't know what...

lines.speaker: ARISH_31664
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: ARISH_31665
lines.text: It should be here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14958
lines.text: Arish, where are you?

lines.speaker: ARISH_14959
lines.text: Where? My office.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_14961
lines.text: Is he okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14962
lines.text: No. He's not.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_31666
lines.text: Shit.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_14965
lines.text: Man, bad vibes here, huh?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_14966
lines.text: Stop it. You're making me nervous.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_31667
lines.text: We're getting closer.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_14970
lines.text: Don't wait for us, Faden. If you can find a way around, then do it. We'll catch up.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_14971
lines.text: It's why God created explosives.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31669
lines.text: It won't open.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_31671
lines.text: We're not getting past this in a hurry.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_14974
lines.text: Faden. Look after yourself.

lines.speaker: ARISH_14978
lines.text: Hey, Faden, uh... Faden. Faden?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_14979
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.speaker: ARISH_14980
lines.text: You're... You're with my team, right? They're gonna need help, I think. You'll help them?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31673
lines.text: Yeah... Don't worry. I've got their backs.

lines.speaker: ARISH_31674
lines.text: Good. That's good. There's something... growing here. I'm trying to find it. It's... A Resonant.

lines.speaker: ARISH_31675
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31676
lines.text: Arish, wait for help. Okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31679
lines.text: I... We're all coming to get you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31677
lines.text: Arish, what's going on? You don't sound--

lines.speaker: ARISH_31681
lines.text: I know how I sound!

lines.speaker: ARISH_31680
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: ARISH_31682
lines.text: There's... something here with me. It's here for me, I think. It's a Resonant...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31683
lines.text: Arish, wait for me. Okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31684
lines.text: I... We're all coming to get you.

lines.speaker: ARISH_31686
lines.text: Yeah, of course you will. You will. You'll keep them alive.

lines.speaker: ARISH_31687
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: ARISH_31688
lines.text: I am going to find it... I think... It's a... Coming for me. It's somewhere here... With me. A Resonant.

lines.speaker: ARISH_31689
lines.text: No... My head...

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_14996
lines.text: Don't stop firing!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_31690
lines.text: We got your back, Faden!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_15002
lines.text: Get them sumbitches!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_31691
lines.text: Concentrate your fire!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_15004
lines.text: Watch out, Faden!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_31692
lines.text: Heads up!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_15005
lines.text: Fuck these fuckers!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_15008
lines.text: Don't let 'em get the upper hand!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_15011
lines.text: Almost got 'em!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_15019
lines.text: Thanks for the help.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_15021
lines.text: Hey, group effort.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_15020
lines.text: Sure thing.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_15024
lines.text: It's getting stronger.

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER1_15025
lines.text: Can't keep doing this...

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER3_15026
lines.text: My brain's runnin' outta my goddamn ears!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_31694
lines.text: <pained grunt>

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_31693
lines.text: <pained grunt>

lines.speaker: ARISH_15027
lines.text: Something's wrong. I-I can't see it. I'm--

lines.speaker: ARISH_31695
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: ARISH_31696
lines.text: Dylan? You have to help me. I'm--

lines.speaker: ARISH_31697
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: ARISH_31698
lines.text: --was wrong about you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31700
lines.text: Arish, where exactly are you?

lines.speaker: ARISH_31699
lines.text: How did it feel? When you changed--

lines.speaker: ARISH_31701
lines.text: <patterned speech>

lines.speaker: ARISH_31702
lines.text: My headache is finally gone...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31703
lines.text: Arish? Dammit!

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER4_15030
lines.text: Are we too late?

lines.speaker: ARISHRANGER2_31704
lines.text: Just hurry.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_15057
lines.text: Zoe. I found Arish. He... He's gone. He turned into a Resonant. Took over his own team... Everyone's dead.

lines.speaker: ZOE_15059
lines.text: What? Fuck.

lines.speaker: ZOE_15058
lines.text: Okay... Keep this quiet until I can break the news to Pope. Arish might've been an asshole, but I think they used to be friends.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31710
lines.text: Shit. A lot of people looked up to him. This won't be good for morale.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31712
lines.text: Tell Pope I'm sorry. I wish I could've done more.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31713
lines.text: Given how Arish treated you, I'm sure you did plenty.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31714
lines.text: Still.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31715
lines.text: I'm sorry I couldn't save the Rangers. I didn't even know their names.

lines.speaker: ZOE_31716
lines.text: I'll find out. Okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31719
lines.text: This must be why Arish survived the Evac Site when no one else did. He thought his injector had lasted longer, but maybe it didn't. Maybe the Patterning was already changing him...

lines.speaker: ZOE_31718
lines.text: You think it influenced his decision with the CFD?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_31720
lines.text: No, Arish made his own choices. But maybe he was dealing with more than we knew.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67723
lines.text: Hey, how'd you wind up in a place like this?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67724
lines.text: Aww. Did you get separated from your humans? Can I help?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67725
lines.text: Doesn't look like you're injured. Maybe you're hungry? Or... you want something to play with?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67726
lines.text: A... A toy? That's what you want?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67727
lines.text: Okay. I'll keep an eye out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67728
lines.text: Hey girl, you wanted a toy, right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67729
lines.text: Hold tight, I'm looking.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67740
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67741
lines.text: Still haven't found anything to play with, huh? I'll see what I can do.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67742
lines.text: Oh. How do you keep ending up in these places?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67743
lines.text: Still looking for a toy? I'll find one, hang tight.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67744
lines.text: You wind up in the strangest places, don't you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67745
lines.text: I'm still hunting for a toy for you. Yes, I am. Hold on.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67746
lines.text: I'm looking. We'll find you a toy, don't worry.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67747
lines.text: Hey, hi, you're here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67748
lines.text: Still haven't found that toy, huh? Well, I'll see what I can do.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67749
lines.text: You're not following me, are you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67750
lines.text: Aww. Still looking for your toy? I'll find it, hang tight.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67751
lines.text: How'd you get over here?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67752
lines.text: Aww. I'm still hunting for your toy. Hang tight.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67753
lines.text: Wait here while I find your toy, okay? Sit.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67754
lines.text: Hello, again. How'd you end up here? Lost that toy of yours?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67755
lines.text: Must be somewhere nearby.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67756
lines.text: I'll be right back, okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67757
lines.text: Do you remember where you last had it?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67758
lines.text: Right. Stupid question. You're a dog.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67768
lines.text: Hey, where's your little dragon friend?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67769
lines.text: I'll just have to find it for you again, won't I?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67770
lines.text: Where did you lose it? Can you show me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67771
lines.text: I guess not.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67779
lines.text: Look who it is. Hey, girl! Missing your toy?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67780
lines.text: Oh, I'd better get searching, huh?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67781
lines.text: I'm looking. Hang in there.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67789
lines.text: Hey, silly girl. Toy gone again?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67790
lines.text: It'd be handy if we could attach it to you, huh?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67791
lines.text: I'm on the case. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67799
lines.text: Aww. You look like you've lost something.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67800
lines.text: I'll go find your toy. Don't you worry.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67801
lines.text: I'm looking. We'll get your toy back.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67811
lines.text: Hey, girl! Where's your dragon?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67812
lines.text: It's okay. I used to lose things all the time. My sister always helped me find them.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67813
lines.text: I'll be right back. Don't go anywhere, okay? Stay.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67849
lines.text: How are you here? Aren't you the same dog that's in my...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67850
lines.text: You look identical. You even have the same bed. But something's missing... Oh! Where's your dragon toy?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67851
lines.text: Oh, did you lose it?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67852
lines.text: I'll see if I can find it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67853
lines.text: Wait here while I find your toy, okay? Sit.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67886
lines.text: Hello, again. How'd you end up here? Lost that toy of yours?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67887
lines.text: Must be somewhere nearby.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67888
lines.text: I'll be right back, okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67889
lines.text: Do you remember where you last had it?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67890
lines.text: Right. Stupid question. You're a dog.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67902

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67903

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67918

lines.text: Aw. You look like you've lost something.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67943
lines.text: I'll go find your toy. Don't you worry.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67944
lines.text: I'm looking. We'll get your toy back.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67956
lines.text: Oh hey, girl! Where's your dragon?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67957
lines.text: It's okay. I used to lose things all the time. My sister always helped me find them.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67958
lines.text: I'll be right back. Don't go anywhere, okay? Stay.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67739
lines.text: Dog fur is softer than I remember.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67761
lines.text: You are winding up in some pretty weird places, aren't you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67762
lines.text: Something tells me you're not a normal dog.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67763
lines.text: Ah, don't worry. You're just a little different, like me.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67764
lines.text: I'm still not sure I should be leaving you out here alone, though. Will you be all right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67765
lines.text: Oh good girl, you do seem to be handling yourself, somehow.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67766
lines.text: Ah, how's that? Am I doing this right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67767
lines.text: Just bark at me if I do this wrong.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67774
lines.text: How did you wind up out here, anyway? Have you lost your people?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67775
lines.text: I... I know how that feels. It must be scary for you, being alone, with all this going on. ... But you seem like a tough one. Don't you, girl?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67776
lines.text: That's right. I bet you could take a chunk out of even the strongest Hiss, couldn't you? That's a good girl.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67777
lines.text: You're a good dog, aren't you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67778
lines.text: Want more pets? Good girl.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67784
lines.text: You must be from around here, right? A New Yorker? Wonder how far away your place is.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67785
lines.text: I don't know if my house, my old one, back in Ordinary, still exists... Not that it's home anymore.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67786
lines.text: We're going to take care of this mess, okay? We'll get your home back.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67787
lines.text: Oh, good girl.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67788
lines.text: You're a big softy, aren't you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67794
lines.text: So how do you and your bed keep turning up in all these strange places, huh? Are you a paranatural, levitating dog?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67795
lines.text: Or is it teleportation? Maybe a very powerful jump?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67796
lines.text: You're a real mystery, aren't you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67797
lines.text: Oh, who's a good dog? That's right, you are.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67798
lines.text: Who's the sweetest girl?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67804
lines.text: If only you could talk. Maybe you could tell me how you got your powers.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67805
lines.text: Were you born like this? Or... Or did something happen to you, hmm? Something paranatural?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67806
lines.text: Whatever it was, you got through it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67807
lines.text: You're a very good dog.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67808
lines.text: Yeah, yes, you are! There's a Good girl! Oh.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67809
lines.text: Hey, girl.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_67810

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21166
lines.text: Wasn't it?

lines.text: She realized it was us.

lines.speaker: JESSE_21287
lines.text: But she didn't lower the rifle.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71133
lines.text: That night, we... Jesse, I...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21260
lines.text: <shocked breath>

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21261
lines.text: Jesse! You're here!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21262
lines.text: Jesse?

lines.speaker: JESSE_21263
lines.text: Mom I-- I can't... I don't remember what...

lines.speaker: JESSE_21264
lines.text: <distressed sigh>

lines.speaker: JESSE_21265
lines.text: I can't... Remember...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21272
lines.text: Jesse. I'm here. I'm here.

lines.speaker: JESSE_21271
lines.text: I tried to take care of him... But I couldn't.

lines.speaker: JESSE_21270
lines.text: I couldn't take care of him. I wasn't enough.

options.text: You were just a kid too
You did take care of me

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21273
lines.text: All that time... I thought you were so much older, wiser, stronger. But you were just a kid too.

lines.speaker: JESSE_21274
lines.text: I... I wanted to run away again. But it wasn't safe for him.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21277
lines.text: You did take care of me, Jesse. You always took care of me. Everything I needed, you made sure I had it. You took on everything alone.

lines.speaker: JESSE_21275
lines.text: I remember... Things with Mom and Dad got even worse.

lines.speaker: JESSE_21276
lines.text: So we stayed away from home as much as we could. But one night, we stayed out too late...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21278
lines.text: No. I don't... I don't want to remember, Jesse. Not this.

lines.speaker: JESSE_21279
lines.text: We have to remember. We have to keep going.

options.text: You were just a kid too
You did take care of me

lines.speaker: JESSE_21288
lines.text: Mom got home from the hospital a week later. She never spoke to us again.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21289
lines.text: After that, we were each other's only family.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21290
lines.text: It's just... Hard to relive that night.

lines.speaker: JESSE_21291
lines.text: You can't stop at the hard part.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21297
lines.text: Things were okay for awhile.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21296
lines.text: We played outside all day, staying away from home whenever we could.

lines.speaker: JESSE_21299
lines.text: And got lost in Severed Circle when we couldn't. In the game, we were heroes. We didn't have to hide.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_21304
lines.text: Jesse? Are you back?

lines.speaker: JESSE_36209
lines.text: I'm back, Dylan. I remember. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36210
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I'm okay.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36211
lines.text: Dylan--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36212
lines.text: Jesse--

lines.speaker: JESSE_36213
lines.text: I'll talk first.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36327
lines.text: You shouldn't have come.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36214
lines.text: But I can help. I did help.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36215
lines.text: That's not what I mean. You never got to have a life. And now you could lose it.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36216
lines.text: A life? Jesse, you know what I did. The Hiss.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36328
lines.text: Before that.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36217
lines.text: You couldn't have--

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36218
lines.text: Yes, I could.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36219
lines.text: I'm not the kid you used to know, Jesse. I don't need you to protect me anymore.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36220
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36221
lines.text: I'm glad you're here. Okay?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36222
lines.text: What do we do next?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36223
lines.text: Do you know what this place is? Why it's full of our memories?

lines.speaker: JESSE_36224
lines.text: All I know is we're between dimensions. There's nothing else here, so it pulls from us. Or maybe that's how we see it. Emily would have a hundred theories...

lines.speaker: JESSE_36329
lines.text: Listen, we don't have a lot of time.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36226
lines.text: I can feel it.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36227
lines.text: It hasn't cracked open yet, but it will.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36228
lines.text: One more Fault and we seal the dimension.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36330
lines.text: What's happening in Manhattan now, is just the start, the edge of something that is about to be on top of us.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36229
lines.text: Then come back with me. We'll close the Fault from there.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36230
lines.text: I can't. Dylan, we're not really together, physically. We're astral projecting. I don't even know how you found me.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36231
lines.text: We can find a--

lines.speaker: JESSE_36232
lines.text: It doesn't matter. I have to seal the Fault from this side. I knew it was a one-way trip.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36233
lines.text: Then let's get it done.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36234
lines.text: No, I don't accept that.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36235
lines.text: We don't have a choice.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36236
lines.text: Use the Slide Projector.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36237
lines.text: The slide I used to get here wasn't stable. And there's no slide back to our dimension.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36239
lines.text: Jesse... We've barely even met.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36241
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36238
lines.text: I... I understand.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36242
lines.text: I have to go. I can't explain it, but on this side, there is more for me to do. We'll meet at the final Fault. Complete the ritual together. Share the burden.

lines.speaker: JESSE_48555
lines.text: And share the loss.

options.text: What happened to us in other Faults?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36243
lines.text: Would you rather forget? If you really have to stay... Would you rather forget what you're giving up?

lines.speaker: JESSE_36244
lines.text: No. I can't do this if I don't remember what I'm fighting for.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36245
lines.text: Bye, Jesse...

lines.speaker: JESSE_36246
lines.text: Goodbye, Dylan.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36247
lines.text: Wait. In the other Faults, when we got near each other... Jesse, it felt like, like we were--

lines.speaker: JESSE_36248
lines.text: I know. I don't have an answer, Dylan. I don't know if it's us, or if it's this place. But it doesn't matter now.

lines.speaker: JESSE_48556
lines.text: We have to go.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36249
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36250
lines.text: I love you too.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36331
lines.text: Hey, how's Emily... How's Pope?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36251
lines.text: She's okay.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36252
lines.text: Good. I'll see you in the next one.

lines.speaker: JESSE_36225
lines.text: There's one Fault left to close.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_36240

options.text: What happened to us in other Faults?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71247
lines.text: I don't think so...

lines.speaker: ZOE_71248

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71249

lines.speaker: ZOE_71252
lines.text: I'm listening.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71254
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71256
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71257
lines.text: And you said I'm the one who underreacts?

lines.speaker: ZOE_71258
lines.text: What?! Oh my god, this is the absolute wildest thing we've ever faced!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71259
lines.text: It's less funny when you do it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71260
lines.text: I think it's more funny.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71261
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71262
lines.text: I'll put it in the report.

lines.speaker: ZOE_71263
lines.text: I'm assuming you're checking it out. Report back, all right?

lines.text: The old guard at the Bureau say that the Oldest House has a heart. I'm a scientist, I don't really believe in the spirituality of the idea. But it's nice to believe we're not alone in this fight.

Fighting back against the Pattern resonance trying to breach its walls. If I can study that resistance, then I can possibly replicate it.

lines.speaker: ZOE_68325

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68327

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68061
lines.text: I don't think so...

lines.speaker: ZOE_68060

lines.speaker: DYLAN_68065
lines.text: Found some climbing ropes, Zoe. Think it's them? Pope's research team?

lines.speaker: ZOE_68064
lines.text: Sounds like it. One of their team, Schultz, is apparently an expert spelunker. You must be close.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_2970
lines.text: Zoe. I just met one of the researchers. She said time is Patterning down here. There are multiple versions of the research camp, and the researchers. Grist told me she's been down here for months.

lines.speaker: ZOE_6020
lines.text: I know. You told me like twenty minutes ago. I patched Pope in and we've been trying to contact you.

lines.speaker: POPE_6021
lines.text: Dylan? If Schultz's team has had months of relative time, it means they've completed months of additional research. Look, we need their data. From every iteration, every timeline. Find a way to transmit it back.

lines.speaker: ZOE_2967
lines.text: Dylan? Pope just received a blip of data, like something was about to transmit but failed.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9657
lines.text: The transmission tower must have lost power. The power might even be supplied by a different timeline's station.

lines.speaker: ZOE_9660
lines.text: Or maybe power supply needs to be functional in all timelines for the tower to work. This time shit is giving me a migraine. Just keep investigating.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_6038

lines.speaker: AYAD_22060
lines.text: Oh, goddamnit.

lines.speaker: AYAD_22059
lines.text: Urrrh.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22066
lines.text: Excuse me?

lines.speaker: AYAD_22065
lines.text: Dylan! You're not dead! As if we didn't have a million problems, the goddamn power's down. Well they all expect me to fix it. And where does Schultz presume I find spare power? We have one charge. We need four. Any ideas how to duplicate a power supply?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22067
lines.text: Where is Dr. Grist?

lines.speaker: AYAD_22069
lines.text: Guess you don't know. They found Mel dead. She fell from somewhere real high. Strange thing was, there was nothing above her to fall from.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22068
lines.text: Why did you think I was dead?

lines.speaker: AYAD_22070
lines.text: Well, we found all that blood and we haven't seen you in weeks.

lines.speaker: AYAD_70792
lines.text: Now that you're here, you can help me get the power back online. See the tape on the ground? We used it to mark the way so we wouldn't get lost, but I swear it's changing, getting Patterned along with everything else. It should still lead you to the power supplies. I hope.

lines.speaker: AYAD_22078
lines.text: Hey, you found one!

lines.speaker: AYAD_22079
lines.text: You're more useful than you look.

lines.speaker: AYAD_22080
lines.text: Gahh!

lines.speaker: AYAD_22081
lines.text: Damn it, that hurts!

lines.speaker: AYAD_22077
lines.text: No. No. No. No. I'm not dead. I'm not dead. That is not me.

lines.speaker: AYAD_60191
lines.text: No. No. No. No. I'm not dead. I'm not dead. That is not me.

lines.text: Dylan. I have bad news. We've completed an initial analysis of the data. And even with all this research, decades worth of it over multiple timelines, there's nothing in here that can stop the Patterning. The mission has failed.

lines.text: Dylan? What's going on?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_4244

lines.speaker: ZOE_6078

lines.speaker: DYLAN_22039

lines.speaker: ZOE_22040

I've heard radio transmissions from the other timelines. Different events, same outcome. Everyone on the surface is Patterned. For us, they stopped responding on day two. Me and my team never make it out. In every iteration, we all die. So I've come here to speed up the inevitable.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9676
lines.text: I thought I was stuck once too. If I'd given up, I never would have seen the sun again.

lines.speaker: GRIST_9675
lines.text: Nice metaphor. But I've looked at this from every angle. The math, the physics, they don't lie.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_9679
lines.text: I'm here in front of you. I came from the surface. They're not all dead. Not in every timeline.

lines.speaker: GRIST_9678

lines.text: You don't always give up, Grist. I met you in another timeline, one where you had a plan. And I think it's working. That version of you told me to find you. You, here, now! She must have had a reason!

lines.speaker: GRIST_9685
lines.text: I guess I can't let myself down. If I can finish my research and someone gets it early enough in their timeline, they could stop this. Saving a dimension isn't a bad way to-

lines.speaker: MAINTENANCEWORKER_13198
lines.text: Well hello there, intrepid FBC employee! So you're here to begin the fascinating task of light bulb appeasement! This critical maintenance protocol will keep the Oldest House from an ever-worsening fit of shifting. That, if not stopped in time, will turn us all into pancakes! And we don't want that, now do we?

lines.speaker: MAINTENANCEWORKER_13199
lines.text: In this protocol, you'll need to ritualistically appease any loose light bulbs in the area. Or else, they will wreak all kinds of havoc in our core structures! The ritual itself is simple: Twist the problematic bulbs three times in their socket. Righty-tighty!

lines.speaker: MAINTENANCEWORKER_13200
lines.text: The switchboard will show which bulbs need attention. Good luck!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_29370
lines.text: Okay, so: three light bulbs.

lines.speaker: MAINTENANCEWORKER_13205
lines.text: Hello again! This troublesome bulb doesn't play nice with other energy sources. So before you can perform the appeasement ritual. You first need to make sure no batteries or generators or whatnot are around to give it a headache. No one likes competition, right?

lines.speaker: MAINTENANCEWORKER_29404
lines.text: I would like some competition. Or company. Anything.

lines.speaker: MAINTENANCEWORKER_13212
lines.text: Hello again! This bulb is very sensitive. If it feels threatened, it won't cooperate, so be sure to make the area safe for the appeasement ritual. And look out: if it feels threatened, the light bulb might panic! But it's nothing a few soothing words can't fix.

lines.speaker: MAINTENANCEWORKER_29401
lines.text: Fun fact: I've been down here so long that I've lost all sense of time.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13224

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13228
lines.text: You seem stressed. Try, uh, not being stressed.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13240

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13241

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13243

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13255

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13254
lines.text: Just relax, stop worrying.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13258
lines.text: There we go.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13260

lines.speaker: DYLAN_13259
lines.text: Hey, hey. Stay still now so I can get you fixed.

lines.speaker: MAINTENANCEWORKER_13267
lines.text: You're just in time! This silly bulb is averse to all things organic! You need to get rid of any unpleasant plant life around this light bulb before it can be appeased. A gardener's job is never done!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49278
lines.text: We're gonna get you out of here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49284
lines.text: Uh, no, nothing happened that I know of. Just a... false alarm. The city's fine. I'm sure your parents are... fine.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49283
lines.text: Okay... Okay, that's good.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49282
lines.text: Now let's focus on getting you out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49288
lines.text: I just need a little more time. Wait there. I'll find you.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49289
lines.text: Hurry.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11070
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11071
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49290
lines.text: Looks like we're still not in the same place. But I'll keep trying.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11072
lines.text: You... you said that last time. There's no way out of here, is there?

options.text: I got out, so can you

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49292
lines.text: Uh, hey, what kind of movies do you like?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49293
lines.text: What? Movies? What are you... I don't know, something funny, I guess. Action comedy. I used to like thrillers, but... I think my tastes just changed.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49294
lines.text: I like action comedies too. You got a favorite? Okay just... Just tell me about it. The whole plot. I have to go, but you keep talking, okay? When you're done, I'll find you.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49295
lines.text: I... okay. Um... It starts with... a... a car chase...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49299
lines.text: No, listen. I've gotten out. More than once now. You can too.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49298
lines.text: What? But... if you're not trapped, then, you're nowhere near me! I need to go.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49297
lines.text: No, no, no, no, no, just wait.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49296
lines.text: For how much longer?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49301
lines.text: I... just trust me. Please. I'm coming.

options.text: I got out, so can you

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49303
lines.text: Mila? Are you there?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11081
lines.text: I want the truth. You know what's going on in this place, don't you? Just... be honest with me. Please.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49305
lines.text: No. It's just... construction in the city. Don't worry. Everything is fine. It will be fine.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49306
lines.text: I don't... I don't believe you. You're just some voice on the phone. For all I know, you're keeping me here. You drove the cab, didn't you?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49307
lines.text: No. No, I swear. I'm here to help.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49312
lines.text: God... I... I gotta get out of here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49311
lines.text: You will. Soon.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49310
lines.text: Okay... We're in... something called a Threshold. It's like... another dimension. Or a parallel universe. I know it's hard to--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49309
lines.text: You're saying I'm not... I... I... I'm not in... Oh my god. Jesus. What do I... What do I do?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49308
lines.text: We can figure this out. This is no big deal. Trust me. Okay? Mila?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49313
lines.text: Okay... I... please, get me out of here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49314
lines.text: I will. Soon.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11101
lines.text: You're still not here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11103
lines.text: I know, I... I'm sorry. I can't seem to get to you...

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11102
lines.text: This is where I die...

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49317
lines.text: Maybe I should... just walk. Somewhere. In circles if I have to.

options.text: Find a cab and get in

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49319
lines.text: Just... stay in one place. I'm not giving up on you.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49320
lines.text: Okay... okay, I'll wait for you.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49324
lines.text: Good. I'll see you soon, all right?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49322
lines.text: I don't even know you...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49325
lines.text: I swear. Just... I'll see you soon, all right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49327
lines.text: All right?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49328
lines.text: Listen, there's a way in and out of this place. But it's... not easy. I was hoping I could...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49330
lines.text: Are there any taxis nearby?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49332
lines.text: I don't know, I've been... I didn't want to look around anymore.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49331
lines.text: I need you to look for a car. If you find the right one, it can take you back. There's a trick to it, you have to recognize a pattern in them...

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49344
lines.text: What was the point?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49342
lines.text: Please, just try.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49343
lines.text: I'll try.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49341
lines.text: Good. Don't give up.

options.text: Find a cab and get in

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11110
lines.text: Hello? Hello, Mila?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11111
lines.text: You're still not here.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11112
lines.text: I... I'm so sorry. I won't stop looking.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11113
lines.text: Did you hear me? Hello?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49346
lines.text: I'm gonna find you. I will.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49349
lines.text: Mila? Did you try it?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49348
lines.text: It didn't work. I... can't make sense of it. Nothing works!

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49353
lines.text: Just keep trying, okay?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49352
lines.text: I'm not... I'm not gonna answer anymore. I... you're just making things worse.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49351
lines.text: No, Mila--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49350
lines.text: Goodbye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49354
lines.text: Mila, find another cab! Hello?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49355
lines.text: Mila? Did you try it?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49358
lines.text: I'm... I am somewhere new. But I'm still trapped.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49357
lines.text: Then it's working. Find another cab. Find the pattern. You can do this.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49356
lines.text: Okay... I will. Hey, if we don't talk again... Thanks.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49359
lines.text: Just keep going.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11129
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_11132
lines.text: Mila?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11130
lines.text: Hello...? I think this is, it's letting me record an answering message. Can payphones do that? I'm not sure if it's... really a payphone.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_11131
lines.text: I can't wait here anymore, I'm sorry. I have to... I have to do something. I think I can climb this building. I do bouldering in my free time... I'm gonna see what's on the other side. Hopefully, I... won't be back here. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49360
lines.text: Goodbye...

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49363
lines.text: Hello? Mila?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49362
lines.text: Are you there?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49364
lines.text: Mila...?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49368
lines.text: Hello? Mila?

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49367
lines.text: Dylan? Dylan, listen, I think -- I think I saw someone else in here. I think she knows how to get out.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49366
lines.text: Hey, hold on--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49369
lines.text: I'm gonna follow her. I have to go.

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49373
lines.text: Dylan? Dylan, listen, I think -- I think I found the right cab.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49372
lines.text: That's good. I--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49371
lines.text: I have to go.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49375
lines.text: Mila--

lines.speaker: TAXICALLER_49374
lines.text: I'm getting out of here this time. I'm sure of it. I won't be back. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49377
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: LWZPARANGERCURFMAN_58334
lines.text: Tell you something? I hope the guys that went in are okay, wherever they are. I would not like to be with them.

lines.speaker: LWZPARANGERCHOU_58335
lines.text: Yeah, that place is messed up. Just looking at it gives me a migraine.

lines.speaker: LWZPARANGERCURFMAN_58336
lines.text: Lw Zpa Ranger Curfman

lines.speaker: LWZPARANGERCHOU_58337
lines.text: Lw Zpa Ranger Chou

lines.speaker: LWZPARANGERCURFMAN_58338
lines.text: Resonant.

lines.speaker: LWZPARANGERCHOU_58339
lines.text: Lw Zpa Ranger Chou

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49634
lines.text: I'm authorized to be in the zone.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49635
lines.text: I think.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49636
lines.text: Look, I know who you are. You don't have a lot of real field experience, so a little advice: If you're gonna work for the Bureau, just because you're authorized to do something, doesn't always mean you should. But hey, you do you.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49628
lines.text: If I were you, I'd give the West Incursion Zone a mile-wide berth at least.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49629
lines.text: You're here...

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49630
lines.text: Yeah, well I'm definitely not stepping foot inside. Research Department thinks the Patterning in the zone is still spreading. As far as we know, everyone who's entered has gone MIA, with one exception: Myself. If you're thinking that was down to my resourcefulness, think again. I'm just glad to be back in normal gravity.

options.text: What happened to you in there?

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49631
lines.text: Like I said, you'd be smart to head back into Central. Trust my firsthand experience if you won't trust the reports -- you don't wanna be in the West Incursion Zone.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49632
lines.text: What happened to you in there?

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49633
lines.text: Checkpoint Guard Ford

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49640
lines.text: Bureau's sent agents in to set up camp.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49637
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49638
lines.text: I heard someone took down a Resonant in the West Incursion Zone.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49639
lines.text: Bureau's sending agents in to set up camp.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49641
lines.text: Not sure that's advisable, but it's above my paygrade.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49642
lines.text: After someone killed the Resonant, the West Incursion Zone's been newly re-classified: Viable for human life once again.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49643
lines.text: Actually... That was me.

lines.speaker: DYLAN_49646
lines.text: Yeah... I heard the Resonant's gone too...

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49644
lines.text: No shit? You killed the Resonant? Guess the Bureau's gamble on you is paying off.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49645
lines.text: I know it was you. I was giving you the opportunity to be humble.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49650
lines.text: We could really use some wins.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49648
lines.text: I know it was you. But glad to see you're humble.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49647
lines.text: You couldn't bribe me to go in myself, dead Resonant or not.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49651
lines.text: All in all, things are looking up.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49649
lines.text: Anyway, hopefully it goes better for the team in there this time around, huh?

options.text: What happened to you in there?

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49625
lines.text: Hey. Hey, this zone is off-limits.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49626
lines.text: I wouldn't advise going in.

lines.speaker: CHECKPOINTGUARDFORD_49627
lines.text: If you die in there, they won't authorize a body recovery.

lines.speaker: HISSAIRLOCKRECORDING_19147
lines.text: Please enter the decontamination area one at a time. You may be asked to undergo a series of minor cognitive and medical evaluations to determine your level of exposure to the gas leak. You may be asked to change out of contaminated clothing. You may be temporarily separated from your loved ones during processing. Do not be alarmed.

lines.speaker: HISSAIRLOCKRECORDING_19149
lines.text: The decontamination process ensures that no residual contaminants enter the Evacuation Site. If you have any questions or need assistance, Agent Carol is present and ready to assist you.

lines.speaker: HISSAIRLOCKRECORDING_19150
lines.text: Please enter and exit the decontamination area in a quick and orderly fashion. Thank you for your patience and cooperation.

lines.speaker: ARISH_33929
lines.text: No no... What happened? How did I let it happen? Wanted to do the right thing. Was supposed to be better than this. What's wrong with me?

lines.speaker: DYLAN_71750
lines.text: Rest in peace.
